verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਟੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈ ਬਿਆਜੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ghaTai mool nit baddai biaaj || rahaau ||
verses.translation: It depletes my capital, and the interest charges only increase. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: saat soot mil banaj keen ||
verses.translation: Weaving the seven threads together, they carry on their trade.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: karam bhaavanee sa(n)g leen ||
verses.translation: They are led on by the karma of their past actions.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਕਰਤ ਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: teen jagaatee karat raar ||
verses.translation: The three tax-collectors argue with them.

verses.original: ਚਲੋ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chalo banajaaraa haath jhaar ||2||
verses.translation: The traders depart empty-handed. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬਨਜੁ ਟੂਟ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee hiraanee banaj TooT ||
verses.translation: Their capital is exhausted, and their trade is ruined.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਟਾਂਡੋ ਗਇਓ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis Taa(n)ddo gio fooT ||
verses.translation: The caravan is scattered in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer man sarasee kaaj ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, O mortal, your tasks will be accomplished,

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਤ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਜ ॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaano ta bharam bhaaj ||3||6||
verses.translation: when you merge in the Celestial Lord; let your doubts run away. ||3||6||

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Basant Hindol, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: maataa jooThee pitaa bhee jooThaa jooThe hee fal laage ||
verses.translation: The mother is impure, and the father is impure. The fruit they produce is impure.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜੂਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaveh jooThe jaeh bhee jooThe jooThe mareh abhaage ||1||
verses.translation: Impure they come, and impure they go. The unfortunate ones die in impurity. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahu pa(n)ddit soochaa kavan Thaau ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar, which place is uncontaminated?

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੈਸਿ ਹਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) bais hau bhojan khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Where should I sit to eat my meal? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੋਲਤ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: jihabaa jooThee bolat jooThaa karan netr sabh jooThe ||
verses.translation: The tongue is impure, and its speech is impure. The eyes and ears are totally impure.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੇ ਲੂਠੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree kee jooTh utaras naahee braham agan ke looThe ||2||
verses.translation: The impurity of the sexual organs does not depart; the Brahmin is burnt by the fire. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਾਨੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agan bhee jooThee paanee jooThaa jooThee bais pakaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fire is impure, and the water is impure. The place where you sit and cook is impure.

verses.original: ਜੂਠੀ ਕਰਛੀ ਪਰੋਸਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jooThee karachhee parosan laagaa jooThe hee baiTh khaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Impure is the ladle which serves the food. Impure is the one who sits down to eat it. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਰੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gobar jooThaa chaukaa jooThaa jooThee dheenee kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Impure is the cow dung, and impure is the kitchen square. Impure are the lines that mark it off.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer teiee nar sooche saachee paree bichaaraa ||4||1||7||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, they alone are pure, who have obtained pure understanding. ||4||1||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raamaana(n)dh jee ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raamaanand Jee, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kat jaieeaai re ghar laago ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Where should I go? My home is filled with bliss.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa chit na chalai man bhio pa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My consciousness does not go out wandering. My mind has become crippled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਮਨ ਭਈ ਉਮੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhivas man bhiee uma(n)g ||
verses.translation: One day, a desire welled up in my mind.

verses.original: ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: ghas cha(n)dhan choaa bahu suga(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I ground up sandalwood, along with several fragrant oils.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poojan chaalee braham Thai ||
verses.translation: I went to God's place, and worshipped Him there.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so braham bataio gur man hee maeh ||1||
verses.translation: That God showed me the Guru, within my own mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਜਲ ਪਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa jaieeaai teh jal pakhaan ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, I find water and stones.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: too poor rahio hai sabh samaan ||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading and permeating in all.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan sabh dhekhe joi ||
verses.translation: I have searched through all the Vedas and the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਊਹਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਈਹਾਂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uoohaa(n) tau jaieeaai jau ieehaa(n) na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: I would go there, only if the Lord were not here. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mai balihaaree tor ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to You, O my True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin sakal bikal bhram kaaTe mor ||
verses.translation: You have cut through all my confusion and doubt.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
verses.translit: raamaana(n)dh suaamee ramat braham ||
verses.translation: Raamaanand's Lord and Master is the All-pervading Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh kaaTai koT karam ||3||1||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad eradicates the karma of millions of past actions. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: basa(n)t baanee naamadheau jee kee
verses.translation: Basant, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਕਟਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sa(n)kaTavai sevak bhajai ||
verses.translation: If the servant runs away when his master is in trouble,

verses.original: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੋਊ ਕੁਲ ਲਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chira(n)kaal na jeevai dhouoo kul lajai ||1||
verses.translation: he will not have a long life, and he brings shame to all his family. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat na chhoddau bhaavai log hasai ||
verses.translation: I shall not abandon devotional worship of You, O Lord, even if the people laugh at me.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਬਸੈਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal mere heeare basai(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਰਨੁ ਮਾਂਡੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaise apane dhaneh praanee maran maa(n)ddai ||
verses.translation: The mortal will even die for the sake of his wealth;

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈਂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taise sa(n)t janaa(n) raam naam na chhaaddai(n) ||2||
verses.translation: in the same way, the Saints do not forsake the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa giaa godhaavaree sa(n)saar ke kaamaa ||
verses.translation: Pilgrimages to the Ganges, the Gaya and the Godawari are merely worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: naarain suprasa(n)n hoi ta sevak naamaa ||3||1||
verses.translation: If the Lord were totally pleased, then He would let Naam Dayv be His servant. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਝਰ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: lobh lahar at neejhar baajai ||
verses.translation: The tidal waves of greed constantly assault me.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਡੂਬੈ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ddoobai kesavaa ||1||
verses.translation: My body is drowning, O Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੇ ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar samu(n)dhe taar guobi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Please carry me across the world-ocean, O Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਤਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taar lai baap beeThulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Carry me across, O Beloved Father. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਲ ਬੇੜਾ ਹਉ ਖੇਵਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: anil beRaa hau khev na saakau ||
verses.translation: I cannot steer my ship in this storm.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teraa paar na paiaa beeThulaa ||2||
verses.translation: I cannot find the other shore, O Beloved Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੋ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal satigur mel too mo kau ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful, and unite me with the True Guru;

verses.original: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paar utaare kesavaa ||3||
verses.translation: carry me across, O Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa kahai hau tar bhee na jaanau ||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, I do not know how to swim.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: mo kau baeh dheh baeh dheh beeThulaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Give me Your Arm, give me Your Arm, O Beloved Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਅਵਲਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਣੀ ਗਾਡੀ ਚਾਲਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj aval dhooR manee gaaddee chaalatee ||
verses.translation: Slowly at first, the body-cart loaded with dust starts to move.

verses.original: ਪੀਛੈ ਤਿਨਕਾ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂਕਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: peechhai tinakaa lai kar haa(n)katee ||1||
verses.translation: Later, it is driven on by the stick. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਨਕਤ ਥ੍ਰੂਟਿਟਿ ਹਾਂਕਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaise panakat thraooTiT haa(n)katee ||
verses.translation: The body moves along like the ball of dung, driven on by the dung-beetle.

verses.original: ਸਰਿ ਧੋਵਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਲਾਡੁਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sar dhovan chaalee laaddulee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The beloved soul goes down to the pool to wash itself clean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੋਬੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhobee dhovai bireh biraataa ||
verses.translation: The washerman washes, imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har charan meraa man raataa ||2||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naamadheau ram rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are All-pervading.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਰ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: apane bhagat par kar dhiaa ||3||3||
verses.translation: Please be kind to Your devotee. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: basa(n)t baanee ravidhaas jee kee
verses.translation: Basant, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਝੰਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tujheh sujha(n)taa kachhoo naeh ||
verses.translation: You know nothing.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ ਦੇਖੇ ਊਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahiraavaa dhekhe uoobh jaeh ||
verses.translation: Seeing your clothes, you are so proud of yourself.

verses.original: ਗਰਬਵਤੀ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: garabavatee kaa naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: The proud bride shall not find a place with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਵੈ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teree garadhan uoopar lavai kaau ||1||
verses.translation: Above your head, the crow of death is cawing. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਾਂਇ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਬਾਵਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: too kaa(n)i garabeh baavalee ||
verses.translation: Why are you so proud? You are insane.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਦਉ ਖੂੰਬਰਾਜੁ ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਰੀ ਉਤਾਵਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise bhaadhau khoo(n)baraaj too tis te kharee utaavalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even the mushrooms of summer live longer than you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaise kura(n)k nahee paio bhedh ||
verses.translation: The deer does not know the secret;

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਢੂਢੈ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan suga(n)dh ddooddai pradhes ||
verses.translation: the musk is within its own body, but it searches for it outside.

verses.original: ਅਪ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ap tan kaa jo kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: Whoever reflects on his own body

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis nahee jamaka(n)kar kare khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: - the Messenger of Death does not abuse him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr kaa kareh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The man is so proud of his sons and his wife;

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਗਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur lekhaa maganahaar ||
verses.translation: his Lord and Master shall call for his account.

verses.original: ਫੇੜੇ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: feRe kaa dhukh sahai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The soul suffers in pain for the actions it has committed.

verses.original: ਪਾਛੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paachhe kiseh pukaareh peeau peeau ||3||
verses.translation: Afterwards, whom shall you call, ""Dear, Dear.""||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਜਉ ਲੇਹਿ ਓਟ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo kee jau leh oT ||
verses.translation: If you seek the Support of the Holy,

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere miTeh paap sabh koT koT ||
verses.translation: millions upon millions of your sins shall be totally erased.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੋੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas juo japai naam ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, one who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis jaat na janam na jon kaam ||4||1||
verses.translation: is not concerned with social class, birth and rebirth. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ
verses.translit: basa(n)t kabeer jeeau
verses.translation: Basant, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਰਹ ਕੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sureh kee jaisee teree chaal ||
verses.translation: You walk like a cow.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਛਟ ਊਪਰਿ ਝਮਕ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teree poo(n)chhaT uoopar jhamak baal ||1||
verses.translation: The hair on your tail is shiny and lustrous. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eis ghar meh hai su too ddoo(n)dd khaeh ||
verses.translation: Look around, and eat anything in this house.

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਮਤਿ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaur kis hee ke too mat hee jaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But do not go out to any other. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਕੀ ਚਾਟਹਿ ਚੂਨੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chaakee chaaTeh choon khaeh ||
verses.translation: You lick the grinding bowl, and eat the flour.

verses.original: ਚਾਕੀ ਕਾ ਚੀਥਰਾ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaakee kaa cheetharaa kahaa(n) lai jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Where have you taken the kitchen rags? ||2||

verses.original: ਛੀਕੇ ਪਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਡੀਠਿ ॥
verses.translit: chheeke par teree bahut ddeeTh ||
verses.translation: Your gaze is fixed on the basket in the cupboard.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਲਕਰੀ ਸੋਟਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰੈ ਪੀਠਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mat lakaree soTaa teree parai peeTh ||3||
verses.translation: Watch out - a stick may strike you from behind. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੋਗ ਭਲੇ ਕੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer bhog bhale keen ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, you have over-indulged in your pleasures.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਰੈ ਈਂਟ ਢੇਮ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: mat kouoo maarai iee(n)T ddem ||4||1||
verses.translation: Watch out - someone may throw a brick at you. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag saarag chaupadhe mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Saarang, Chau-Padhay, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: apune Thaakur kee hau cheree ||
verses.translation: I am the hand-maiden of my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan gahe jagajeevan prabh ke haumai maar niberee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Feet of God, the Life of the world. He has killed and eradicated my egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pooran param jot paramesar preetam praan hamaare ||
verses.translation: He is the Perfect, Supreme Light, the Supreme Lord God, my Beloved, my Breath of Life.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mohan moh leeaa man meraa samajhas sabadh beechaare ||1||
verses.translation: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, I have come to understand. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh heen hochhee mat jhooThee man tan peer sareere ||
verses.translation: The worthless self-willed manmukh, with false and shallow understanding - his mind and body are held in pain's grip.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੀਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab kee raam ra(n)geelai raatee raam japat man dheere ||2||
verses.translation: Since I came to be imbued with the Love of my Beautiful Lord, I meditate on the Lord, and my mind is encouraged. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai chhodd bhiee bairaagan tab saachee surat samaanee ||
verses.translation: Abandoning egotism, I have become detached. And now, I absorb true intuitive understanding.

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: akul nira(n)jan siau man maaniaa bisaree laaj luokaanee ||3||
verses.translation: The mind is pleased and appeased by the Pure, Immaculate Lord; the opinions of other people are irrelevant. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhoor bhavikh naahee tum jaise mere preetam praan adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: There is no other like You, in the past or in the future, O my Beloved, my Breath of Life, my Support.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kai naam ratee sohaagan naanak raam bhataaraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is imbued with the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, the Lord is her Husband. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kiau raheeaai dhukh biaapai ||
verses.translation: How can I survive without the Lord? I am suffering in pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਫੀਕੀ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa saadh na feekee ras bin bin prabh kaal sa(n)taapai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My tongue does not taste - all is bland without the Lord's sublime essence. Without God, I suffer and die. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag dharas na parasai preetam tab lag bhookh piaasee ||
verses.translation: As long as I do not attain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, I remain hungry and thirsty.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜਲ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekhat hee man maaniaa jal ras kamal bigaasee ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is pleased and appeased. The lotus blossoms forth in the water. ||1||

verses.original: ਊਨਵਿ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਬਰਸੈ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਮੋਰ ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoonav ghanahar garajai barasai kokil mor bairaagai ||
verses.translation: The low-hanging clouds crack with thunder and burst. The cuckoos and the peacocks are filled with passion,

verses.original: ਤਰਵਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taravar birakh biha(n)g bhuia(n)gam ghar pir dhan sohaagai ||2||
verses.translation: along with the birds in the trees, the bulls and the snakes. The soul-bride is happy when her Husband Lord returns home. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kuchil kuroop kunaar kulakhanee pir kaa sahaj na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: She is filthy and ugly, unfeminine and ill-mannered - she has no intuitive understanding of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਨ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ras ra(n)g rasan nahee tirapatee dhuramat dhookh samaaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: She is not satisfied by the sublime essence of her Lord's Love; she is evil-minded, immersed in her pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aai na jaavai naa dhukh paavai naa dhukh dharadh sareere ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride does not come and go in reincarnation or suffer in pain; her body is not touched by the pain of disease.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh te sahaj suhelee prabh dhekhat hee man dheere ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is intuitively embellished by God; seeing God, her mind is encouraged. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoor naahee mero prabh piaaraa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord God is not far away.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan mero man maaniaa har paae praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Word of the True Guru's Teachings. I have found the Lord, the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh har mileeaai var kaaman dhan sohaag piaaree ||
verses.translation: This is the way to meet your Husband Lord. Blessed is the soul-bride who is loved by her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਬਰਨ ਕੁਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaat baran kul sahasaa chookaa gurmat sabadh beechaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Social class and status, race, ancestry and skepticism are eliminated, following the Guru's Teachings and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਿੰਸਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis man maanai abhimaan na taa kau hi(n)saa lobh visaare ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased and appeased, has no egotistical pride. Violence and greed are forgotten.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj ravai var kaaman pir kee gurmukh ra(n)g savaare ||2||
verses.translation: The soul-bride intuitively ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; as Gurmukh, she is embellished by His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਰਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaarau aaisee preet kuTa(n)b sanaba(n)dhee maiaa moh pasaaree ||
verses.translation: Burn away any love of family and relatives, which increases your attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)tar preet raam ras naahee dhubidhaa karam bikaaree ||3||
verses.translation: One who does not savor the Lord's Love deep within, lives in duality and corruption. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਿਤ ਕੌ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ratan padhaarath hit kau dhurai na laal piaaree ||
verses.translation: His Love is a priceless jewel deep within my being; the Lover of my Beloved is not hidden.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam amolak jug jug a(n)tar dhaaree ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, enshrine the Priceless Naam deep within your being, all the ages through. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t janaa kee ham dhoor ||
verses.translation: I am the dust of the feet of the humble Saints of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat param padh paiaa aatam raam rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the supreme status. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sa(n)t milai saa(n)t paieeaai kilavikh dhukh kaaTe sabh dhoor ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Saintly True Guru, I have found peace and tranquility. Sins and painful mistakes are totally erased and taken away.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਫੂਲਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aatam jot bhiee parafoolit purakh nira(n)jan dhekhiaa hajoor ||1||
verses.translation: The Divine Light of the soul radiates forth, gazing upon the Presence of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)gat paiee har har naam rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Sat Sangat; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is all-prevading everywhere.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਨਾਏ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath majan keeaa satasa(n)gat pag naae dhoor ||2||
verses.translation: I have taken my cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, bathing in the dust of the feet of the True Congregation. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat bikaar maleen mat hochhee hiradhaa kusudh laagaa moh koor ||
verses.translation: Evil-minded and corrupt, filthy-minded and shallow, with impure heart, attached to enticement and falsehood.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin karamaa kiau sa(n)gat paieeaai haumai biaap rahiaa man jhoor ||3||
verses.translation: Without good karma, how can I find the Sangat? Engrossed in egotism, the mortal remains stuck in regret. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਾਗਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jee maagau satasa(n)gat pag dhoor ||
verses.translation: Be kind and show Your Mercy, O Dear Lord; I beg for the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t milai har paieeaai jan har bheTiaa raam hajoor ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, the Lord is attained. The Lord's humble servant obtains the Presence of the Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh charanan kau balihaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal jagat na jaiee taranaa jap har har paar utaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot swim across the terrifying world ocean. But chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am carried across across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai prateet banee prabh keree sevaa surat beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Faith in God came to fill my heart; I serve Him intuitively, and contemplate Him.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin raam naam jap hiradhai sarab kalaa gunakaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name within my heart; it is all-powerful and virtuous. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh agam agochar raviaa srab Thaiee man tan alakh apaaree ||
verses.translation: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, All-pervading everywhere, in all minds and bodies; He is Infinite and Invisible.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal bhe tab paiaa hiradhai alakh lakhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: When the Guru becomes merciful, then the Unseen Lord is seen within the heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har naam sarab dharaneedhar saakat kau dhoor bhiaa aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Deep within the inner being is the Name of the Lord, the Support of the entire earth, but to the egotistical shaakta, the faithless cynic, He seems far away.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa jalat na kabahoo boojheh jooaai baajee haaree ||3||
verses.translation: His burning desire is never quenched, and he loses the game of life in the gamble. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat har gun gaaveh gur ki(n)chat kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, the mortal sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, when the Guru bestows even a tiny bit of His Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin kau nadhar bhiee hai tin kee paij savaaree ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace - He saves and protects their honor. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mirat naam dheh piaare ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin uoopar gurmukh man maaniaa tin ke kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are pleased to be Gurmukh - the Lord completes their projects. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan dheen bhe gur aagai tin ke dhookh nivaare ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who become meek before the Guru-their pains are taken away.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh gur aagai gur kai sabadh savaare ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship services to the Guru; they are embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam a(n)mirat ras rasanaa ras gaaveh ras beechaare ||
verses.translation: Within their hearts is the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they savor this essence, sing the praises of this essence, and contemplate this essence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਓਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh a(n)mirat ras cheeni(h)aa oi paaveh mokh dhuaare ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are aware of this ambrosial essence; they find the Gate of Salvation. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਅਚਲਾ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh achal achalaa mat jis dhiraRataa naam adhaare ||
verses.translation: The True is the Primal Being, Unmoving and Unchanging. One who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord - his intellect becomes focused and steady.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis aagai jeeau dhevau apunaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
verses.translation: I offer my soul to Him; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhram dhoojai bhai laage a(n)tar agiaan gubaare ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are stuck in doubt and attached to duality; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is within them.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa nadhar na aavai naa uravaar na paare ||4||
verses.translation: They do not see the True Guru, the Giver; they are not on this shore, or the other. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe ghaT ghaT raviaa suaamee sarab kalaa kal dhaare ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is supremely Potent to exercise His Might.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaasan dhaas kahat hai kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||5||3||
verses.translation: Nanak, the slave of His slaves, says, please, be merciful and save me! ||5||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh kee aaisee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: This is the way to work for the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su sat kar maanahu gurmukh naam rahahu liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, accept that as true. As Gurmukh, remain lovingly absorbed in His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh preet lagee at meeThee avar visar sabh jai ||
verses.translation: The Love of the Lord of the Universe seems supremely sweet. Everything else is forgotten.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin rahas bhiaa man maaniaa jotee jot milai ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, he is in ecstasy; his mind is pleased and appeased, and his light merges into the Light. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab gun gai tab hee man tirapatai saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, his mind is satisfied. Peace and tranquility come to abide within his mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal bhe tab paiaa har charanee chit lai ||2||
verses.translation: When the Guru becomes merciful, the mortal finds the Lord; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mat pragaas bhiee har dhiaaiaa giaan tat liv lai ||
verses.translation: The intellect is enlightened, meditating on the Lord. He remains lovingly attuned to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot pragaTee man maaniaa har sahaj samaadh lagai ||3||
verses.translation: The Divine Light radiates forth deep within his being; his mind is pleased and appeased. He merges intuitively into Celestial Samaadhi. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kapaT nit kapaT kamaaveh mukhahu har har sunai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with falsehood, continues to practice falsehood, even while he teaches and preaches about the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੂਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tuh kooTai dhukh khai ||4||
verses.translation: Within him is the utter darkness of greed. He is thrashed like wheat, and suffers in pain. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab suprasa(n)n bhe prabh mere gurmukh parachaa lai ||
verses.translation: When my God is totally pleased, the mortal tunes in and becomes Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nira(n)jan paiaa naam japat sukh pai ||5||4||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, he has found peace. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man raam naam man maanee ||
verses.translation: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai heearai satigur preet lagaiee man har har kathaa sukhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted divine love within my heart. The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal hovahu jan uoopar jan dhevahu akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to Your meek and humble servant; please bless Your humble servant with Your Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil har ras paiaa har man tan meeTh lagaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found the sublime essence of the Lord. The Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g rate bairaagee jin(h) gurmat naam pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: They alone are unattached, who are imbued with the Lord's Love; through the Guru's Teachings, they realize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: purakhai purakh miliaa sukh paiaa sabh chookee aavan jaanee ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Primal Being, one finds peace, and one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੈਣੀ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: nainee birahu dhekhaa prabh suaamee rasanaa naam vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I gaze lovingly upon God, my Lord and Master. I chant His Name with my tongue.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sravanee keeratan sunau dhin raatee hiradhai har har bhaanee ||3||
verses.translation: With my ears, I listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, day and night. I love the Lord, Har, Har, with all my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਣੇ ਤਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch janaa gur vasagat aane tau unaman naam lagaanee ||
verses.translation: When the Guru helped me to overcome the five thieves, then I found ultimate bliss, attached to the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree har raamai naam samaanee ||4||5||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; he merges in the Lord, in the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜ੍ਹੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam paRh saar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and study His Excellence.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin thir nahee koiee hor nihafal sabh bisathaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is steady or stable. All the rest of the show is useless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਜੀਐ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa leejai kiaa tajeeaai baure jo dheesai so chhaar ||
verses.translation: What is there to accept, and what is there to reject, O madman? Whatever is seen shall turn to dust.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis bikhiaa kau tum(h) apunee kar jaanahu saa chhaadd jaahu sir bhaar ||1||
verses.translation: That poison which you believe to be your own - you must abandon it and leave it behind. What a load you have to carry on your head! ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਅਉਧ ਫੁਨਿ ਘਾਟੈ ਬੂਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: til til pal pal aaudh fun ghaaTai boojh na sakai gavaar ||
verses.translation: Moment by moment, instant by instant, your life is running out. The fool cannot understand this.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so kichh karai j saath na chaalai ih saakat kaa aachaar ||2||
verses.translation: He does things which will not go along with him in the end. This is the lifestyle of the faithless cynic. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g mil baure tau paaveh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: So join together with the humble Saints, O madman, and you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin satasa(n)g sukh kinai na paiaa jai poochhahu bedh beechaar ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, no one finds any peace. Go and ask the scholars of the Vedas. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਊ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raanaa raau sabhai kouoo chaalai jhooTh chhodd jai paasaar ||
verses.translation: All the kings and queens shall depart; they must leave this false expanse.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t sadhaa thir nihachal jin raam naam aadhaar ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are eternally steady and stable; they take the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦਾ
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa dhupadhaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਪੂਤ ਝਗਰਤ ਹਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe poot jhagarat hau sa(n)g baap ||
verses.translation: O son, why do you argue with your father?

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਣੇ ਬਡੀਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਝਗਰਤ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke jane baddeere tum hau tin siau jhagarat paap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is a sin to argue with the one who fathered you and raised you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਤੁਮ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhan kaa tum garab karat hau so dhan kiseh na aap ||
verses.translation: That wealth, which you are so proud of - that wealth does not belong to anyone.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin meh chhodd jai bikhiaa ras tau laagai pachhutaap ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, you shall have to leave behind all your corrupt pleasures; you shall be left to regret and repent. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: jo tumare prabh hote suaamee har tin ke jaapahu jaap ||
verses.translation: He is God, your Lord and Master - chant the Chant of that Lord.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: aupadhes karat naanak jan tum kau jau sunahu tau jai sa(n)taap ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak spreads the Teachings; if you listen to it, you shall be rid of your pain. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ghar panjavaa dhupadhe paRataal
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੋ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap man jaga(n)naath jagadheesaro jagajeevano manmohan siau preet laagee mai har har har Tek sabh dhinas sabh raat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Life of the World, the Enticer of the mind; fall in love with Him. I take the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, all day and all night. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਨਿਨ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kee upamaa anik anik anik gun gaavat suk naaradh brahamaadhik tav gun suaamee ganin na jaat ||
verses.translation: Endless, endless, endless are the Praises of the Lord. Suk Dayv, Naarad and the gods like Brahma sing His Glorious Praises. Your Glorious Virtues, O my Lord and Master, cannot even be counted.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too har bea(n)t too har bea(n)t too har suaamee too aape hee jaaneh aapanee bhaa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are Infinite, O Lord, You are Infinite, O Lord, You are my Lord and Master; only You Yourself know Your Own Ways. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਹੀ ਬਸਤੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: har kai nikaT nikaT har nikaT hee basate te har ke jan saadhoo har bhagaat ||
verses.translation: Those who are near, near to the Lord - those who dwell near the Lord - those humble servants of the Lord are the Holy, the devotees of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: te har ke jan har siau ral mile jaise jan naanak salalai salal milaat ||2||1||8||
verses.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord merge with their Lord, O Nanak, like water merging with water. ||2||1||8||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰਹਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap man narahare narahar suaamee har sagal dhev dhevaa sree raam raam naamaa har preetam moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your Lord and Master. The Lord is the Most Divine of all the divine beings. Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the Lord, my most Dear Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit gireh gun gaavate har ke gun gaavate raam gun gaavate tit gireh vaaje pa(n)ch sabadh vadd bhaag mathoraa ||
verses.translation: That household, in which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, where the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, resound - great is the destiny written on the forehead of one who lives in such a household.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਏ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h) jan ke sabh paap ge sabh dhokh ge sabh rog ge kaam karodh lobh moh abhimaan ge tin(h) jan ke har maar kadde pa(n)ch choraa ||1||
verses.translation: All the sins of that humble being are taken away, all pains are taken away, all diseases are taken away; lust anger, greed, attachment and egotistical pride are taken away. The Lord drives the five thieves out of such a person of the Lord. 1

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
verses.translit: har raam bolahu har saadhoo har ke jan saadhoo jagadhees japahu man bachan karam har har aaraadhoo har ke jan saadhoo ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Holy Saints of the Lord; meditate on the Lord of the Universe, O Holy people of the Lord. Meditate in thought, word and deed on the Lord, Har, Har. Worship and adore the Lord, O Holy people of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਧੂ ॥
verses.translit: har raam bol har raam bol sabh paap gavaadhoo ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, chant the Name of the Lord. It shall rid you of all your sins.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਗਰਣੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੋੁਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit jaagaran karahu sadhaa sadhaa aana(n)dh jap jagadheesuoraa ||
verses.translation: Continually and continuously remain awake and aware. You shall be in ecstasy forever and ever, meditating on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਭੈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: man ichhe fal paavahu sabhai fal paavahu dharam arath kaam mokh jan naanak har siau mile har bhagat toraa ||2||2||9||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak: O Lord, Your devotees obtain the fruits of their minds' desires; they obtain all the fruits and rewards, and the four great blessings - Dharmic faith, wealth and riches, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||2||9||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap man maadho madhusoodhano har sreera(n)go paramesaro sat paramesaro prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of Wealth, the Source of Nectar, the Supreme Lord God, the True Transcendent Being, God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੂਖਨ ਕੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੂਖਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਓੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhookhan ko ha(n)taa sabh sookhan ko dhaataa har preetam gun gaao ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Destroyer of all suffering, the Giver of all peace; sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਓੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ghaT ghaTe ghaT basataa har jal thale har basataa har thaan thaana(n)tar basataa mai har dhekhan ko chaao ||
verses.translation: The Lord dwells in the home of each and every heart. The Lord dwells in the water, and the Lord dwells on the land. The Lord dwells in the spaces and interspaces. I have such a great longing to see the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਸੰਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aavai sa(n)to har kaa jan sa(n)to meraa preetam jan sa(n)to moh maarag dhikhalaavai ||
verses.translation: If only some Saint, some humble Saint of the Lord, my Holy Beloved, would come, to show me the way.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਓੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis jan ke hau mal mal dhovaa paao ||1||
verses.translation: I would wash and massage the feet of that humble being. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kau har miliaa har saradhaa te miliaa gurmukh har miliaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant meets the Lord, through his faith in the Lord; meeting the Lord, he becomes Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਓੁ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan aana(n)dh bhe mai dhekhiaa har raao ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are in ecstasy; I have seen my Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau kirapaa bhiee har kee kirapaa bhiee jagadheesur kirapaa bhiee ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has been blessed with Grace, blessed with the Lord's Grace, blessed with the Grace of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਓੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: mai anadhino sadh sadh sadhaa har japiaa har naao ||2||3||10||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord, night and day, forever, forever and ever. ||2||3||10||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap man nirabhau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Fearless Lord,

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat sadhaa sat ||
verses.translation: who is True, True, Forever True.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: niravair akaal moorat ||
verses.translation: He is free of vengeance, the Image of the Undying,

verses.original: ਆਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥
verses.translit: aajoonee sa(n)bhau ||
verses.translation: beyond birth, Self-existent.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man anadhinuo dhiaai nira(n)kaar niraahaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate night and day on the Formless, Self-sustaining Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਰਭਵਨ ਕਰਤ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan kau har dharasan kau koT koT tetees sidh jatee jogee taT teerath parabhavan karat rahat niraahaaree ||
verses.translation: For the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the three hundred thirty million gods, and millions of Siddhas, celibates and Yogis make their pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, and go on fasts.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹੋਵਤੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin jan kee sevaa thai piee jin(h) kau kirapaal hovat banavaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The service of the humble person is approved, unto whom the Lord of the World shows His Mercy. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke ho sa(n)t bhale te uootam bhagat bhale jo bhaavat har raam muraaree ||
verses.translation: They alone are the good Saints of the Lord, the best and most exalted devotees, who are pleasing to their Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kaa a(n)g karai meraa suaamee tin(h) kee naanak har paij savaaree ||2||4||11||
verses.translation: Those who have my Lord and Master on their side - O Nanak, the Lord saves their honor. ||2||4||11||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla, Partaal:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap man govi(n)dh har govi(n)dh gunee nidhaan sabh sirasaT kaa prabho mere man har bol har purakh abinaasee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Virtue, the God of all creation. O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable, Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam a(n)mrit har har hare so peeaai jis raam piaasee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar, Har, Har, Har. He alone drinks it in, whom the Lord inspires to drink it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aap dhiaal dhiaa kar melai jis satiguroo so jan har har a(n)mirat naam chakhaasee ||1||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows His Mercy, and He leads the mortal to meet with the True Guru. That humble being tastes the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan seveh sadh sadhaa meraa har hare tin kaa sabh dhookh bharam bhau jaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve my Lord, forever and ever - all their pain, doubt and fear are taken away.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਪੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam le taa(n) jeevai jiau chaatirak jal peeaai tirapataasee ||2||5||12||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so he lives, like the song-bird, which is satisfied only by drinking in the water. ||2||5||12||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਿਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man siree raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Supreme Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam ramat raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord is All-pervading.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat raam ||
verses.translation: True, True is the Lord.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਸਦ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu bhieeaa sadh raam raam raam rav rahiaa sarabage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, forever. He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam aape aap aape sabh karataa raam aape aap aap sabhat jage ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is Himself the Creator of all. The Lord Himself is Himself pervading the whole world.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis aap kirapaa kare meraa raam raam raam rai so jan raam naam liv laage ||1||
verses.translation: That person, upon whom my Sovereign Lord King, Raam, Raam, Raam, bestows His Mercy - that person is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਅਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kee upamaa dhekhahu har sa(n)tahu jo bhagat janaa(n) kee pat raakhai vich kalijug age ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, behold the Glory of the Name of the Lord; His Name saves the honor of His humble devotees in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਭਗੇ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kaa a(n)g keeaa merai raam rai dhusaman dhookh ge sabh bhage ||2||6||13||
verses.translation: My Sovereign Lord King has taken servant Nanak's side; his enemies and attackers have all run away. ||2||6||13||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur moorat kau bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Image of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਂਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar piaas chaatirak jiau jal kee safal dharasan kadh paa(n)au ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My inner being is filled with a great thirst, like that of the song-bird for water. When shall I find the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anaathaa ko naath sarab pratipaalak bhagat vachhal har naau ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Cherisher of all. He is the Lover of the devotees of His Name.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau koi na raakhai praanee tis too dheh asaraau ||1||
verses.translation: That mortal, whom no one can protect - You bless him with Your Support, O Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਨਿਗਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਥਾਵਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nidhariaa dhar nigatiaa gat nithaaviaa too thaau ||
verses.translation: Support of the unsupported, Saving Grace of the unsaved, Home of the homeless.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਂਉ ਤਹਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis jaa(n)au tahaa(n) too sa(n)ge teree keerat karam kamaau ||2||
verses.translation: Wherever I go in the ten directions, You are there with me. The only thing I do is sing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਤੇ ਏਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ekas te laakh laakh te ekaa teree gat mit keh na sakaau ||
verses.translation: From Your Oneness, You become tens of thousands, and from tens of thousands, You become One. I cannot describe Your state and extent.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too bea(n)t teree mit nahee paieeaai sabh tero khel dhikhaau ||3||
verses.translation: You are Infinite - Your value cannot be appraised. Everything I see is Your play. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhan kaa sa(n)g saadh siau gosaT har saadhan siau liv laau ||
verses.translation: I speak with the Company of the Holy; I am in love with the Holy people of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak paiaa hai gurmat har dheh dharas man chaau ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Lord through the Guru's Teachings; please bless me with Your Blessed Vision; O Lord, my mind yearns for it. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਛਪਾਈ ਸਾਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਪਵਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karat buraiee maanukh te chhapaiee saakhee bhoot pavaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mortal does evil deeds, and hides from others, but like the air, the Lord is present everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੈਸਨੌ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਖਟ ਕਰਮਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਜੂਠਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: baisanau naam karat khaT karamaa a(n)tar lobh jooThaan ||
verses.translation: You call yourself a devotee of Vishnu and you practice the six rituals, but your inner being is polluted with greed.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਭ ਅਗਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa kee ni(n)dhaa karate ddoobe sabh agiaan ||1||
verses.translation: Those who slander the Society of the Saints, shall all be drowned in their ignorance. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਮ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਝੂਠ ਗੁਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kareh som paak hireh par dharabaa a(n)tar jhooTh gumaan ||
verses.translation: The mortal eats the food which he has carefully prepared, and then steals the wealth of others. His inner being is filled with falsehood and pride.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saasatr bedh kee bidh nahee jaaneh biaape man kai maan ||2||
verses.translation: He knows nothing of the Vedas or the Shaastras; his mind is gripped by pride. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਾਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਸਫਰੀ ਦੰਫਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)dhiaa kaal kareh sabh varataa jiau safaree dha(n)faan ||
verses.translation: He says his evening prayers, and observes all the fasts, but this is all just a show.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਊਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabhoo bhulaae uoojhaR paae nihafal sabh karamaan ||3||
verses.translation: God made him stray from the path, and sent him into the wilderness. All his actions are useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੌ ਪੜਿੑਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: so giaanee so baisanau paRi(h)aa jis karee kirapaa bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is a devotee of Vishnu and a scholar, whom the Lord God blesses with His Grace.

verses.original: ਓੁਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਨ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: oun satigur sev param padh paiaa udhariaa sagal bisavaiaan ||4||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, he obtains the supreme status and saves the whole world. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਥਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੋੁਲਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ham katheh kichh kath nahee jaaneh prabh bhaavai tivai buolaan ||
verses.translation: What can I say? I don't know what to say. As God wills, so do I speak.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਓ ਸਰਾਨ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kee dhoor ik maa(n)gau jan naanak pio saraan ||5||2||
verses.translation: I ask only for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Servant Nanak seeks their Sanctuary. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਰਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: ab moro naachano raho ||
verses.translation: Now, my dancing is over.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਗੀਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਲਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laal rageelaa sahaje paio satigur bachan laho ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have intuitively obtained my Darling Beloved. Through the Word of the True Guru's Teachings, I found Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਕਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: kuaar ka(n)niaa jaise sa(n)g saheree pria bachan upahaas kaho ||
verses.translation: The virgin speaks with her friends about her husband and they laugh together;

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਤਬ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਲਜੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau surijan gireh bheetar aaio tab mukh kaaj lajo ||1||
verses.translation: but when he comes home, she becomes shy, and modestly covers her face. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਨਿਕੋ ਕੋਠਾਰੀ ਚੜਿਓ ਕਬਰੋ ਹੋਤ ਫਿਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kaniko koThaaree chaRio kabaro hot firo ||
verses.translation: When gold is melted in the crucible, it flows freely everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਬਾਰਹਿ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਿਰੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab te sudh bhe hai baareh tab te thaan thiro ||2||
verses.translation: But when it is made into pure solid bars of gold, then it remains stationary. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਬਜਿਓ ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਪਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: jau dhin rain tuoo lau bajio moorat gharee palo ||
verses.translation: As long as the days and the nights of one's life last, the clock strikes the hours, minutes and seconds.

verses.original: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਜੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bajaavanahaaro uooTh sidhaario tab fir baaj na bhio ||3||
verses.translation: But when the gong player gets up and leaves, the gong is not sounded again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਉਦਕ ਪੂਰਿ ਆਨਿਓ ਤਬ ਓੁਹੁ ਭਿੰਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaise ku(n)bh udhak poor aanio tab ouh bhi(n)n dhirasaTo ||
verses.translation: When the pitcher is filled with water, the water contained within it seems distinct.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਜਲੈ ਮਹਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭ ਮਿਲੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ku(n)bh jalai meh ddaario a(n)bhai a(n)bh milo ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the pitcher is emptied out, the water mingles again with water. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab poochhe kiaa kahaa ||
verses.translation: Now if he is asked, what can he say?

verses.original: ਲੈਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਬਾਵਰ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laino naam a(n)mirat ras neeko baavar bikh siau geh rahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He was supposed to have gathered the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, but instead, the mad-man was busy with poison. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਾਤਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhulabh janam chira(n)kaal paio jaatau kauddee badhalahaa ||
verses.translation: This human life, so difficult to obtain, was finally obtained after such a long time. He is losing it in exchange for a shell.

verses.original: ਕਾਥੂਰੀ ਕੋ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਦਿਓ ਕਾਲਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਜਿਵਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaathooree ko gaahak aaio laadhio kaalar birakh jivahaa ||1||
verses.translation: He came to buy musk, but instead, he has loaded dust and thistle grass. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਲਾਭਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਠਾਗਉਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਉਲਝਿ ਪਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaio laabh laabhan kai taiee mohan Thaagauree siau ulajh pahaa ||
verses.translation: He comes in search of profits, but he is entangled in the enticing illusion of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਲਾਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਦਿ ਲਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaach baadharai laal khoiee hai fir ih aausar kadh lahaa ||2||
verses.translation: He loses the jewel, in exchange for mere glass. When will he have this blessed opportunity again? ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਧ ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਹ ਦਾਸਿ ਭਜਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal paraadh ek gun naahee Thaakur chhoddeh dhaas bhajahaa ||
verses.translation: He is full of sins, and he has not even one redeeming virtue. Forsaking his Lord and Master, he is involved with Maya, God's slave.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਮਸਟਿ ਜੜਵਤ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਂਨਿੑਹਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaiee masaT jaRavat kee niaaiee jiau tasakar dhar saa(n)ni(h)haa ||3||
verses.translation: And when the final silence comes, like inanimate matter, he is caught like a thief at the door. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਿ ਰਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aan upaau na kouoo soojhai har dhaasaa saranee par rahaa ||
verses.translation: I cannot see any other way out. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਧਰਹਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tab hee man chhuTeeaai jau sagale aaugan meT dharahaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the mortal is emancipated, only when all his demerits and faults are erased and eradicated. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਧੀਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: maiee dheer rahee pria bahut biraagio ||
verses.translation: O mother, my patience is gone. I am in love with my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਆਨੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhaa(n)t aanoop ra(n)g re tin(h) siau ruchai na laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There are so many kinds of incomparable pleasures, but I am not interested in any of them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਟੇਰਉ ਨਂੀਦ ਪਲਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: nis baasur pria pria mukh Terau na(n)eedh palak nahee jaagio ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I utter, ""Pri-a, Pri-a - Beloved, Beloved"" with my mouth. I cannot sleep, even for an instant; I remain awake and aware.

verses.original: ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haar kajar basatr anik seegaar re bin pir sabhai bikh laagio ||1||
verses.translation: Necklaces, eye make-up, fancy clothes and decorations - without my Husband Lord, these are all poison to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਛਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਦੀਨ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦੇਸਾਂਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: poochhau poochhau dheen bhaa(n)t kar kouoo kahai pria dhesaa(n)gio ||
verses.translation: I ask and ask, with humility, ""Who can tell me which country my Husband Lord lives in?""

verses.original: ਹੀਂਓੁ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hee(n)o dhe(n)au sabh man tan arapau sees charan par raakhio ||2||
verses.translation: I would dedicate my heart to him, I offer my mind and body and everything; I place my head at his feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰਦਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: charan ba(n)dhanaa amol dhaasaro dhe(n)au saadhasa(n)gat aradhaagio ||
verses.translation: I bow at the feet of the voluntary slave of the Lord; I beg him to bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa moh prabhoo milaavahu nimakh dharas pekhaagio ||3||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to me, that I may meet God, and gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan every moment. ||3||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT bhiee tab bheetar aaio meraa man anadhin seetalaagio ||
verses.translation: When He is Kind to me, He comes to dwell within my being. Night and day, my mind is calm and peaceful.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਬਾਜਿਓ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ras ma(n)gal gaae sabadh anaahadh baajio ||4||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I sing the Songs of Joy; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad resounds within me. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiee sat sat sat har sat sat sat saadhaa ||
verses.translation: O mother, True, True True is the Lord, and True, True, True is His Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਛੀਕਿ ਗਾਂਠਰੀ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bachan guroo jo poorai kahio mai chheek gaa(n)Tharee baadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Word which the Perfect Guru has spoken, I have tied to my robe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nis baasur nakhiatr binaasee rav saseear benaadhaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, and the stars in the sky shall vanish. The sun and the moon shall vanish.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਿ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਜਲ ਪਵਨ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਅਟਲਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gir basudhaa jal pavan jaigo ik saadh bachan aTalaadhaa ||1||
verses.translation: The mountains, the earth, the water and the air shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint shall endure. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਡ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤ ਬਿਨਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dd binaasee jer binaasee utabhuj set binaadhaa ||
verses.translation: Those born of eggs shall pass away, and those born of the womb shall pass away. Those born of the earth and sweat shall pass away as well.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖਟਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਧਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaar binaasee khaTeh binaasee ik saadh bachan nihachalaadhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The four Vedas shall pass away, and the six Shaastras shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is eternal. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਭੀ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: raaj binaasee taam binaasee saatak bhee benaadhaa ||
verses.translation: Raajas, the quality of energetic activity shall pass away. Taamas, the quality of lethargic darkness shall pass away. Saatvas, the quality of peaceful light shall pass away as well.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਆਗਾਧਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhirasaTimaan hai sagal binaasee ik saadh bachan aagaadhaa ||3||
verses.translation: All that is seen shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is beyond destruction. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap aap hee aape sabh aapan khel dhikhaadhaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Himself by Himself. All that is seen is His play.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: paio na jaiee kahee bhaa(n)t re prabh naanak gur mil laadhaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: He cannot be found by any means. O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, God is found. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਿਬੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: merai man baasibo gur gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਹਾਂ ਨਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) simaran bhio hai Thaakur tahaa(n) nagar sukh aana(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever my Lord and Master is remembered in meditation - that village is filled with peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਸਭ ਆਪਦ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) beesarai Thaakur piaaro tahaa(n) dhookh sabh aapadh ||
verses.translation: Wherever my Beloved Lord and Master is forgotten - all misery and misfortune is there.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤਹਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh gun gai aana(n)dh ma(n)gal roop tahaa(n) sadhaa sukh sa(n)padh ||1||
verses.translation: Where the Praises of my Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss and Joy are sung - eternal peace and wealth are there. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨਦ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa sravan har kathaa na suneeaai teh mahaa bhiaan udhiaanadh ||
verses.translation: Wherever they do not listen to the Stories of the Lord with their ears - the utterly desolate wilderness is there.

verses.original: ਜਹਾਂ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਹ ਸਘਨ ਬਾਸ ਫਲਾਂਨਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jahaa(n) keeratan saadhasa(n)gat ras teh saghan baas falaa(n)nadh ||2||
verses.translation: Where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung with love in the Saadh Sangat - there is fragrance and fruit and joy in abundance. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਰਖ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਉਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਨਦ ॥
verses.translit: bin simaran koT barakh jeevai sagalee aaudh birathaanadh ||
verses.translation: Without meditative remembrance on the Lord, one may live for millions of years, but his life would be totally useless.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੀਵਾਨਦ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh gobi(n)dh bhajan kar tau sadhaa sadhaa jeevaanadh ||3||
