verses.translation: But if he vibrates and meditates on the Lord of the Universe, for even a moment, then he shall live forever and ever. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਨਦ ॥
verses.translit: saran saran saran prabh paavau dheejai saadhasa(n)gat kirapaanadh ||
verses.translation: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary; please mercifully bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਂਨਦ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak poor rahio hai sarab mai sagal gunaa bidh jaa(n)nadh ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is All-pervading everywhere, amongst all. He knows the qualities and the condition of all. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh raam bharosau paae ||
verses.translation: Now, I have obtained the Support of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾਨਿਧਿ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo saran pario karunaanidh te te bhaveh taraae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the Ocean of Mercy are carried across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਅਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sukh soio ar sahaj samaio sahasaa gureh gavaae ||
verses.translation: They sleep in peace, and intuitively merge into the Lord. The Guru takes away their cynicism and doubt.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo chaahat soiee har keeo man baa(n)chhat fal paae ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever they wish for, the Lord does; they obtain the fruits of their minds' desires. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai japau netr dhiaan laavau sravanee kathaa sunaae ||
verses.translation: In my heart, I meditate on Him; with my eyes, I focus my meditation on Him. With my ears, I listen to His Sermon.

verses.original: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charanee chalau maarag Thaakur kai rasanaa har gun gaae ||2||
verses.translation: With my feet, I walk on my Lord and Mater's Path. With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਉਲਟੀ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhio dhirasaT sarab ma(n)gal roop ulaTee sa(n)t karaae ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I see the Lord, the Embodiment of Absolute Bliss; the Saint has turned away from the world.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paio laal amol naam har chhodd na katahoo jaae ||3||
verses.translation: I have found the Priceless Name of the Beloved Lord; it never leaves me or goes anywhere else. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਡਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਉ ਰੀਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kavan upamaa kaun baddaiee kiaa gun kahau reejhaae ||
verses.translation: What praise, what glory and what virtues should I utter, in order to please the Lord?

verses.original: ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਏ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: hot kirapaal dheen dhiaa prabh jan naanak dhaas dhasaae ||4||8||
verses.translation: That humble being, unto whom the Merciful Lord is kind - O servant Nanak, he is the slave of God's slaves. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਓੁਇ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਰਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: oui sukh kaa siau baran sunaavat ||
verses.translation: Who can I tell, and with whom can I speak, about this state of peace and bliss?

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh pekh prabh dharasan man ma(n)gal gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy and delight, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. My mind sings His Songs of Joy and His Glories. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: bisam bhiee pekh bisamaadhee poor rahe kirapaavat ||
verses.translation: I am wonderstruck, gazing upon the Wondrous Lord. The Merciful Lord is All-pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਪੀਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਵਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: peeo a(n)mirat naam amolak jiau chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaavat ||1||
verses.translation: I drink in the Invaluable Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Like the mute, I can only smile - I cannot speak of its flavor. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaise pavan ba(n)dh kar raakhio boojh na aavat jaavat ||
verses.translation: As the breath is held in bondage, no one can understand its coming in and going out.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kau ridhai pragaas bhio har uaa kee kahee na jai kahaavat ||2||
verses.translation: So is that person, whose heart is enlightened by the Lord - his story cannot be told. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਸੀਖੇ ਪਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: aan upaav jete kichh kahe'eeh tete seekhe paavat ||
verses.translation: As many other efforts as you can think of - I have seen them and studied them all.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਖਾਵਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t laal gireh bheetar pragaTio agam jaise parakhaavat ||3||
verses.translation: My Beloved, Carefree Lord has revealed Himself within the home of my own heart; thus I have realized the Inaccessible Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤੁਲੋ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: niragun nira(n)kaar abinaasee atulo tulio na jaavat ||
verses.translation: The Absolute, Formless, Eternally Unchanging, Immeasurable Lord cannot be measured.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਰਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ajar jin jariaa tis hee kau ban aavat ||4||9||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, whoever endures the unendurable - this state belongs to him alone. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਖਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਗੁਦਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiee dhin rain iv hee gudhaarai ||
verses.translation: The corrupt person passes his days and nights uselessly.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਭਜੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਜਿਉ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh na bhajai aha(n)budh maataa janam jooaai jiau haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; he is intoxicated with egotistical intellect. He loses his life in the gamble. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam amolaa preet na tis siau par ni(n)dhaa hitakaarai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He loves only to slander others.

verses.original: ਛਾਪਰੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਜਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhaapar baa(n)dh savaarai tiran ko dhuaarai paavak jaarai ||1||
verses.translation: Weaving the grass, he builds his house of straw. At the door, he builds a fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਲਰ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਮੂੰਡਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaalar poT uThaavai moo(n)ddeh a(n)mrit man te ddaarai ||
verses.translation: He carries a load of sulfur on his head, and drives the Ambrosial Nectar out of his mind.

verses.original: ਓਢੈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਾਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਝਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oddai basatr kaajar meh pariaa bahur bahur fir jhaarai ||2||
verses.translation: Wearing his good clothes, the mortal falls into the coal-pit; again and again, he tries to shake it off. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਟੈ ਪੇਡੁ ਡਾਲ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੌ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaaTai pedd ddaal par Thaaddau khai khai musakaarai ||
verses.translation: Standing on the branch, eating and eating and smiling, he cuts down the tree.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਛਿਟੀ ਛਿਟੀ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: girio jai rasaatal pario chhiTee chhiTee sir bhaarai ||3||
verses.translation: He falls down head-first and is shattered into bits and pieces. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaae pahuch na sakai gavaarai ||
verses.translation: He bears vengeance against the Lord who is free of vengeance. The fool is not up to the task.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sa(n)tan kaa raakhaa paarabraham nira(n)kaarai ||4||10||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Saving Grace of the Saints is the Formless, Supreme Lord God. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: avar sabh bhoole bhramat na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: All the others are deluded by doubt; they do not understand.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਬੇਦਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek sudhaakhar jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa tin bedheh tat pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That person, within whose heart the One Pure Word abides, realizes the essence of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਤੇਤਾ ਲੋਗ ਪਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paravirat maarag jetaa kichh hoieeaai tetaa log pachaaraa ||
verses.translation: He walks in the ways of the world, trying to please people.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau lau ridhai nahee paragaasaa tau lau a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: But as long as his heart is not enlightened, he is stuck in pitch black darkness. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਂਮੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaise dharatee saadhai bahu bidh bin beejai nahee jaa(n)mai ||
verses.translation: The land may be prepared in every way, but nothing sprouts without being planted.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee hai tuTai naahee abhimaanai ||2||
verses.translation: Just so, without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated, nor is egotistical pride eradicated. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨੈਨੂ ਕੈਸੇ ਰੀਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: neer bilovai at sram paavai nainoo kaise reesai ||
verses.translation: The mortal may churn water until he is sore, but how can butter be produced?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin gur bheTe mukat na kaahoo milat nahee jagadheesai ||3||
verses.translation: Without meeting the Guru, no one is liberated, and the Lord of the Universe is not met. ||3||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat ihai beechaario sarab sukhaa har naamaa ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis bhio paraapat jaa kai lekh mathaamaa ||4||11||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin raam ke gun kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal padhaarath sarab sookh sidh man baa(n)chhat fal laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain all wealth, all pleasures and successes, and the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t praan sukhadhaate simareh prabh abinaasee ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints, let us meditate in remembrance on God; He is the Eternal, Imperishable Giver of Peace and Praanaa, the Breath of Life.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anaatheh naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan poor rahio ghaT vaasee ||1||
verses.translation: Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; He is All-pervading and permeating, abiding in all hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavat sunat sunaavat saradhaa har ras pee vaddabhaage ||
verses.translation: The very fortunate ones drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, singing, reciting and listening to the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTe sabh tan te raam naam liv jaage ||2||
verses.translation: All their sufferings and struggles are wiped away from their bodies; they remain lovingly awake and aware in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh jhooTh taj ni(n)dhaa har simaran ba(n)dhan tooTe ||
verses.translation: So abandon your sexual desire, greed, falsehood and slander; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be released from bondage.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਅੰਧ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh magan aha(n) a(n)dh mamataa gur kirapaa te chhooTe ||3||
verses.translation: The intoxication of loving attachments, egotism and blind possessiveness are eradicated by Guru's Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too samarath paarabraham suaamee kar kirapaa jan teraa ||
verses.translation: You are All-Powerful, O Supreme Lord God and Master; please be Merciful to Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: poor rahio sarab meh Thaakur naanak so prabh neraa ||4||12||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is All-pervading and prevailing everywhere; O Nanak, God is Near. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਚਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gurdhev charan ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai sa(n)g paarabraham dhiaaieeaai upadhes hamaaree gat karan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I meditate with Him on the Supreme Lord God; His Teachings have emancipated me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog bhai sagal binaase jo aavai har sa(n)t saran ||
verses.translation: All pains, diseases and fears are erased, for one who comes to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Saints.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap japai avareh naam japaavai vadd samarath taaran taran ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself chants, and inspires others to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He is Utterly All-Powerful; He carries us across to the other side. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਊਣੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ko ma(n)tr utaarai sahasaa uoone kau subhar bharan ||
verses.translation: His Mantra drives out cynicism, and totally fills the empty one.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਤ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭ ਪਰਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har dhaasan kee aagiaa maanat te naahee fun garabh paran ||2||
verses.translation: Those who obey the Order of the Lord's slaves, do not enter into the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatan kee Tahal kamaavat gaavat dhukh kaaTe taa ke janam maran ||
verses.translation: Whoever works for the Lord's devotees and sings His Praises - his pains of birth and death are taken away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਜਰ ਜਰਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhio kirapaal beeThulaa tin har har ajar jaran ||3||
verses.translation: Those unto whom my Beloved becomes Merciful, endure the Unendurable Ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਬਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: har raseh aghaane sahaj samaane mukh te naahee jaat baran ||
verses.translation: Those who are satisfied by the Sublime Essence of the Lord, merge intuitively into the Lord; no mouth can describe their state.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਨ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak sa(n)tokhe naam prabhoo jap jap udharan ||4||13||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they are content; chanting and meditating on God's Name, they are saved. ||4||13||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: gaio ree mai gun nidh ma(n)gal gaio ||
verses.translation: I sing, O I sing the Songs of Joy of my Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਜਉ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhale sa(n)jog bhale dhin aausar jau gopaal reejhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Fortunate is the time, fortunate is the day and the moment, when I become pleasing to the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਨ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)teh charan moralo maathaa ||
verses.translation: I touch my forehead to the Feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸੰਤ ਧਰੇ ਹਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hamare masatak sa(n)t dhare haathaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints have placed their hands on my forehead. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਹ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadheh ma(n)tr moralo manooaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with the Mantra of the Holy Saints,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa te gat hoe trai guneeaa ||2||
verses.translation: and I have risen above the three qualities||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਹ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨੈਨ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagateh dharas dhekh nain ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of God's devotees, my eyes are filled with love.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤੂਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lobh moh tooTe bhram sa(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: Greed and attachment are gone, along with doubt. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sukh sahaj ana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

verses.original: ਖੋਲਿੑ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kholi(h) bheet mile paramaana(n)dhaa ||4||14||
verses.translation: Tearing down the wall, I have met the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||4||14||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਕਹਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਬੇਦਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaise kahau moh jeea bedhanaiee ||
verses.translation: How can I express the pain of my soul?

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਮਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan piaas pria preet manohar man na rahai bahu bidh umakaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Enticing and Lovely Beloved. My mind cannot survive - it yearns for Him in so many ways. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chitavan chitavau pria preet bairaagee kadh paavau har dharasaiee ||
verses.translation: I think thoughts of Him; I miss the Love of my Beloved. When will I obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jatan karau ih man nahee dheerai kouoo hai re sa(n)t milaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I try, but this mind is not encouraged. Is there any Saint who can lead me to God? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਮਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam pu(n)n sabh homau tis arapau sabh sukh jaa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: Chanting, penance, self-control, good deeds and charity - I sacrifice all these in fire; I dedicate all peace and places to Him.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh pria dharas dhikhaavai tis sa(n)tan kai bal jaa(n)iee ||2||
verses.translation: One who helps me to behold the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, for even an instant - I am a sacrifice to that Saint. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੇਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: karau nihoraa bahut benatee sevau dhin rainaiee ||
verses.translation: I offer all my prayers and entreaties to him; I serve him, day and night.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maan abhimaan hau sagal tiaagau jo pria baat sunaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I have renounced all pride and egotism; he tells me the stories of my Beloved. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਈ ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh charitr bhiee hau bisaman gur satigur purakh milaiee ||
verses.translation: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the wondrous play of God. The Guru, the True Guru, has led me to meet the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: prabh ra(n)g dhiaal moh gireh meh paiaa jan naanak tapat bujhaiee ||4||1||15||
verses.translation: I have found God, my Merciful Loving Lord, within the home of my own heart. O Nanak, the fire within me has been quenched. ||4||1||15||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਬ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: re mooR(h)e too kiau simarat ab naahee ||
verses.translation: You fool, why are you not meditating on the Lord now?

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: narak ghor meh uradh tap karataa nimakh nimakh gun gaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the awful hell of the fire of the womb, you did penance, upside-down; each and every instant, you sang His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam bhramatau hee aaio maanas janam dhulabhaahee ||
verses.translation: You wandered through countless incarnations, until finally you attained this priceless human birth.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਉ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਤਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਅਨ ਠਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garabh jon chhodd jau nikasio tau laago an Thaa(n)hee ||1||
verses.translation: Leaving the womb, you were born, and when you came out, you became attached to other places. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਠਗਾਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kareh buraiee Thagaiee dhin rain nihafal karam kamaahee ||
verses.translation: You practiced evil and fraud day and night, and did useless deeds.

verses.original: ਕਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹ ਗਾਹਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kan naahee tuh gaahan laage dhai dhai dhukh paa(n)hee ||2||
verses.translation: You thrash the straw, but it has no wheat; running around and hurrying, you obtain only pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਸਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa sa(n)g kooR lapaTaio urajh pario kusamaa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: The false person is attached to falsehood; he is entangled with transitory things.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਉ ਕਾਲ ਮੁਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jab pakaras bavare tau kaal mukhaa uTh jaahee ||3||
verses.translation: And when the Righteous Judge of Dharma seizes you, O madman, you shall arise and depart with your face blackened. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: so miliaa jo prabhoo milaiaa jis masatak lekh likhaa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: He alone meets with God, whom God Himself meets, by such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਲਿਪ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin(h) jan balihaaree jo alip rahe man maa(n)hee ||4||2||16||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being, who remains unattached within his mind. ||4||2||16||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau jeevan preetam bin maiee ||
verses.translation: How can I live without my Beloved, O my mother?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਮਿਰਤਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke bichhurat hot mritakaa gireh meh rahan na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Separated from Him, the mortal becomes a corpse, and is not allowed to remain within the house. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਹਂੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ha(n)eea praan ko dhaataa jaa kai sa(n)g suhaiee ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, the heart, the breath of life. Being with Him, we are embellished with joy.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa sa(n)tahu moh apunee prabh ma(n)gal gun gaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Gace, O Saint, that I may sing the songs of joyful praise to my God. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਥੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਾੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan sa(n)tan ke maathe mere uoopar nainahu dhoor baa(n)chhaae(n)ee ||
verses.translation: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. My eyes long for their dust.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh mileeaai prabh naanak bal bal taa kai hau jaiee ||2||3||17||
verses.translation: By His Grace, we meet God; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||17||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਆ ਅਉਸਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: auaa aausar kai hau bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that occasion.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar apanaa prabh simaran vaddabhaagee har paa(n)iee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on my God; by great good fortune, I have found the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਲੋ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੈਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhalo kabeer dhaas dhaasan ko uootam sain jan naiee ||
verses.translation: Kabeer is good, the slave of the Lord's slaves; the humble barber Sain is sublime.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooch te uooch naamadheau samadharasee ravidhaas Thaakur ban aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Highest of the high is Naam Dayv, who looked upon all alike; Ravi Daas was in tune with the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd tan dhan saadhan kaa ih man sa(n)t renaiee ||
verses.translation: My soul, body and wealth belong to the Saints; my mind longs for the dust of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prataap bharam sabh naase naanak mile gusaiee ||2||4||18||
verses.translation: And by the radiant Grace of the Saints, all my doubts have been erased. O Nanak, I have met the Lord. ||2||4||18||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: manorath poore satigur aap ||
verses.translation: The True Guru fulfills the mind's desires.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal padhaarath simaran jaa kai aaTh pahar mere man jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All wealth and treasures are obtained by remembering Him in meditation; twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam suaamee teraa jo peevai tis hee tirapataas ||
verses.translation: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master. Whoever drinks it in is satisfied.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh naaseh aagai dharageh hoi khalaas ||1||
verses.translation: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, and hereafter, he shall be saved and redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: saran tumaaree aaio karate paarabraham pooran abinaas ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Creator, O Perfect Supreme Eternal Lord God.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa tere charan dhiaavau naanak man tan dharas piaas ||2||5||19||
verses.translation: Please be kind to me, that I may meditate on Your Lotus Feet. O Nanak, my mind and body thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||5||19||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਹਾ ਲੁਭਾਈਐ ਆਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: man kahaa lubhaieeaai aan kau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, why are you lured away by otherness?

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot prabh sadhaa sahaiee jeea sa(n)g tere kaam kau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, God is forever your Help and Support. He is your soul-mate; He will help you succeed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਇਹੈ ਅਘਾਵਨ ਪਾਂਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam pria preet manohar ihai aghaavan paa(n)n kau ||
verses.translation: The Name of your Beloved Lover, the Fascinating Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar. Drinking it in, you shall find satisfaction.

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨੀਕੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat hai saadh sa(n)tan kee Thaahar neekee dhiaan kau ||1||
verses.translation: The Being of Immortal Manifestation is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meditate on Him in that most sublime place. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਉਤਾਰਨ ਮਾਂਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: baanee ma(n)tr mahaa purakhan kee maneh utaaran maa(n)n kau ||
verses.translation: The Bani, the Word of the Supreme Lord God, is the greatest Mantra of all. It eradicates pride from the mind.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: khoj lahio naanak sukh thaanaa(n) har naamaa bisraam kau ||2||1||20||
verses.translation: Searching, Nanak found the home of peace and bliss in the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||20||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man sadhaa ma(n)gal gobi(n)dh gai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, sing forever the Songs of Joy of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਘ ਨਿਮਖ ਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog tere miTeh sagal agh nimakh heeaai har naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All your disease, sorrow and sin will be erased, if you meditate on the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd siaanap bahu chaturaiee saadhoo saranee jai pai ||
verses.translation: Abandon all your clever tricks; go and enter the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau hoi kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan jam te hovai dharam rai ||1||
verses.translation: When the Lord, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, the Messenger of Death is changed into the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin naahee ko dhoojaa aan na beeo lavai lai ||
verses.translation: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. No one else can equal Him.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee naanak ko sukhadhaataa har praan sai ||2||2||21||
verses.translation: The Lord is Nanak's Mother, Father and Sibling, the Giver of Peace, his Breath of Life. ||2||2||21||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸੰਗ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan sagal udhaare sa(n)g ke ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant saves those who accompany him.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe puneet pavitr man janam janam ke dhukh hare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their minds are sanctified and rendered pure, and they are rid of the pains of countless incarnations. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਸੇ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maarag chale tin(h)ee sukh paiaa jin(h) siau gosaT se tare ||
verses.translation: Those who walk on the path find peace; they are saved, along with those who speak with them.

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: booddat ghor a(n)dh koop meh te saadhoo sa(n)g paar pare ||1||
verses.translation: Even those who are drowning in the horrible, deep dark pit are carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਬਡੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਜੁਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) ke bhaag badde hai bhaiee tin(h) saadhoo sa(n)g mukh jure ||
verses.translation: Those who have such high destiny turn their faces toward the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kee dhoor baa(n)chhai nit naanak prabh meraa kirapaa kare ||2||3||22||
verses.translation: Nanak longs for the dust of their feet; O God, please shower Your Mercy on me! ||2||3||22||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਂਏ ॥
verses.translit: har jan raam raam raam dhiaa(n)e ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਪਲਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਹ ਪਾਂਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek palak sukh saadh samaagam koT baiku(n)Theh paa(n)e ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who enjoys peace in the Company of the Holy, even for an instant, obtains millions of heavenly paradises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhulabh dheh jap hot puneetaa jam kee traas nivaarai ||
verses.translation: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is sanctified by meditating on the Lord. It takes away the fear of death.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa patit ke paatik utareh har naamaa ur dhaarai ||1||
verses.translation: Even the sins of terrible sinners are washed away, by cherishing the Lord's Name within the heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sunai raam jas niramal taa kaa janam maran dhukh naasaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever listens to the Immaculate Praises of the Lord - his pains of birth and death are dispelled.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗਂੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak paieeaai vaddabhaaga(n)ee man tan hoi bigaasaa ||2||4||23||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord is found by great good fortune, and then the mind and body blossom forth. ||2||4||23||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਰਉ ਜੋਦਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mohan ghar aavahu karau jodhareeaa ||
verses.translation: O my Fascinating Lord, I pray to You: come into my house.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ਬੋਲਉ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਚਿਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan karau abhimaanai bolau bhool chook teree pria chireeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I act in pride, and speak in pride. I am mistaken and wrong, but I am still Your hand-maiden, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT sunau ar pekhau naahee bharam bharam dhukh bhareeaa ||
verses.translation: I hear that You are near, but I cannot see You. I wander in suffering, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਦੋ ਮਿਲਉ ਲਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi kirapaal gur laeh paaradho milau laal man hareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has become merciful to me; He has removed the veils. Meeting with my Beloved, my mind blossoms forth in abundance. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh je bisarai suaamee jaanau koT dhinas lakh bareeaa ||
verses.translation: If I were to forget my Lord and Master, even for an instant, it would be like millions of days, tens of thousands of years.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਜਉ ਪਾਈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kee bheer jau paiee tau naanak har sa(n)g mireeaa ||2||1||24||
verses.translation: When I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, I met my Lord. ||2||1||24||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚਉ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab kiaa sochau soch bisaaree ||
verses.translation: Now what should I think? I have given up thinking.

verses.original: ਕਰਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karanaa saa soiee kar rahiaa dheh naau balihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You do whatever You wish to do. Please bless me with Your Name - I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਫੂਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੂਖਿ ਗਰੁੜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: chahu dhis fool rahee bikhiaa bikh gur ma(n)tr mookh garuRaaree ||
verses.translation: The poison of corruption is flowering forth in the four directions; I have taken the GurMantra as my antidote.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲਾ ਅਲਿਪਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhio kar apunaa jiau jal kamalaa alipaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me as His Own; like the lotus in the water, I remain unattached. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau naahee kichh mai kiaa hosaa sabh tum hee kal dhaaree ||
verses.translation: I am nothing. What am I? You hold all in Your Power.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh sa(n)t sadhakaaree ||2||2||25||
verses.translation: Nanak has run to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save him, for the sake of Your Saints. ||2||2||25||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਵ ਬਿਰਕਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh sarab upaav birakaate ||
verses.translation: Now I have abandoned all efforts and devices.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath suaamee har ekas te meree gaate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes, my only Saving Grace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਂਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhe naanaa roop bahu ra(n)gaa an naahee tum bhaa(n)te ||
verses.translation: I have seen numerous forms of incomparable beauty, but nothing is like You.

verses.original: ਦੇਂਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhe(n)h adhaar sarab kau Thaakur jeea praan sukhadhaate ||1||
verses.translation: You give Your Support to all, O my Lord and Master; You are the Giver of peace, of the soul and the breath of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhramatau bhramatau haar jau pario tau gur mil charan paraate ||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering, I grew so tired; meeting the Guru, I fell at His Feet.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai sarab sukh paiaa ieh sookh bihaanee raate ||2||3||26||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found total peace; this life-night of mine passes in peace. ||2||3||26||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਬਧਿਓ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh labadhio hai har Tekaa ||
verses.translation: Now I have found the Support of my Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਦੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhiaal bhe sukhadhaiee a(n)dhulai maanik dhekhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Giver of peace, has become merciful to me. I was blind - I see the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਤਿਮਰ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaTe agiaan timar niramaleeaa budh bigaas bibekaa ||
verses.translation: I have cut away the darkness of ignorance and become immaculate; my discriminationg intellect has blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਫੇਨੁ ਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਏ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau jal tara(n)g fen jal hoiee hai sevak Thaakur bhe ekaa ||1||
verses.translation: As the waves of water and the foam become water again, the Lord and His servant become One. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਠਿਓ ਤਹ ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਏਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh te uThio teh hee aaio sabh hee ekai ekaa ||
verses.translation: He is taken in again, into what from which he came; all is one in the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਕਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhirasaT aaio srab Thaiee praanapatee har samakaa ||2||4||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have come to see the Master of the breath of life, all-pervading everywhere. ||2||4||27||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਂਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man ekai hee pria maa(n)gai ||
verses.translation: My mind longs for the One Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਦੇਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekh aaio sarab thaan dhes pria rom na samasar laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have looked everywhere in every country, but nothing equals even a hair of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਰੁਚਾਂਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: mai neere anik bhojan bahu bi(n)jan tin siau dhirasaT na karai ruchaa(n)gai ||
verses.translation: All sorts of delicacies and dainties are placed before me, but I do not even want to look at them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਟੇਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਲੋਭਾਂਗੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ras chaahai pria pria mukh Terai jiau al kamalaa lobhaa(n)gai ||1||
verses.translation: I long for the sublime essence of the Lord, calling, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!"", like the Bumble bee longing for the lotus flower. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸਰਬਾਂਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan manmohan laalan sukhadhaiee sarabaa(n)gai ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of Virtue, the Enticer of the mind, my Beloved is the Giver of peace to all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: gur naanak prabh paeh paThaio milahu sakhaa gal laagai ||2||5||28||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak has led me to You, O God. Join with me, O my Best Friend, and hold me close in Your Embrace. ||2||5||28||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: ab moro Thaakur siau man maanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Now my mind is pleased and appeased by my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਛੇਦਿਓ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kirapaal dhiaal bhe hai ih chhedhio dhusaT bigaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saint has become kind and compassionate to me, and has destroyed this demon of duality. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁਘਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum hee su(n)dhar tumeh siaane tum hee sughar sujaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are so beautiful, and You are so wise; You are elegant and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal jog ar giaan dhiaan ik nimakh na keemat jaanaa(n) ||1||
verses.translation: All the Yogis, spiritual teachers and meditators do not know even a bit of Your value. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਨਾਇਕ ਤੁਮੑਹਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum hee naik tum(h)h chhatrapat tum poor rahe bhagavaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Master, You are the Lord under the royal canopy; You are the perfectly pervading Lord God.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: paavau dhaan sa(n)t sevaa har naanak sadh kurabaanaa(n) ||2||6||29||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the gift of service to the Saints; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||6||29||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai man cheet aae pria ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The Love of my Beloved comes into my conscious mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਰਜਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bisario dha(n)dh ba(n)dh maiaa ko rajan sabaiee ja(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have forgotten the entangling affairs of Maya, and I spend my life-night fighting with evil. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har sevau har ridhai basaavau har paiaa satasa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: I serve the Lord; the Lord abides within my heart. I have found my Lord in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaiso milio manohar preetam sukh paae mukh ma(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: So I have met with my enticingly beautiful Beloved; I have obtained the peace which I asked for. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਭੋਗਉ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: priau apanaa gur bas kar dheenaa bhogau bhog nisa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has brought my Beloved under my control, and I enjoy Him with unrestrained pleasure.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਠੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe naanak bhau miTiaa har paio paaTha(n)gaa ||2||7||30||
verses.translation: I have become fearless; O Nanak, my fears have been eradicated. Chanting the Word, I have found the Lord. ||2||7||30||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau ke dharasan kau kurabaanee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਬਚਨ ਨਾਦ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੇਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bachan naadh mere sravanahu poore dhehaa pria a(n)k samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Naad, the Sound-current of His Word fills my ears; my body has settled gently into the Lap of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੂਟਰਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: chhooTar te gur keeiee suohaagan har paio sughaR sujaanee ||
verses.translation: I was a discarded bride, and the Guru has made me a happy soul-bride. I have found the Elegant and All-knowing Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਬਾਸਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh ghar meh baisan nahee paavat so thaan milio baasaanee ||1||
verses.translation: That home, in which I was not even allowed to sit - I have found that place in which I can dwell. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਆਇਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਆਨ ਸੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h) kai bas aaio bhagat bachhal jin raakhee aan sa(n)taanee ||
verses.translation: God, the Love of His devotees, has come under the control of those who protect the honor of His Saints.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har sa(n)g man maaniaa sabh chookee kaan luokaanee ||2||8||31||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my mid is pleased and appeased with the Lord, and my subservience to other people has come to an end. ||2||8||31||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab mero pa(n)chaa te sa(n)g tooTaa ||
verses.translation: Now my association with the five thieves has come to an end.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh bhe man aanadh gur kirapaa te chhooTaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is in ecstasy; by Guru's Grace, I am released. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਖ ਸੂਰੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: bikham thaan bahut bahu dhareeaa anik raakh soorooTaa ||
verses.translation: The impregnable place is guarded by countless ramparts and warriors.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਕਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਨਥ ਭਏ ਲੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikham gaarh kar pahuchai naahee sa(n)t saanath bhe looTaa ||1||
verses.translation: This impregnable fortress cannot be touched, but with the assistance of the Saints, I have entered and robbed it. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਿਆ ਅਮੋਲ ਲਾਲ ਆਖੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahut khajaane merai paalai pariaa amol laal aakhooTaa ||
verses.translation: I have found such a great treasure, a priceless, inexhaustible supply of jewels.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਘੂਟਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree tau man meh har ras ghooTaa ||2||9||32||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, when God showered His Mercy on me, my mind drank in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||9||32||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab mero Thaakur siau man leenaa ||
verses.translation: Now my mind is absorbed in my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: praan dhaan gur poorai dheeaa urajhaio jiau jal meenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the breath of life. I am involved with the Lord, like the fish with the water. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਹ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh madh matasar ieh arap sagal dhaan keenaa ||
verses.translation: I have cast out sexual desire, anger, greed, egotism and envy; I have offered all this as a gift.

verses.original: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ma(n)tr dhiraRai har aaukhadh gur dheeo tau milio sagal prabeenaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the medicine of the Lord's Mantra within me, and I have met with the All-knowing Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਖੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: girahu teraa too Thaakur meraa gur hau khoiee prabh dheenaa ||
verses.translation: My household belongs to You, O my Lord and Master; the Guru has blessed me with God, and rid me of egotism.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai sahaj ghar paiaa har bhagat bha(n)ddaar khajeenaa ||2||10||33||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found the Lord with intuitive ease, within the home of my own heart. Devotional worship of the Lord is a treasure over-flowing. ||2||10||33||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mohan sabh jeea tere too taareh ||
verses.translation: O my Enticing Lord, all beings are Yours - You save them.

verses.original: ਛੁਟਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਨਿਮਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhuTeh sa(n)ghaar nimakh kirapaa te koT brahama(n)dd udhaareh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even a tiny bit of Your Mercy ends all cruelty and tyranny. You save and redeem millions of universes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਾਮੑਾਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kareh aradhaas bahut bena(n)tee nimakh nimakh saam(h)aareh ||
verses.translation: I offer countless prayers; I remember You each and every instant.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan haath dhei nisataareh ||1||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; please give me Your hand and save me. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਏ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa e bhoopat bapure kahe'eeh kahu e kis no maareh ||
verses.translation: And what about these poor kings? Tell me, who can they kill?

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਹਿ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: raakh raakh raakh sukhadhaate sabh naanak jagat tum(h)aareh ||2||11||34||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, save me, O Giver of peace; O Nanak, all the world is Yours. ||2||11||34||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh dhan paio har naamaa ||
verses.translation: Now I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe achi(n)t tirasan sabh bujhee hai ih likhio lekh mathaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have become carefree, and all my thirsty desires are satisfied. Such is the destiny written on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਦੇਹ ਗਿਰਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat bhio bairaagee fir aaio dheh giraamaa ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I became depressed; I wandered all around, and finally came back to my body-village.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਹਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਗਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal saudhaa ih jorio hath chario laal agaamaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Merciful Guru made this deal, and I have obtained the priceless jewel. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਬਾਪਾਰ ਬਨਜ ਜੋ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: aan baapaar banaj jo kare'eh tete dhookh sahaamaa ||
verses.translation: The other deals and trades which I did, brought only sorrow and suffering.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: gobidh bhajan ke nirabhai vaapaaree har raas naanak raam naamaa ||2||12||35||
verses.translation: Fearless are those traders who deal in meditation on the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, the Lord's Name is their capital. ||2||12||35||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਸਟ ਲਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai man misaT lage pria bolaa ||
verses.translation: The Speech of my Beloved seems so sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸਦ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur baeh pakar prabh sevaa laae sadh dhiaal har ddolaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has taken hold of my arm, and linked me to God's service. My Beloved Lord is forever merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਭਿ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh too Thaakur sarab pratipaalak moh kalatr sahit sabh golaa ||
verses.translation: O God, You are my Lord and Master; You are the Cherisher of all. My wife and I are totally Your slaves.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maan taan sabh toohai toohai ik naam teraa mai ol(h)aa ||1||
verses.translation: You are all my honor and power - You are. Your Name is my only Support. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਘਾਸੁ ਬਢਾਵਹਿ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: je takhat baisaaleh tau dhaas tum(h)aare ghaas baddaaveh ketak bolaa ||
verses.translation: If You seat me on the throne, then I am Your slave. If You make me a grass-cutter, then what can I say?

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh purakh bidhaate mere Thaakur ageh atolaa ||2||13||36||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's God is the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, Unfathomable and Immeasurable. ||2||13||36||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਣ ਸੋਹੰ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam kahat gun soha(n) ||
verses.translation: The tongue becomes beautiful, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਓਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh opai samaavai dhekh charit man moha(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He creates and destroys. Gazing upon His Wondrous Plays, my mind is fascinated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਾਨ ਦੁਖ ਜੋਹੰ ॥
verses.translit: jis suniaai man hoi rahas at ridhai maan dhukh joha(n) ||
verses.translation: Listening to His Praises, my mind is in utter ecstasy, and my heart is rid of pride and pain.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukh paio dhukh dhoor paraio ban aaiee prabh toha(n) ||1||
verses.translation: I have found peace, and my pains have been taken away, since I became one with God. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੰ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh ge man niramal hoiee hai gur kaadde maiaa dhroha(n) ||
verses.translation: Sinful resides have been wiped away, and my mind is immaculate. The Guru has lifted me up and pulled me out of the deception of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੋਹੰ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai so prabh paiaa karan kaaran samarathoha(n) ||2||14||37||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||14||37||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਲਤੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu dhekhio chalat tamaasaa ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I have seen the marvellous wonders of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਹੂ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਘਟ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh hoo dhoor sabh hoo te nerai agam agam ghaT vaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is far from all, and yet near to all. He is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, and yet He dwells in the heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਭੂਲੁ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਨ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: abhool na bhoolai likhio na chalaavai mataa na karai pachaasaa ||
verses.translation: The Infallible Lord never makes a mistake. He does not have to write His Orders, and He does not have to consult with anyone.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਨਾਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin meh saaj savaar binaahai bhagat vachhal gunataasaa ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, He creates, embellishes and destroys. He is the Lover of His devotees, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੀਓ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop meh dheepak balio gur ridhai keeo paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: Lighting the lamp in the deep dark pit, the Guru illumines and enlightens the heart.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dharas pekh sukh paiaa sabh pooran hoiee aasaa ||2||15||38||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I have found peace, and all my hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||15||38||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: charaneh gobi(n)dh maarag suhaavaa ||
verses.translation: The most beautiful path for the feet is to follow the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਤੇਤੋ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan maarag jetaa kichh dhaieeaai teto hee dhukh haavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The more you walk on any other path, the more you suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਹਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਟਹਲਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: netr puneet bhe dharas pekhe hasat puneet Tahalaavaa ||
verses.translation: The eyes are sanctified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. Serving Him, the hands are sanctified.

verses.original: ਰਿਦਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ridhaa puneet ridhai har basio masat puneet sa(n)t dhooraavaa ||1||
verses.translation: The heart is sanctified, when the Lord abides within the heart; that forehead which touches the dust of the feet of the Saints is sanctified. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan naam har har kai jis karam likhiaa tin paavaa ||
verses.translation: All treasures are in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he alone obtains it, who has it written in his karma.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau gur pooraa bheTio sukh sahaje anadh bihaavaa ||2||16||39||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; he passes his life-night in peace, poise and pleasure. ||2||16||39||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaaio a(n)t baar naam sakhaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; at the very last instant, it shall be your Help and Support.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh maat pitaa sut bhaiee na pahuchai tahaa tahaa too rakhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In that place where your mother, father, children and siblings shall be of no use to you at all, there, the Name alone shall save you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop gireh meh tin simario jis masatak lekh likhaa ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord in the deep dark pit of his own household, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.

verses.original: ਖੂਲੑੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਿਖਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khool(h)e ba(n)dhan mukat gur keenee sabh toohai tuhee dhikhaa ||1||
verses.translation: His bonds are loosened, and the Guru liberates him. He sees You, O Lord, everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਆਘਾਏ ਰਸਨ ਚਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam peeaa man tirapatiaa aaghaae rasan chakhaa ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, his mind is satisfied. Tasting it, his tongue is satiated.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਖਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sukh sahaj mai paiaa gur laahee sagal tikhaa ||2||17||40||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have obtained celestial peace and poise; the Guru has quenched all my thirst. ||2||17||40||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil aaise prabhoo dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on God in such a way,

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dhiaal dhukh bha(n)jan lagai na taatee baiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that He has become kind and compassionate to me. He is the Destroyer of pain; He does not allow the hot wind to even touch me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹਮ ਲੇਤੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jete saas saas ham lete tete hee gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath I take, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਤ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nimakh na bichhurai gharee na bisarai sadh sa(n)ge jat jaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He is not separated from me, even for an instant, and I never forget Him. He is always with me, wherever I go. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau bal bal bal bal charan kamal kau bal bal gur dharasaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kaahoo paravaahaa jau sukh saagar mai paiaa ||2||18||41||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I do not care about anything else; I have found the Lord, the Ocean of peace. ||2||18||41||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai man sabadh lago gur meeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਖੁਲਿੑਓ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khuli(h)o karam bhio paragaasaa ghaT ghaT har har ddeeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My karma has been activated, and the Divine Radiance of the Lord, Har, Har, is manifest in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਘਟ ਬੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham aajonee sa(n)bhau sarab thaan ghaT beeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, beyond birth, Self-existent, is seated within every heart everywhere.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhio paraapat a(n)mirat naamaa bal bal prabh charaneeThaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have come to obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lotus Feet of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਕੀਏ ਸਗਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat kee ren mukh laagee ke'ee sagal teerath majaneeThaa ||
verses.translation: I anoint my forehead with the dust of the Society of the Saints; it is as if I have bathed at all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ra(n)g chalool bhe hai har ra(n)g na lahai majeeThaa ||2||19||42||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; the Love of my Lord shall never fade away. ||2||19||42||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheeo gur saathe ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as my Companion.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਬਚਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਭੂਖ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh bachan prabh heearai basio sagal bhookh meree laathe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If the Word of God dwells within my heart for even an instant, all my hunger is relieved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਭ ਨਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidhaan gun naik Thaakur sukh samooh sabh naathe ||
verses.translation: O Treasure of Mercy, Master of Excellence, my Lord and Master, Ocean of peace, Lord of all.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਉਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਆਸ ਬਿਰਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek aas moh teree suaamee aaur dhuteeaa aas biraathe ||1||
verses.translation: My hopes rest in You alone, O my Lord and Master; hope in anything else is useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: nain tirapataase dhekh dharasaavaa gur kar dhaare merai maathe ||
verses.translation: My eyes were satisfied and fulfilled, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, when the Guru placed His Hand on my forehead.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai atul sukh paiaa janam maran bhai laathe ||2||20||43||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found immeasurable peace; my fear of birth and death is gone. ||2||20||43||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਆਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: re mooR(h)e aan kaahe kat jaiee ||
verses.translation: You fool: why are you going somewhere else?

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g manohar a(n)mrit hai re bhool bhool bikh khaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Enticing Ambrosial Amrit is with you, but you are deluded, totally deluded, and you eat poison. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh su(n)dhar chatur anoop bidhaate tis siau ruch nahee raiee ||
verses.translation: God is Beautiful, Wise and Incomparable; He is the Creator, the Architect of Destiny, but you have no love for Him.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਵਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mohan siau baavar man mohio jhooTh Thagauree paiee ||1||
verses.translation: The mad-man's mind is enticed by Maya, the enticer; he has taken the intoxicating drug of falsehood. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhio dhiaal kirapaal dhukh harataa sa(n)tan siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of pain has become kind and compassionate to me, and I am in tune with the Saints.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: sagal nidhaan gharai meh paae kahu naanak jot samaiee ||2||21||44||
verses.translation: I have obtained all treasures within the home of my own heart; says Nanak, my light has merged into the Light. ||2||21||44||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਓਅੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਪਹਿਲਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n) pria preet cheet pahilareeaa ||
verses.translation: My consciousness has loved my Beloved God, since the very beginning of time.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tau bachan dheeo mere satigur tau mai saaj seegareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When You blessed me with the Teachings, O my True Guru, I was embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਅਭੂਲਾ ਹਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham bhooleh tum sadhaa abhoolaa ham patit tum patit udhareeaa ||
verses.translation: I am mistaken; You are never mistaken. I am a sinner; You are the Saving Grace of sinners.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਲਾਜ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham neech birakh tum mailaagar laaj sa(n)g sa(n)g basareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a lowly thorn-tree, and You are the sandalwood tree. Please preserve my honor by staying with me; please stay with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੰਤਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tum ga(n)bheer dheer upakaaree ham kiaa bapure ja(n)tareeaa ||
verses.translation: You are deep and profound, calm and benevolent. What am I? Just a poor helpless being.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਤਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੂਖਿ ਸੇਜਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal naanak har melio tau meree sookh sejareeaa ||2||22||45||
verses.translation: The Merciful Guru Nanak has united me with the Lord. I lay on His Bed of Peace. ||2||22||45||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਓਇ ਦਿਨਸ ਧੰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: man oi dhinas dha(n)n paravaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: O my mind, blessed and approved is that day,

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਘਰੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: safal te gharee sa(n)jog suhaave satigur sa(n)g giaanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and fruitful is that hour, and lucky is that moment, when the True Guru blesses me with spirtual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਗ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n subhaag dha(n)n sohaagaa dha(n)n dhet jin maanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Blessed is my good destiny, and blessed is my Husband Lord. Blessed are those upon whom honor is bestowed.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਹੀਂਉ ਕੀਓ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eih tan tum(h)raa sabh girahu dhan tumaraa hee(n)au keeo kurabaanaa(n) ||1||
verses.translation: This body is Yours, all my home and wealth are Yours; I offer my heart as a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪੇਖਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: koT laakh raaj sukh paae ik nimakh pekh dhirasaTaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: I obtain tens of thousands and millions of regal pleasures, if I gaze upon Your Blessed Vision, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਹ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: jau kahahu mukhahu sevak ieh baiseeaai sukh naanak a(n)t na jaanaa(n) ||2||23||46||
verses.translation: When You, O God, say, ""My servant, stay here with me"", Nanak knows unlimited peace. ||2||23||46||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab moro sahasaa dhookh giaa ||
verses.translation: Now I am rid of my skepticism and sorrow.

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaur upaav sagal tiaag chhodde satigur saran piaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have abandoned and forsaken all other efforts, and come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਰੇ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਖਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sidh kaaraj sabh savare aha(n) rog sagal hee khiaa ||
verses.translation: I have attained total perfection, and all my works are perfectly completed; the illness of egotism has been totally eradicated.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਉ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT paraadh khin meh khau bhiee hai gur mil har har kahiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are destroyed in an instant; meeting with the Guru, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhaas gur vasagat keene man nihachal nirabhiaa ||
verses.translation: Subduing the five thieves, he Guru has made them my slaves; my mind has become stable and steady and fearless.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਡੋਲੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: aai na jaavai na kat hee ddolai thir naanak raajiaa ||2||24||47||
verses.translation: It does not come or go in reincarnation; it does not waver or wander anywhere. O Nanak, my empire is eternal. ||2||24||47||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mero it ut sadhaa sahaiee ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, God is forever my Help and Support.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmohan mere jeea ko piaaro kavan kahaa gun gaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Enticer of my mind, the Beloved of my soul. What Glorious Praises of His can I sing and chant? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੇਲਿ ਖਿਲਾਇ ਲਾਡ ਲਾਡਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khel khilai laadd laaddaavai sadhaa sadhaa anadhaiee ||
verses.translation: He plays with me, He fondles and caresses me. Forever and ever, He blesses me with bliss.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pratipaalai baarik kee niaaiee jaise maat pitaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He cherishes me, like the father and the mother love their child. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin nimakh nahee reh sakeeaai bisar na kabahoo jaiee ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant; I shall never forget Him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat te magan bhe liv laiee ||2||25||48||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, joining the Society of the Saints, I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to my Lord. ||2||25||48||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa meet suaamee gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Sing of your Lord and Master, your Best Friend.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aas na avar kaahoo kee keejai sukhadhaataa prabh dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Do not place your hopes in anyone else; meditate on God, the Giver of peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan jiseh ghar tis hee saranee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Peace, joy and salvation are in His Home. Seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiseh tiaag maanukh je sevahu tau laaj lon hoi jaieeaai ||1||
