verses.translation: But if you forsake Him, and serve mortal beings, your honor will dissolve like salt in water. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਪਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ek oT pakaree Thaakur kee gur mil mat budh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Anchor and Support of my Lord and Master; meeting with the Guru, I have found wisdom and understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan naanak prabh miliaa sagal chukee muhataieeaai ||2||26||49||
verses.translation: Nanak has met God, the Treasure of Excellence; all dependence on others is gone. ||2||26||49||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: oT sataanee prabh jeeau merai ||
verses.translation: I have the Almighty Support of my Dear Lord God.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਉ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮਾਣਿ ਮਹਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT na liaavau avar kaahoo kau maan mahat prabh terai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not look up to anyone else. My honor and glory are Yours, O God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai kaadd leeaa bikh gherai ||
verses.translation: God has taken my side; He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the whirlpool of corruption.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam aaukhadh mukh dheeno jai piaa gur pairai ||1||
verses.translation: He has poured the medicine of the Naam, the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, into my mouth; I have fallen at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan upamaa kahau ek mukh niragun ke dhaaterai ||
verses.translation: How can I praise You with only one mouth? You are generous, even to the unworthy.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: kaaT silak jau apunaa keeno naanak sookh ghanerai ||2||27||50||
verses.translation: You cut away the noose, and now You own me; Nanak is blessed with myriad joys. ||2||27||50||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh simarat dhookh binaasee ||
verses.translation: Remembering God in meditation, pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਖਲਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal jeea sukhadhaataa hoiee sagal khalaasee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Giver of peace to the soul becomes merciful, the mortal is totally redeemed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: avar na kouoo soojhai prabh bin kahu ko kis peh jaasee ||
verses.translation: I know of none other than God; tell me, who else should I approach?

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau jaanahu tiau raakhahu Thaakur sabh kichh tum hee paasee ||1||
verses.translation: As You know me, so do You keep me, O my Lord and Master.I have surrendered everything to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhe prabh apune sadh jeevan abinaasee ||
verses.translation: God gave me His Hand and saved me; He has blessed me with eternal life.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੨੮॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak man anadh bhiaa hai kaaTee jam kee faasee ||2||28||51||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my mind is in ecstasy; the noose of death has been cut away from my neck. ||2||28||51||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: mero man jat kat tujheh sam(h)aarai ||
verses.translation: My mind contemplates You, O Lord, all the time.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਪਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik dheen pitaa prabh mere jiau jaaneh tiau paarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am Your meek and helpless child; You are God my Father. As You know me, You save me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਭੁਖੌ ਤਬ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਅਘਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਘਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab bhukhau tab bhojan maa(n)gai aghaae sookh saghaarai ||
verses.translation: When I am hungry, I ask for food; when I am full, I am totally at peace.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਅਰੋਗ ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੌ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab arog jab tum sa(n)g basatau chhuTakat hoi ravaarai ||1||
verses.translation: When I dwell with You, I am free of disease; if I become separated from You, I turn to dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਥਾਪਿਉ ਥਾਪਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan basero dhaas dhaasan ko thaapiau thaapanahaarai ||
verses.translation: What power does the slave of Your slave have, O Establisher and Disestablisher?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਤਬ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naam na bisarai tab jeevan paieeaai binatee naanak ieh saarai ||2||29||52||
verses.translation: If I do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then I die. Nanak offers this prayer. ||2||29||52||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: man te bhai bhau dhoor paraio ||
verses.translation: I have shaken off fear and dread from my mind.

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laal dhiaal gulaal laaddile sahaj sahaj gun gaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Kind, Sweet, Darling Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanaat kamaat kirapaa te bahur na katahoo dhaio ||
verses.translation: Practicing the Guru's Word, by His Grace, I do not wander anywhere anymore.

verses.original: ਰਹਤ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rahat upaadh samaadh sukh aasan bhagat vachhal gireh paio ||1||
verses.translation: The illusion has been dispelled; I am in Samaadhi, Sukh-aasan, the position of peace. I have found the Lord, the Lover of His devotees, within the home of my own heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: naadh binodh kodd aana(n)dhaa sahaje sahaj samaio ||
verses.translation: | The Sound-current of the Naad, playful joys and pleasures - I am intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: karanaa aap karaavan aape kahu naanak aap aapaio ||2||30||53||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, the Cause of causes. Says Nanak, He Himself is All-in-all. ||2||30||53||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam maneh aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa tis kai kurabaanai gur poore namasakaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the One who gave it to me; I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: boojhee tirasanaa sahaj suhelaa kaam karodh bikh jaaro ||
verses.translation: My thirst is quenched, and I have been intuitively embellished. The poisons of sexual desire and anger have been burnt away.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਇਹ ਠਾਹਰ ਜਹ ਆਸਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aai na jai basai ieh Thaahar jeh aasan nira(n)kaaro ||1||
verses.translation: This mind does not come and go; it abides in that place, where the Formless Lord sits. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ekai paragaT ekai gupataa ekai dhu(n)dhookaaro ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is manifest and radiant; the One Lord is hidden and mysterious. The One Lord is abysmal darkness.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee kahu naanak saach beechaaro ||2||31||54||
verses.translation: From the beginning, throughout the middle and until the end, is God. Says Nanak, reflect on the Truth. ||2||31||54||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin prabh rahan na jai gharee ||
verses.translation: Without God, I cannot survive, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh taahoo kai pooran jaa kai sukh hai haree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who finds joy in the Lord finds total peace and perfection. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਘਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal roop praan jeevan dhan simarat anadh ghanaa ||
verses.translation: God is the Embodiment of bliss, the Breath of Life and Wealth; remembering Him in meditation, I am blessed with absolute bliss.

verses.original: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਭਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vadd samarath sadhaa sadh sa(n)ge gun rasanaa kavan bhanaa ||1||
verses.translation: He is utterly All-powerful, with me forever and ever; what tongue can utter His Glorious Praises? ||1||

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਹਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: thaan pavitraa maan pavitraa pavitr sunan kahanahaare ||
verses.translation: His Place is sacred, and His Glory is sacred; sacred are those who listen and speak of Him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੨॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak te bhavan pavitraa jaa meh sa(n)t tum(h)aare ||2||32||55||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that dwelling is sacred, in which Your Saints live. ||2||32||55||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa japatee toohee toohee ||
verses.translation: My tongue chants Your Name, Your Name.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh tum hee pratipaalak mirat ma(n)ddal ik tuhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the mother's womb, You sustained me, and in this mortal world, You alone help me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumeh pitaa tum hee fun maataa tumeh meet hit bhraataa ||
verses.translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother; You are my Loving Friend and Sibling.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum paravaar tumeh aadhaaraa tumeh jeea praanadhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: You are my Family, and You are my Support. You are the Giver of the Breath of Life. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜਰੀਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumeh khajeenaa tumeh jareenaa tum hee maanik laalaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Treasure, and You are my Wealth. You are my Gems and Jewels.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: tumeh paarajaat gur te paae tau naanak bhe nihaalaa ||2||33||56||
verses.translation: You are the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree. Nanak has found You through the Guru, and now he is enraptured. ||2||33||56||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਹੂ ਕਾਹੂ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaahoo kaahoo apuno hee chit aavai ||
verses.translation: Wherever he goes, his consciousness turns to his own.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਚੇਰੋ ਹੋਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kaahoo ko chero hovat Thaakur hee peh jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever is a chaylaa (a servant) goes only to his Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: apane peh dhookh apune peh sookhaa apane hee peh birathaa ||
verses.translation: He shares his sorrows, his joys and his condition only with his own.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apune peh maan apune peh taanaa apane hee peh arathaa ||1||
verses.translation: He obtains honor from his own, and strength from his own; he gets an advantage from his own. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਖਾ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kin hee raaj joban dhan milakhaa kin hee baap mahataaree ||
verses.translation: Some have regal power, youth, wealth and property; some have a father and a mother.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: sarab thok naanak gur paae pooran aas hamaaree ||2||34||57||
verses.translation: I have obtained all things, O Nanak, from the Guru. My hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||34||57||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਝੂਠੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTho maiaa ko madh maan ||
verses.translation: False is intoxication and pride in Maya.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhroh moh dhoor kar bapure sa(n)g gopaaleh jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Get rid of your fraud and attachment, O wretched mortal, and remember that the Lord of the World is with you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਉਮਰੇ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਅਰੁ ਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa raaj joban ar umare meer malak ar khaan ||
verses.translation: False are royal powers, youth, nobility, kings, rulers and aristocrats.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mithiaa kaapar suga(n)dh chaturaiee mithiaa bhojan paan ||1||
verses.translation: False are the fine clothes, perfumes and clever tricks; false are the foods and drinks. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: dheen ba(n)dharo dhaas dhaasaro sa(n)teh kee saaraan ||
verses.translation: O Patron of the meek and the poor, I am the slave of Your slaves; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Saints.

verses.original: ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੫॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: maa(n)gan maa(n)gau hoi achi(n)taa mil naanak ke har praan ||2||35||58||
verses.translation: I humbly ask, I beg of You, please relieve my anxiety; O Lord of Life, please unite Nanak with Yourself. ||2||35||58||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਇਤਨੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: apunee itanee kachhoo na saaree ||
verses.translation: By himself, the mortal cannot accomplish anything.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਾਜ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਵਰਤਾ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik kaaj anik dhaavarataa urajhio aan ja(n)jaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He runs around chasing all sorts of projects, engrossed in other entanglements. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਿਉਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਹਾਂ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaus chaar ke dheeseh sa(n)gee uoohaa(n) naahee jeh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: His companions of these few days will not be there when he is in trouble.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin siau raach maach hit laio jo kaam nahee gaavaaree ||1||
verses.translation: He is hand and glove with those who are of no use to him; the poor wretch is affectionately involved with them. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਹਮਰੋ ਬਸੁ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau naahee naahee kichh meraa naa hamaro bas chaaree ||
verses.translation: I am nothing; nothing belongs to me. I have no power or control.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੬॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan naanak ke prabh sa(n)tan sa(n)g udhaaree ||2||36||59||
verses.translation: O Creator, Cause of causes, Lord God of Nanak, I am saved and redeemed in the Society of the Saints. ||2||36||59||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mohanee mohat rahai na horee ||
verses.translation: The Great Enticer Maya keeps enticing, and cannot be stopped.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh sagal kee piaaree tuTai na kaahoo toree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: She is the Beloved of all the Siddhas and seekers; no one can fend her off. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਚਰਤ ਰਸਨਾਗਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਵਨ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaT saasatr ucharat rasanaagar teerath gavan na thoree ||
verses.translation: Reciting the six Shaastras and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage do not decrease her power.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤਪੀਆ ਊਹਾ ਗੈਲਿ ਨ ਛੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poojaa chakar barat nem tapeeaa uoohaa gail na chhoree ||1||
verses.translation: Devotional worship, ceremonial religious marks, fasting, vows and penance - none of these will make her release her hold. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਜਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop meh patit hot jag sa(n)tahu karahu param gat moree ||
verses.translation: The world has fallen into the deep dark pit. O Saints, please bless me with the supreme status of salvation.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਓ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੭॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat naanak bhio mukataa dharasan pekhat bhoree ||2||37||60||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has been liberated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||37||60||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਖਾਟਿ ਖਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa kareh re khaaT khaaTulee ||
verses.translation: Why are you working so hard to earn profits?

verses.original: ਪਵਨਿ ਅਫਾਰ ਤੋਰ ਚਾਮਰੋ ਅਤਿ ਜਜਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pavan afaar tor chaamaro at jajaree teree re maaTulee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are puffed up like a bag of air, and your skin is very brittle. Your body has grown old and dusty. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਹੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਓ ਊਹਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸਾ ਮਾਸ ਦੇਤ ਝਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoohee te hario uoohaa le dhario jaise baasaa maas dhet jhaaTulee ||
verses.translation: You move things from here to there, like the hawk swooping down on the flesh of its prey.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸਫਰੀ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaar bisaario a(n)dhule jiau safaree udhar bharai beh haaTulee ||1||
verses.translation: You are blind - you have forgotten the Great Giver. You fill your belly like a traveller at an inn. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਝੂਠ ਰਸ ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਭੀਰ ਬਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadh bikaar bikaar jhooTh ras jeh jaano teh bheer baaTulee ||
verses.translation: You are entangled in the taste of false pleasures and corrupt sins; the path which you have to take is very narrow.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝੁ ਰੇ ਇਆਨੇ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਾਂਠੁਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੮॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak samajh re iaane aaj kaal khul(h)ai teree gaa(n)Thulee ||2||38||61||
verses.translation: Says Nanak: figure it out, you ignorant fool! Today or tomorrow, the knot will be untied! ||2||38||61||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: gur jeeau sa(n)g tuhaarai jaanio ||
verses.translation: O Dear Guru, by associating with You, I have come to know the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਧ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਗਹ ਭੀ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT jodh uaa kee baat na puchheeaai taa(n) dharageh bhee maanio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There are millions of heroes, and no one pays any attention to them, but in the Court of the Lord, I am honored and respected. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mool praanee kaa kaheeaai kavan roop dhirasaTaanio ||
verses.translation: What is the origin of the human beings? How beautiful they are!

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jot pragaas bhiee maaTee sa(n)g dhulabh dheh bakhaanio ||1||
verses.translation: When God infuses His Light into clay, the human body is judged to be precious. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸੇਵ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: tum te sev tum te jap taapaa tum te tat pachhaanio ||
verses.translation: From You, I have learned to serve; from You, I have learned to chant and meditate; from You, I have realized the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨਿਓ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: kar masatak dhar kaTee jevaree naanak dhaas dhasaanio ||2||39||62||
verses.translation: Placing His Hand on my forehead, He has cut away the bonds which held me; O Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves. ||2||39||62||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har har dheeo sevak kau naam ||
verses.translation: The Lord has blessed His servant with His Name.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਭਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਖਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maanas kaa ko bapuro bhaiee jaa ko raakhaa raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What can any poor mortal do to someone who has the Lord as his Savior and Protector? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਹਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aap mahaa jan aape pa(n)chaa aap sevak kai kaam ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Great Being; He Himself is the Leader. He Himself accomplishes the tasks of His servant.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape sagale dhoot bidhaare Thaakur a(n)tarajaam ||1||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master destroys all demons; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: aape pat raakhee sevak kee aap keeo ba(n)dhaan ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves the honor of His servants; He Himself blesses them with stability.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੦॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh sevak kee raakhai naanak ko prabh jaan ||2||40||63||
verses.translation: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He saves His servants. O Nanak, how rare is the person who knows God. ||2||40||63||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: too mere meet sakhaa har praan ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are my Best Friend, my Companion, my Breath of Life.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਧਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man dhan jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaraa ih tan seeto tumarai dhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind, wealth, body and soul are all Yours; this body is sewn together by Your Blessing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: tum hee dhe'ee anik prakaaraa tum hee dhe'ee maan ||
verses.translation: You have blessed me with all sorts of gifts; you have blessed me with honor and respect.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa tum hee pat raakhahu a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, You preserve my honor, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jin sa(n)tan jaaniaa too Thaakur te aae paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those Saints who know You, O Lord and Master - blessed and approved is their coming into the world.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: jan kaa sa(n)g paieeaai vaddabhaagee naanak sa(n)tan kai kurabaan ||2||41||64||
verses.translation: The Congregation of those humble beings is obtained by great good fortune; Nanak is a sacrifice to the Saints. ||2||41||64||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karahu gat dhiaal sa(n)tahu moree ||
verses.translation: Save me, O Merciful Saint!

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum samarath kaaran karanaa tooTee tum hee joree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the All-powerful Cause of causes. You have ended my separation, and joined me with God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਖਈ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke bikhiee tum taare sumat sa(n)g tumaarai paiee ||
verses.translation: You save us from the corruption and sins of countless incarnations; associating with You, we obtain sublime understanding.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik jon bhramate prabh bisarat saas saas har gaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting God, we wandered through countless incarnations; with each and every breath, we sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sa(n)g mile saadhoo kai te te patit puneetaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever meets with the Holy Saints - those sinners are sanctified.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa ke vaddabhaagaa tin janam padhaarath jeetaa ||2||42||65||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those who have such high destiny, win this invaluable human life. ||2||42||65||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur binatee karan jan aaio ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, Your humble servant has come to offer this prayer.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh aana(n)dh sahaj ras sunat tuhaaro naio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hearing Your Name, I am blessed with total peace, bliss, poise and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਛਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidhaan sookh ke saagar jas sabh meh jaa ko chhaio ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of Mercy, the Ocean of Peace - His Praises are diffused everywhere.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g ra(n)g tum ke'ee apanaa aap dhirasaTaio ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, You celebrate in the Society of the Saints; You reveal Yourself to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਨ ਝਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu sa(n)g sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan jhaaree kesaio ||
verses.translation: With my eyes I see the Saints, and dedicate myself to serving them; I wash their feet with my hair.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar dharasan sa(n)tan kaa sukh naanak ih paio ||2||43||66||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Saints; this is the peace and comfort which Nanak has received. ||2||43||66||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee ||
verses.translation: One who is lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name

verses.original: ਸਜਨੁ ਸੁਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sajan suridhaa suhelaa sahaje so kaheeaai baddabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: is a good-hearted friend, intuitively embellished with happiness. He is said to be blessed and fortunate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਹਿਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: rahit bikaar alap maiaa te aha(n)budh bikh tiaagee ||
verses.translation: He is rid of sin and corruption, and detached from Maya; he has renounced the poison of egotistical intellect.

verses.original: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਏਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੀਐਂ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharas piaas aas ekeh kee Tek heeaai(n) pria paagee ||1||
verses.translation: He thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and he places his hopes in the One Lord alone. The Feet of his Beloved are the Support of his heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸੋਇ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਸਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t soi jaagan uTh baisan achi(n)t hasat bairaagee ||
verses.translation: He sleeps, wakes, rises up and sits down without anxiety; he laughs and cries without anxiety.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਠਗਾਨਾ ਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਠਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੪੪॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin jagat Thagaanaa su maiaa har jan Thaagee ||2||44||67||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, she who has cheated the world - that Maya is cheated by the humble servant of the Lord. ||2||44||67||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab jan uoopar ko na pukaarai ||
verses.translation: Now, no one complains about the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਪੂਕਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pookaaran kau jo udham karataa gur paramesar taa kau maarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever tries to complain is destroyed by the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਹੁ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaavai har dharageh oh haarai ||
verses.translation: Whoever harbors vengeance against the One who is beyond all vengenace, shall lose in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh prabh kee vaddiaaiee jan kee paij savaarai ||1||
verses.translation: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, it is the glorious greatness of God, that He preserves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe sagal bhau miTiaa charan kamal aadhaarai ||
verses.translation: The mortal becomes fearless, and all his fears are taken away, when he leans on the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੫॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan japio naau naanak pragaT bhio sa(n)saarai ||2||45||68||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name, through the Guru's Word, Nanak has become famous throughout the world. ||2||45||68||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jan chhoddiaa sagalaa aap ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant has discarded all self-conceit.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jaanahu tiau rakhahu gusaiee pekh jeevaa(n) parataap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As You see fit, You save us, O Lord of the World. Beholding Your Glorious Grandeur, I live. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes saadh kee sa(n)gat binasio sagal sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Instruction, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sorrow and suffering is taken away.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mitr satr pekh samat beechaario sagal sa(n)bhaakhan jaap ||1||
verses.translation: I look upon friend and enemy alike; all that I speak is the Lord's meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: tapat bujhee seetal aaghaane sun anahadh bisam bhe bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: The fire within me is quenched; I am cool, calm and tranquil. Hearing the unstruck celestial melody, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੨॥੪੬॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: anadh bhiaa naanak man saachaa pooran poore naadh ||2||46||69||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, O Nanak, and my mind is filled with Truth, through the perfect perfection of the Sound-current of the Naad. ||2||46||69||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai gur moro sahasaa utaariaa ||
verses.translation: My Guru has rid me of my cynicism.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਈਐ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kai jaieeaai balihaaree sadhaa sadhaa hau vaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Guru; I am devoted to Him, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa naam japio dhin raatee gur ke charan man dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: I chant the Guru's Name day and night; I enshrine the Guru's Feet within my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhoor karau nit majan kilavikh mail utaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: I bathe continually in the dust of the Guru's Feet, washing off my dirty sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee karau nit sevaa gur apanaa namasakaariaa ||
verses.translation: I continually serve the Perfect Guru; I humbly bow to my Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੪੭॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: sarab falaa dheen(h)e gur poorai naanak gur nisataariaa ||2||47||70||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with all fruitful rewards; O Nanak, the Guru has emancipated me. ||2||47||70||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam praan gat paavai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal attains salvation.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miTeh kales traas sabh naasai saadhasa(n)g hit laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His sorrows are dispelled, and his fears are all erased; he is in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har man aaraadhe rasanaa har jas gaavai ||
verses.translation: His mind worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; his tongue sings the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan kaam karodh ni(n)dhaa baasudhev ra(n)g laavai ||1||
verses.translation: Abandoning egotistical pride, sexual desire, anger and slander, he embraces love for the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਸੋੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaamodhar dhiaal aaraadhahu gobi(n)dh karat suohaavai ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Merciful Lord God; chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, you shall be embellished and exalted.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪੮॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sabh kee hoi renaa har har dharas samaavai ||2||48||71||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, whoever becomes the dust of all, merges in the Blesed Vision of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||48||71||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: apune gur poore balihaarai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT prataap keeo naam ko raakhe raakhanahaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Savior Lord has saved me; He has revealed the Glory of His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੀਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau ke'ee sevak dhaas apane sagale dhookh bidhaarai ||
verses.translation: He makes His servants and slaves fearless, and takes away all their pain.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan upaav tiaag jan sagale charan kamal ridh dhaarai ||1||
verses.translation: So renounce all other efforts, and enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: praan adhaar meet saajan prabh ekai eka(n)kaarai ||
verses.translation: God is the Support of the breath of life, my Best Friend and Companion, the One and Only Creator of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੯॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch Thaakur naanak kaa baar baar namasakaarai ||2||49||72||
verses.translation: Nanak's Lord and Master is the Highest of all; again and again, I humbly bow to Him. ||2||49||72||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਕਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin har hai ko kahaa bataavahu ||
verses.translation: Tell me: other than the Lord, who exists?

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh samooh karunaa mai karataa tis prabh sadhaa dhiaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Creator, the Embodiment of Mercy, bestows all comforts; meditate forever on that God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਏ ਜੰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai soot paroe ja(n)taa tis prabh kaa jas gaavahu ||
verses.translation: All creatures are strung on His Thread; sing the Praises of that God.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਆਨ ਕਹਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar Thaakur jin sabh kichh dheenaa aan kahaa peh jaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on that Lord and Master who gives you everything. Why would you go to anyone else? ||1||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: safal sevaa suaamee mere kee man baa(n)chhat fal paavahu ||
verses.translation: Service to my Lord and Master is fruitful and rewarding; from Him, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੫੦॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak laabh laahaa lai chaalahu sukh setee ghar jaavahu ||2||50||73||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, take your profits and leave; you shall go to your true home in peace. ||2||50||73||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur tum(h) saranaiee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O my Master, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: autar gio mere man kaa sa(n)saa jab te dharasan paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The anxiety of my mind departed, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anabolat meree birathaa jaanee apanaa naam japaiaa ||
verses.translation: You know my condition, without my speaking. You inspire me to chant Your Name.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਨਦ ਅਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh naaThe sukh sahaj samaae anadh anadh gun gaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: My pains are gone, and I am absorbed in peace, poise and bliss, singing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baeh pakar kadd leene apune gireh a(n)dh koop te maiaa ||
verses.translation: Taking me by the arm, You lifted me up, out of the deep dark pit of household and Maya.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੫੧॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur ba(n)dhan kaaTe bichhurat aan milaiaa ||2||51||74||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has broken my bonds, and ended my separation; He has united me with God. ||2||51||74||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kee gat Thaa(n)ddee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਕਾਢੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan simirat saadhoo jan khojat khojat kaaddee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the Holy Saints have realized this. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਅਰੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਤੌ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: siv bira(n)ch ar i(n)dhr lok taa meh jalatau firiaa ||
verses.translation: In the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra, I wandered around, burning up with envy.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee bhe seetal dhookh dharadh bhram hiriaa ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, I became cool and calm; my pains, sorrows and doubts are gone. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo tario puraatan navatan bhagat bhai har dhevaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever has been saved in the past or the present, was saved through loving devotional worship of the Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੫੨॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jeeau milai sa(n)t jan sevaa ||2||52||75||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: O Dear God, please let me serve the humble Saints. ||2||52||75||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla;

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jihave a(n)mirat gun har gaau ||
verses.translation: O my tongue, sing the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਚਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har bol kathaa sun har kee ucharahu prabh ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, listen to the Lord's Sermon, and chant God's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ratan dhan sa(n)chahu man tan laavahu bhaau ||
verses.translation: So gather in the jewel, the wealth of the Lord's Name; love God with your mind and body.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan bibhoot mithiaa kar maanahu saachaa ihai suaau ||1||
verses.translation: You must realize that all other wealth is false; this alone is the true purpose of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan mukat ko dhaataa ekas siau liv laau ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, the breath of life and liberation; lovingly tune in to the One and Only Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥੨॥੫੩॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kee saranaiee dhet sagal apiaau ||2||53||76||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have entered His Sanctuary; He gives sustenance to all. ||2||53||76||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: hotee nahee kavan kachh karanee ||
verses.translation: I cannot do anything else.

verses.original: ਇਹੈ ਓਟ ਪਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eihai oT paiee mil sa(n)teh gopaal ek kee saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have taken this Support, meeting the Saints; I have entered the Sanctuary of the One Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhokh chhidhr iaa tan meh bikhai biaadh kee karanee ||
verses.translation: The five wicked enemies are within this body; they lead the mortal to practice evil and corruption.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਅਪਾਰ ਦਿਨਸ ਗਣਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਲੁ ਜਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas apaar dhinas gan raakhe grasat jaat bal jaranee ||1||
verses.translation: He has infinite hope, but his days are numbered, and old age is sapping his strength. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: anaatheh naath dhiaal sukh saagar sarab dhokh bhai haranee ||
verses.translation: He is the Help of the helpless, the Merciful Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of all pains and fears.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੪॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: man baa(n)chhat chitavat naanak dhaas pekh jeevaa prabh charanee ||2||54||77||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak longs for this blessing, that he may live, gazing upon the Feet of God. ||2||54||77||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: feeke har ke naam bin saadh ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, flavors are tasteless and insipid.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras keeratan har gaieeaai ahinis pooran naadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Sweet Ambrosial Praises of the Lord's Kirtan; day and night, the Sound-current of the Naad will resonate and resound. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: simarat saa(n)t mahaa sukh paieeaai miT jaeh sagal bikhaadh ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, total peace and bliss are obtained, and all sorrows are taken away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵਹੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har laabh saadhasa(n)g paieeaai ghar lai aavahu laadh ||1||
verses.translation: The profit of the Lord, Har, Har, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; so load it and bring it on home. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਜਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch uooch te uoocho a(n)t nahee marajaadh ||
verses.translation: He is the Highest of all, the Highest of the high; His celestial ecomony has no limit.

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੫੫॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau naanak mahimaa pekh rahe bisamaadh ||2||55||78||
verses.translation: Nanak cannot even express His Glorious Grandeur; gazing upon Him, he is wonder-struck. ||2||55||78||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਸੁਨਨ ਪੜਨ ਕਉ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaio sunan paRan kau baanee ||
verses.translation: You've come (to this world) to hear and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam visaar lageh an laalach birathaa janam paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But he has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he has become attached to other temptations. His life is totally worthless! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਥੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: samajh achet chet man mere kathee sa(n)tan akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: O my unconscious mind, become conscious and figure it out; the Saints speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਲਾਭੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laabh laih har ridhai araadhahu chhuTakai aavan jaanee ||1||
verses.translation: So gather in your profits - worship and adore the Lord within your heart; your coming and going in reincarnation shall end. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: audham sakat siaanap tum(h)ree dheh ta naam vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: Effort, power and wisdom are provided by You. If You bless me with them, I can repeat Your Name.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੬॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: seiee bhagat bhagat se laage naanak jo prabh bhaanee ||2||56||79||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, and they alone are attached to devotional worship, O Nanak, who are pleasing to God. ||2||56||79||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhanava(n)t naam ke vanajaare ||
verses.translation: Those who deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are wealthy.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)jhee karahu naam dhan khaaTahu gur kaa sabadh veechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So become a partner with them, and earn the wealth of the Naam. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddahu kapaT hoi niravairaa so prabh sa(n)g nihaare ||
verses.translation: Abandon your deception, and go beyond vengeance; see God who is always with you.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach dhan vanajahu sach dhan sa(n)chahu kabahoo na aavahu haare ||1||
verses.translation: Deal only in this true wealth and gather in this true wealth, and you shall never suffer loss. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat kichh nikhuTat naahee aganat bhare bha(n)ddaare ||
verses.translation: Eating and consuming it, it is never exhausted; God's treasures are overflowing.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੫੭॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sobhaa sa(n)g jaavahu paarabraham kai dhuaare ||2||57||80||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, you shall go home to the Court of the Supreme Lord God with honor and respect. ||2||57||80||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee moh kavan anaath bichaaraa ||
verses.translation: O Dear God, I am wretched and helpless!

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mool te maanukh kariaa ih parataap tuhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: From what source did you create humans? This is Your Glorious Grandeur. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan sarab ke dhaate gun kahe na jaeh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of the soul and the breath of life to all; Your Infinite Glories cannot be spoken.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾਂ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh ke preetam srab pratipaalak sarab ghaTaa(n) aadhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Beloved Lord of all, the Cherisher of all, the Support of all hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: koi na jaanai tumaree gat mit aapeh ek pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: No one knows Your state and extent. You alone created the expanse of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਵ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫੮॥੮੧॥
verses.translit: saadh naav baiThaavahu naanak bhav saagar paar utaaraa ||2||58||81||
verses.translation: Please, give me a seat in the boat of the Holy; O Nanak, thus I shall cross over this terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||58||81||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavai raam saran vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: One who comes to the Lord's Sanctuary is very fortunate.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin kichh hor na jaanai avar upaav tiaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He knows of no other than the One Lord. He has renounced all other efforts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam aaraadhai har har saadhasa(n)g sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: He worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, in thought, word and deed; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds peace.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh akath kathaa ras saachai sahaj samaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He enjoys bliss and pleasure, and savors the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; he merges intuitively into the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jo apunaa keeno taa kee uootam baanee ||
verses.translation: Sublime and exalted is the speech of one whom the Lord, in His Mercy makes His Own.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੯॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak nisatareeaai jo raate prabh nirabaanee ||2||59||82||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with God in the state of Nirvaanaa, O Nanak, are emancipated in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||59||82||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te saadhoo saran gahee ||
verses.translation: Since I grasped hold of the Sanctuary of the Holy,

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj man bhio pragaasaa birathaa kachh na rahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: my mind is illuminated with tranquility, peace and poise, and I am rid of all my pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਏਹ ਕਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal naam dheh apunaa binatee eh kahee ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Lord, and bless me with Your Name; this is the prayer I offer to You.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan biauhaar bisare prabh simarat paio laabh sahee ||1||
verses.translation: I have forgotten my other occupations; remembering God in meditation, I have obtained the true profit. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਸਾਈ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh te upajio tahee samaano saiee basat ahee ||
verses.translation: We shall merge again into the One from whom we came; He is the Essence of Being.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਓ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਹੀ ॥੨॥੬੦॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bharam gur khoio jotee jot samahee ||2||60||83||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has eradicated my doubt; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||60||83||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam ko jas gaau ||
verses.translation: O my tongue, sing the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਲੋ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan suaadh bisaar sagale bhalo naam suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon all other tastes and flavors; the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is so sublime. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal basai hiradhai ek siau liv laau ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart; let yourself be lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat hoh niramal bahuR jon na aau ||1||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become immaculate and pure; you shall not come to be reincarnated again. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan adhaar teraa too nithaave thaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Support of the soul and the breath of life; You are the Home of the homeless.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥੬੧॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: saas saas sam(h)aal har har naanak sadh bal jaau ||2||61||84||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I dwell on the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||61||84||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: baiku(n)Th gobi(n)dh charan nit dhiaau ||
verses.translation: To meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe is heaven for me.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath saadhoo sa(n)gat a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and the Lord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: uootam kathaa suneejai sravanee miaa karahu bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please be kind to me, that I may hear with my ears Your Sublime and Exalted Sermon.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਪਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat dhouoo pakh pooran paieeaai sukh bisraam ||1||
verses.translation: My cycle of coming and going is finally completed, and I have attained peace and tranquility. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sodhat sodhat tat beechaario bhagat saresaT pooree ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I have realized the essence of reality: devotional worship is the most sublime fulfillment.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਊਰੀ ॥੨॥੬੨॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ik raam naam bin avar sagal bidh uooree ||2||62||85||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, without the Name of the One Lord, all other ways are imperfect. ||2||62||85||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saache satiguroo dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the True Giver.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh sagal dhukh naaseh charan kamal balihaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my pains are dispelled. I am a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat paramesar sat saadh jan nihachal har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is True, and True are the Holy Saints; the Name of the Lord is steady and stable.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhaavanee paarabraham kee abinaasee gun gaau ||1||
verses.translation: So worship the Imperishable, Supreme Lord God with love, and sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar mit nahee paieeaai sagal ghaTaa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be found; He is the Support of all hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬੩॥੮੬॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu kahu taa kau jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||2||63||86||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant, ""Waaho! Waaho!"" to Him, who has no end or limitation. ||2||63||86||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan base man merai ||
verses.translation: The Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਭ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poor rahio Thaakur sabh thaiee nikaT basai sabh nerai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places; He dwells nearby, close to all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tor raam liv laiee sa(n)tasa(n)g ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Breaking my bonds, I have lovingly tuned in to the Lord, and now the Saints are pleased with me.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਇਛਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath bhio puneetaa ichhaa sagal pujaiee ||1||
verses.translation: This precious human life has been sanctified, and all my desires have been fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau kirapaa karahu prabh mere so har kaa jas gaavai ||
verses.translation: O my God, whoever You bless with Your Mercy - he alone sings Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬੪॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gobi(n)dh gun gaavai jan naanak sadh bal jaavai ||2||64||87||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that person who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||64||87||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਉ ਗਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan tau ganeeaai har pekhaa ||
verses.translation: A person is judged to be alive, only if he sees the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa preetam manmohan for bharam kee rekhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O my Enticing Beloved Lord, and erase the record of my doubts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਸ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਖਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kahat sunat kichh saa(n)t na upajat bin bisaas kiaa sekhaa(n) ||
verses.translation: By speaking and listening, tranquility and peace are not found at all. What can anyone learn without faith?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabhoo tiaag aan jo chaahat taa kai mukh laagai kaalekhaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai raas sarab sukh suaamee aan na maanat bhekhaa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the wealth of our Lord and Master, the Embodiment of Peace, does not believe in any other religious doctrine.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੨॥੬੫॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dharas magan man mohio pooran arath bisekhaa ||2||65||88||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is fascinated and intoxicated with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan - his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||2||65||88||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: simaran raam ko ik naam ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਕਲਮਲ ਦਗਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kalamal dhagadh hoh khin a(n)tar koT dhaan isanaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this way, the sins of your past mistakes shall be burnt off in an instant. It is like giving millions in charity, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਘਾਲਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: aan ja(n)jaar birathaa sram ghaalat bin har fokaT giaan ||
verses.translation: Entangled in other affairs, the mortal suffers uselessly in sorrow. Without the Lord, wisdom is useless.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran sa(n)kaT te chhooTai jagadhees bhajan sukh dhiaan ||1||
verses.translation: The mortal is freed of the anguish of death and birth, meditating and vibrating on the Blissful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran pooran sukh saagar kar kirapaa dhevahu dhaan ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sancutary, O Perfect Lord, Ocean of Peace. Please be merciful, and bless me with this gift.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੬੬॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: simar simar naanak prabh jeevai binas jai abhimaan ||2||66||89||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, Nanak lives; his egotistical pride has been eradicated. ||2||66||89||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੂਰਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿ ਧੁਰ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoorat soiee j dhur kau laagai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Dhoorat, who is attached to the Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਧੁਰੰਧਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਸੁੰਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soiee dhura(n)dhar soiee basu(n)dhar har ek prem ras paagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Dhurandhar, and he alone is a Basundhar, who is absorbed in the sublime essence of Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਲਾਭੈ ਸੋ ਧੂਰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: balaba(n)ch karai na jaanai laabhai so dhoorat nahee mooR(h)aa ||
verses.translation: One who practices deception and does not know where true profit lies is not a Dhoorat - he is a fool.

verses.original: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਸਾਰਥਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: suaarath tiaag asaarath rachio neh simarai prabh rooRaa ||1||
verses.translation: He abandons profitable enterprises and is involved in unprofitable ones. He does not meditate on the Beauteous Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: soiee chatur siaanaa pa(n)ddit so sooraa so dhaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: He alone is clever and wise and a religious scholar, he alone is a brave warrior, and he alone is intelligent,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੬੭॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jin har har japio naanak so paravaanaa ||2||67||90||
verses.translation: who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, he alone is approved. ||2||67||90||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har sa(n)t janaa kee jeevan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is the life of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai ras bhog a(n)mirat sukh saagar raam naam ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Instead of enjoying corrupt pleasures, they drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name of the Lord, the Ocean of Peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)chan raam naam dhan ratanaa man tan bheetar seevan ||
verses.translation: They gather up the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name, and weave it into the fabric of their mind and body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਂਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਲਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਖੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raa(n)g bhe man laalaa raam naam ras kheevan ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, their minds are dyed in the deep crimson color of devotional love; they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਵਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau meenaa jal siau urajhaano raam naam sa(n)g leevan ||
verses.translation: As the fish is immersed in water, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਥੀਵਨਿ ॥੨॥੬੮॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t chaatirak kee niaaiee har boo(n)dh paan sukh theevan ||2||68||91||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are like the rainbirds; they are comforted, drinking in the drops of the Lord's Name. ||2||68||91||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naamaheen betaal ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortal is a ghost.

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੇਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa karan karaavan tetaa sabh ba(n)dhan ja(n)jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All the actions he commits are just shackles and bonds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਟੈ ਕਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: bin prabh sev karat an sevaa birathaa kaaTai kaal ||
verses.translation: Without serving God, one who serves another wastes his time uselessly.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai praanee tab tumaro kaun havaal ||1||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes to kill you, O mortal, what will your condition be then? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leh dhaas apune kau sadhaa sadhaa kirapaal ||
verses.translation: Please protect Your slave, O Eternally Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥੬੯॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: sukh nidhaan naanak prabh meraa saadhasa(n)g dhan maal ||2||69||92||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my God is the Treasure of Peace; He is the wealth and property of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||69||92||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raam ko biauhaar ||
verses.translation: My mind and body deal only in the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ਗੀਧੇ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat gun gaavan geedhe pohat neh sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with loving devotional worship, I sing His Glorious Praises; I am not affected by worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sravanee keeratan simaran suaamee ih saadh ko aachaar ||
verses.translation: This is the way of life of the Holy Saint: he listens to the Kirtan, the Praises of his Lord and Master, and meditates in remembrance on Him.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal asathit ridh a(n)tar poojaa praan ko aadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He implants the Lord's Lotus Feet deep within his heart; worship of the Lord is the support of his breath of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dheen dhiaal sunahu bena(n)tee kirapaa apanee dhaar ||
verses.translation: O God, Merciful to the meek, please hear my prayer, and shower Your Blessings upon me.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਉਚਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੭੦॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan ucharau nit rasanaa naanak sadh balihaar ||2||70||93||
verses.translation: I continually chant the treasure of the Naam with my tongue; Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||70||93||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naamaheen mat thoree ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, his intellect is shallow.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਅੰਧ ਦੁਖ ਘੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naeh sireedhar Thaakur milat a(n)dh dhukh ghoree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, his Lord and Master; the blind fool suffers in terrible agony. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam siau preet na laagee anik bhekh bahu joree ||
verses.translation: He does not embrace love for the Name of the Lord; he is totally attached to various religious robes.

verses.original: ਤੂਟਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tooTat baar na laagai taa kau jiau gaagar jal foree ||1||
verses.translation: His attachments are shattered in an instant; when the pitcher is broken, the water runs out. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa bhagat ras dheejai man khachit prem ras khoree ||
verses.translation: Please bless me, that I may worship You in loving devotion. My mind is absorbed and intoxicated with Your Delicious Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੭੧॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee prabh bin aan na horee ||2||71||94||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary; without God, there is no other at all. ||2||71||94||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਵਾ ਅਉਸਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chitavau vaa aausar man maeh ||
verses.translation: In my mind, I think about that moment,

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hoi ikatr milahu sa(n)t saajan gun gobi(n)dh nit gaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: when I join the Gathering of the Friendly Saints, constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhajan jete kaam kare'eh tete birathe jaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: Without vibrating and meditating on the Lord, whatever deeds you do will be useless.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran paramaana(n)dh man meeTho tis bin dhoosar naeh ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Embodiment of Supreme Bliss is so sweet to my mind. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam karam sukh saadhan tul na kachhooaai laeh ||
verses.translation: Chanting, deep meditation, austere self-discipline, good deeds and other techniques to being peace - they are not equal to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੭੨॥੯੫॥
verses.translit: charan kamal naanak man bedhio charaneh sa(n)g samaeh ||2||72||95||
verses.translation: Nanak's mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord; it is absorbed in His Lotus Feet. ||2||72||95||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh sa(n)ge a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: My God is always with me; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਖੇਮ ਸੂਖਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aagai kusal paachhai khem sookhaa simarat naam suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I find happiness in the world hereafter, and peace and pleasure in this world, meditating in remembrance on the Name of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet sakhaa har merai gun guopaal har raiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Best Friend, my Buddy, my Companion. I sing the Glorious Praises of my Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisar na jaiee nimakh hiradhai te poorai guroo milaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I shall not forget Him in my heart, even for an instant; I have met with the Perfect Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa raakhe dhaas apane jeea ja(n)t vas jaa kai ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; all beings and creatures are in His Power.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੨॥੭੩॥੯੬॥
verses.translit: ekaa liv pooran paramesur bhau nahee naanak taa kai ||2||73||96||
verses.translation: One who is lovingly attuned to the One, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God, O Nanak, is rid of all fear. ||2||73||96||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai raam ko bal hoi ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord's Power on his side

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooran taahoo ke dhookh na biaapai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - all his desires are fulfilled, and no pain afflicts him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan bhagat dhaas nij prabh kaa sun jeevaa(n) tis soi ||
verses.translation: That humble devotee is a slave of his God, who listens to Him, and so lives.

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕੌ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: audham karau dharasan pekhan kau karam paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: I have made the effort to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; it is obtained only by good karma. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee dhirasaT nihaarau dhoosar naahee koi ||
verses.translation: It is only by Guru's Grace that I see His Vision with my eyes which none can equal.

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥੭੪॥੯੭॥
verses.translit: dhaan dheh naanak apane kau charan jeevaa(n) sa(n)t dhoi ||2||74||97||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with this Gift, that he may wash the Feet of the Saints, and so live. ||2||74||97||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat raam ke gun gai ||
verses.translation: I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa gopaal beeThule bisar na kab hee jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please be Merciful to me, O my Loving Lord of the Universe, that I may never forget You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan dhan sabh tumaraa suaamee aan na dhoojee jai ||
verses.translation: My mind, body, wealth and all are Yours, O my Lord and Master; there is nowhere else for me at all.
