verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਪੈਨੈੑ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau too raakheh tiv hee rahanaa tum(h)raa painai(h) khai ||1||
verses.translation: As You keep me, so do I survive; I eat and I wear whatever You give me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai bal bal jaiee bahuR na janamaa dhai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I shall never again fall into reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥੭੫॥੯੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee jiau bhaavai tivai chalai ||2||75||98||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord; as it pleases Your Will, so do You guide him. ||2||75||98||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: man re naam ko sukh saar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Naam is the most sublime peace.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਕਾਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan kaam bikaar maiaa sagal dheeseh chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Other affairs of Maya are corrupt. They are nothing more than dust. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਤਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gireh a(n)dh koop patit praanee narak ghor gubaar ||
verses.translation: The mortal has fallen into the deep dark pit of household attachment; it is a horrible, dark hell.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik jonee bhramat haario bhramat baara(n) baar ||1||
verses.translation: He wanders in various incarnations, growing weary; he wanders through them again and again. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan bhagat bachhal dheen kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: O Purifier of sinners, O Lover of Your devotees, please shower Your Mercy on Your meek servant.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੬॥੯੯॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak dhaan maa(n)gai saadhasa(n)g udhaar ||2||76||99||
verses.translation: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, please save me in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||76||99||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: biraajit raam ko parataap ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Radiance of the Lord has spread out everywhere.

verses.original: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੀਨੈ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aadh biaadh upaadh sabh naasee binase teenai taap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The doubts of my mind and body are all erased, and I am rid of the three diseases. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa bujhee pooran sabh aasaa chooke sog sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: My thirst is quenched, and my hopes have all been fulfilled; my sorrows and sufferings are over.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat achut abinaasee man tan aatam dhraap ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, my mind, body and soul are comforted and encouraged. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh madh matasar saadhoo kai sa(n)g khaap ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, pride and envy are destroyed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੭੭॥੧੦੦॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhai kaaTanahaare naanak ke maiee baap ||2||77||100||
verses.translation: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; O Nanak, He is our Mother and Father. ||2||77||100||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aatur naam bin sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is miserable.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat na hovat kookaree aasaa it laago bikhiaa chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Like a dog, its desires are never satisfied; it clings to the ashes of corruption. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ਜਨਮਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: pai Thagauree aap bhulaio janamat baaro baar ||
verses.translation: Administering the intoxicating drug, God Himself leads the mortals astray; they are reincarnated again and again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kaa simaran nimakh na simario jamaka(n)kar karat khuaar ||1||
verses.translation: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death makes him suffer. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan teriaa sa(n)teh kee raavaar ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੮॥੧੦੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas dharas prabh jaachai man tan ko aadhaar ||2||78||101||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak asks for the Blessed Vision of God. It is the Support of his mind and body. ||2||78||101||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mailaa har ke naam bin jeeau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the soul is polluted.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin prabh saachai aap bhulaiaa bikhai Thagauree peeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Lord God has Himself administered the intoxicating drug of corruption, and led the mortal astray. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam bhramatau bahu bhaa(n)tee thit nahee katahoo paiee ||
verses.translation: Wandering through millions of incarnations in countless ways, he does not find stability anywhere.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur sahaj na bheTiaa saakat aavai jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic does not intuitively meet with the Perfect True Guru; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leh prabh sa(n)mrith dhaate tum prabh agam apaar ||
verses.translation: Please save me, O All-powerful Lord God, O Great Giver; O God, You are Inaccessible and Infinite.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੯॥੧੦੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee bhavajal utario paar ||2||79||102||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, to cross over the terrible world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||79||102||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਮਣ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: raman kau raam ke gun baadh ||
verses.translation: To chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord is Sublime.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g dhiaaieeaai paramesar a(n)mirat jaa ke suaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Transcendent Lord God; The taste of His essence is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: simarat ek achut abinaasee binase maiaa maadh ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the One Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, the intoxication of Maya wears off.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਅਨਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaj anadh anahadh dhun baanee bahur na bhe bikhaadh ||1||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with intuitive peace and poise, and the vibrations of the Unstruck Celestial Bani, never suffers again. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: sanakaadhik brahamaadhik gaavat gaavat suk prahilaadh ||
verses.translation: Even Brahma and his sons sing God's Praises; Sukdayv and Prahlaad sing His Praises as well.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਤ ਅਮਿਉ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੮੦॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit: peevat amiau manohar har ras jap naanak har bisamaadh ||2||80||103||
verses.translation: Drinking in the fascinating Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence, Nanak meditates on the Amazing Lord. ||2||80||103||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: keen(h)e paap ke bahu koT ||
verses.translation: He commits many millions of sins.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਥਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rainee thakat naahee kateh naahee chhoT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Day and night, he does not get tired of them, and he never finds release. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਜਰ ਬਿਖ ਬਿਆਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਠਾਈ ਪੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bajar bikh biaadhee sir uThaiee poT ||
verses.translation: He carries on his head a terrible, heavy load of sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੇ ਝੋਟ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aughar gieeaa(n) khineh bheetar jameh graase jhoT ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, he is exposed. The Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ ਉਸਟ ਗਰਧਭ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਲੇਟ ॥
verses.translit: pas paret usaT garadhabh anik jonee leT ||
verses.translation: He is consigned to countless forms of reincarnation, into beasts, ghosts, camels and donkeys.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਫੇਟ ॥੨॥੮੧॥੧੦੪॥
verses.translit: bhaj saadhasa(n)g gobi(n)dh naanak kachh na laagai feT ||2||81||104||
verses.translation: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, you shall never be struck or harmed at all. ||2||81||104||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਸੂ ਕੇ ਗਟਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe khaaveh bisoo ke gaTaak ||
verses.translation: He is so blind! He is eating loads of poison.

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਟਿਓ ਸਾਸੁ ਗਇਓ ਤਤ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nain sravan sareer sabh huTio saas gio tat ghaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His eyes, ears and body are totally exhausted; he shall lose his breath in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਰਞਾਣਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੋਖਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਗਈਆ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: anaath ran(j)aan udhar le pokheh maiaa gieeaa haaT ||
verses.translation: Making the poor suffer, he fills his belly, but the wealth of Maya shall not go with him.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kilabikh karat karat pachhutaaveh kabahu na saakeh chhaa(n)T ||1||
verses.translation: Committing sinful mistakes again and again, he regrets and repents, but he can never give them up. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਓ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਉਪਰਿ ਮਟਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak jamadhootee aai sa(n)ghaario dheveh moo(n)dd upar maTaak ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death comes to slaughter the slanderer; he beats him on his head.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਕਟਾਰੀ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਲਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਫਾਟ ॥੨॥੮੨॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit: naanak aapan kaTaaree aapas kau laiee man apanaa keeno faaT ||2||82||105||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he cuts himself with his own dagger, and damages his own mind. ||2||82||105||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਟੂਟੀ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ॥
verses.translit: TooTee ni(n)dhak kee adh beech ||
verses.translation: The slanderer is destroyed in mid-stream.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਇ ਪਹੂਚੀ ਮੀਚ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan kaa raakhaa aap suaamee bemukh kau aai pahoochee meech ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is the Saving Grace, the Protector of His humble servants; those who have turned their backs on the Guru are overtaken by death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਸ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aus kaa kahiaa koi na suniee kahee na baisan paavai ||
verses.translation: No one listens to what he says; he is not allowed to sit anywhere.

verses.original: ਈਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa(n) dhukh aagai narak bhu(n)chai bahu jonee bharamaavai ||1||
verses.translation: He suffers in pain here, and falls into hell hereafter. He wanders in endless reincarnations. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhiaa kha(n)ddee brahama(n)ddee keetaa apanaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: He has become infamous across worlds and galaxies; he receives according to what he has done.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮੩॥੧੦੬॥
verses.translit: naanak saran nirabhau karate kee anadh ma(n)gal gun gaiaa ||2||83||106||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Fearless Creator Lord; he sings His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss. ||2||83||106||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਲਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa chalat bahu parakaar ||
verses.translation: Desire plays itself out in so many ways.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਬਾਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਤੀ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hot na katahu baateh a(n)t paratee haar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But it is not fulfilled at all, and in the end, it dies, exhausted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਨ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sookh na sahaj upajai ihai is biauhaar ||
verses.translation: It does not produce tranquility, peace and poise; this is the way it works.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਹਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai kaam karodheh jaar ||1||
verses.translation: He does not know what belongs to him, and to others. He burns in sexual desire and anger. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar dhukh biaapio dhaas levahu taar ||
verses.translation: The world is enveloped by an ocean of pain; O Lord, please save Your slave!

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੪॥੧੦੭॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saranai naanak sadh sadhaa balihaar ||2||84||107||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet; Nanak is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||2||84||107||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: re paapee tai kavan kee mat leen ||
verses.translation: O sinner, who taught you to sin?

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh gharee na simar suaamee jeeau pi(n)dd jin dheen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You do not contemplate your Lord and Master, even for an instant; it was He who gave you your body and soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਵੰਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਖੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: khaat peevat sava(n)t sukheeaa naam simarat kheen ||
verses.translation: Eating, drinking and sleeping, you are happy, but contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you are miserable.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਉਦਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਹਾਂ ਹੋਵਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garabh udhar bilalaaT karataa tahaa(n) hovat dheen ||1||
verses.translation: In the womb of your mother, you cried and whined like a wretch. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਾਧਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa maadh bikaar baadhaa anik jon bhrameen ||
verses.translation: And now, bound by great pride and corruption, you shall wander in endless incarnations.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਦ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੨॥੮੫॥੧੦੮॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh bisare kavan dhukh gane'eeh sukh naanak har padh cheen(h) ||2||85||108||
verses.translation: You have forgotten the Lord of the Universe; what misery will be your lot now? O Nanak, peace is found by realizing the sublime state of the Lord. ||2||85||108||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree charaneh oT gahee ||
verses.translation: O mother, I have grasped the Protection, the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan pekh meraa man mohio dhuramat jaat bahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fascinated, and evil-mindedness is taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ageh agaadh uooch abinaasee keemat jaat na kahee ||
verses.translation: He is Unfathomable, Incomprehensible, Exalted and High, Eternal and Imperishable; His worth cannot be appraised.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal thal pekh pekh man bigasio poor rahio srab mahee ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon Him, gazing upon Him in the water and on the land, my mind has blossomed forth in ecstasy. He is totally pervading and permeating all. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal preetam manmohan mil saadheh keeno sahee ||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek, my Beloved, Enticer of my mind; meeting with the Holy, He is known.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਨ ਫਹੀ ॥੨॥੮੬॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit: simar simar jeevat har naanak jam kee bheer na fahee ||2||86||109||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak lives; the Messenger of Death cannot catch or torment him. ||2||86||109||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree man mero matavaaro ||
verses.translation: O mother, my mind is intoxicated.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਦ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਪਿਓ ਖੁਮਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekh dhiaal anadh sukh pooran har ras rapio khumaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Merciful Lord, I am filled with bliss and peace; imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, I am intoxicated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਊਜਲ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: niramal bhe uoojal jas gaavat bahur na hovat kaaro ||
verses.translation: I have become spotless and pure, singing the Sacred Praises of the Lord; I shall never again be dirtied.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਚੀ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau ddoree raachee bheTio purakh apaaro ||1||
verses.translation: My awareness is focused on the Lotus Feet of God; I have met the Infinite, Supreme Being. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene sarabas dheene dheepak bhio ujaaro ||
verses.translation: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything; He has lit up my lamp.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹਾਂ ਤਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੮੭॥੧੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rasik bairaagee kuleh samoohaa(n) taaro ||2||87||110||
verses.translation: O Nanak, savoring the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have become detached; my generations have been carried across as well. ||2||87||110||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree aan simar mar jaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: O mother, by meditating in remembrance on some other, the mortal dies.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag gobidh jeean ko dhaataa maiaa sa(n)g lapaTaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Lord of the Universe, the Giver of souls, the mortal is engrossed and entangled in Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam bisaar chaleh an maarag narak ghor meh paeh ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he walks on some other path, and falls into the most horrible hell.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਜਾਂਈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗਰਭੈ ਗਰਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik sajaa(n)iee ganat na aavai garabhai garabh bhramaeh ||1||
verses.translation: He suffers uncounted punishments, and wanders from womb to womb in reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: se dhanava(n)te se pativa(n)te har kee saran samaeh ||
verses.translation: They alone are wealthy, and they alone are honorable, who are absorbed in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨॥੮੮॥੧੧੧॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak jag jeetio bahur na aaveh jaa(n)h ||2||88||111||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they conquer the world; they do not come and go in reincarnation ever again. ||2||88||111||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਕੁਠਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaaTee kuTilataa kuThaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord has cut down the crooked tree of my deceit.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਨ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram ban dhahan bhe khin bheetar raam naam parahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The forest of doubt is burnt away in an instant, by the fire of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਆ ਕਾਢੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ni(n)dhaa parahareeaa kaadde saadhoo kai sa(n)g maar ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and slander are gone; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have beaten them and driven them out.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath gurmukh jeetiaa bahur na jooaai haar ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is successful in this priceless human life; he shall not lose it in the gamble ever again. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh ke gun gaaveh pooran sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੯॥੧੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaasan dhaas jan teraa puneh puneh namasakaar ||2||89||112||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves; over and over again, he bows in humble reverence to You. ||2||89||112||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੋਥੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pothee paramesar kaa thaan ||
verses.translation: This Holy Book is the home of the Transcendent Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g gaaveh gun gobi(n)dh pooran braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has the perfect knowledge of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh sagal mun locheh birale laagai dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas and seekers and all the silent sages long for the Lord, but those who meditate on Him are rare.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiseh kirapaal hoi meraa suaamee pooran taa ko kaam ||1||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is merciful - all his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ridhai vasai bhai bha(n)jan tis jaanai sagal jahaan ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, knows the whole world.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੯੦॥੧੧੩॥
verses.translit: khin pal bisar nahee mere karate ih naanak maa(n)gai dhaan ||2||90||113||
verses.translation: May I never forget You, even for an instant, O my Creator Lord; Nanak begs for this blessing. ||2||90||113||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੂਠਾ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vooThaa sarab thaiee meh ||
verses.translation: The rain has fallen everywhere.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal gaau har jas pooran pragaTio neh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Singing the Lord's Praises with ecstasy and bliss, the Perfect Lord is revealed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਊਨ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis jal nidh uoon thaau na keh ||
verses.translation: On all four sides and in the ten directions, the Lord is an ocean. There is no place where He does not exist.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidh gobi(n)dh pooran jeea dhaan sabh dheh ||1||
verses.translation: O Perfect Lord God, Ocean of Mercy, You bless all with the gift of the soul. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat har sat suaamee sat saadhasa(n)geh ||
verses.translation: True, True, True is my Lord and Master; True is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਭਰਮੇਹੁ ॥੨॥੯੧॥੧੧੪॥
verses.translit: sat te jan jin parateet upajee naanak neh bharameh ||2||91||114||
verses.translation: True are those humble beings, within whom faith wells up; O Nanak, they are not deluded by doubt. ||2||91||114||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh jeeau too mere praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, You are the Support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet sahaiee tum hee too mero paravaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Best Friend and Companion, my Help and Support; You are my family. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar masatak dhaario merai maathai saadhasa(n)g gun gaae ||
verses.translation: You placed Your Hand on my forehead; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree kirapaa te sabh fal paae rasak raam naam dhiaae ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I have obtained all fruits and rewards; I meditate on the Lord's Name with delight. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: abichal neev dharaiee satigur kabahoo ddolat naahee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has laid the eternal foundation; it shall never be shaken.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥੯੨॥੧੧੫॥
verses.translit: gur naanak jab bhe dhiaaraa sarab sukhaa nidh paa(n)hee ||2||92||115||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak has become merciful to me, and I have been blessed with the treasure of absolute peace. ||2||92||115||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਪ ॥
verses.translit: nibahee naam kee sach khep ||
verses.translation: Only the true merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, stays with you.

verses.original: ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਲੇਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laabh har gun gai nidh dhan bikhai maeh alep ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of wealth, and earn your profit; in the midst of corruption, remain untouched. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sagal sa(n)tokhe aapanaa prabh dhiaai ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures find contentment, meditating on their God.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ratan janam apaar jeetio bahuR jon na pai ||1||
verses.translation: The priceless jewel of infinite worth, this human life, is won, and they are not consigned to reincarnation ever again. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal dhiaal gobidh bhiaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe shows His kindness and compassion, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈ ਲਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥੯੩॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit: har charan raas naanak paiee lagaa prabh siau ra(n)g ||2||93||116||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he is imbued with the Love of God. ||2||93||116||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree pekh rahee bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: O mother, I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh dhunee meraa man mohio acharaj taa ke savaiaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is enticed by the unstruck celestial melody; its flavor is amazing! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਅਹਿਲਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa ba(n)dhap hai soiee man har ko ahilaadh ||
verses.translation: He is my Mother, Father and Relative. My mind delights in the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਮਾਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g gaae gun gobi(n)dh binasio sabh paramaadh ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my illusions are dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਡੋਰੀ ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਖਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: ddoree lapaT rahee charaneh sa(n)g bhram bhai sagale khaadh ||
verses.translation: I am lovingly attached to His Lotus Feet; my doubt and fear are totally consumed.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੯੪॥੧੧੭॥
verses.translit: ek adhaar naanak jan keeaa bahur na jon bhramaadh ||2||94||117||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has taken the Support of the One Lord. He shall not wander in reincarnation ever again. ||2||94||117||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮੂਹ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree maatee charan samooh ||
verses.translation: O mother, I am totally intoxicated with the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਸਭ ਲੂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin hau aan na jaanau dhuteeaa bhaau sabh looh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I know of none other than the Lord. I have totally burnt off my sense of duality. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਅਵਰ ਜੋ ਕਰਣਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਖੂਹ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag guopaal avar jo karanaa te bikhiaa ke khooh ||
verses.translation: To abandon the Lord of the World, and become involved with anything else, is to fall into the pit of corruption.

verses.original: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਕਾਢੀ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਧੂਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharas piaas meraa man mohio kaaddee narak te dhooh ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is enticed, thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. He has lifted me up and out of hell. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੂਹ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh milio sukhadhaataa binasee haumai hooh ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met the Lord, the Giver of peace; the noise of egotism has been stilled.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੂਹ ॥੨॥੯੫॥੧੧੮॥
verses.translit: raam ra(n)g raate dhaas naanak maulio man tan jooh ||2||95||118||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord; the forests of his mind and body have blossomed forth. ||2||95||118||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਚ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: binase kaach ke biauhaar ||
verses.translation: The false dealings are finished.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhaj mil saadhasa(n)gat ihai jag meh saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord. This is the most excellent thing in the world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਡੋਲਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot na ddol katahoo naam hiradhai dhaar ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, you shall never waver; enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਾਗੀ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur charan bohith milio bhaagee utario sa(n)saar ||1||
verses.translation: The boat of the Guru's Feet is found by great good fortune; it shall carry you across the world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਥ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal poor rahio sarab naath apaar ||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord is totally permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਰ ॥੨॥੯੬॥੧੧੯॥
verses.translit: har naam a(n)mrit peeau naanak aan ras sabh khaar ||2||96||119||
verses.translation: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, all other tastes are bitter. ||2||96||119||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: taa te karan palaeh kare ||
verses.translation: You whine and cry

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੌ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikaar moh madh maatau simarat naeh hare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - you are intoxicated with the great corruption of attachment and pride, but you do not remember the Lord in meditation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਜਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g japate naarain tin ke dhokh jare ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy - the guilt of their minstakes is burnt away.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਜਨਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: safal dheh dha(n)n oi janame prabh kai sa(n)g rale ||1||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the body, and blessed is the birth of those who merge with God. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT dhasaa sidh sabh uoopar saadh bhale ||
verses.translation: The four great blessings, and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers - above all these are the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਲੇ ॥੨॥੯੭॥੧੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas dhoor jan baa(n)chhai udhareh laag pale ||2||97||120||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the humble; attached to the hem of His robe, he is saved. ||2||97||120||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਕਾਂਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam ke jan kaa(n)khee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants yearn for the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਏਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਬ ਆਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bachan ehee sukh chaahat prabh dharas dhekheh kab aakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In thought, word and deed, they long for this peace, to gaze with their eyes upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: too bea(n)t paarabraham suaamee gat teree jai na laakhee ||
verses.translation: You are Endless, O God, my Supreme Lord and Master; Your state cannot be known.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal preet man bedhiaa kar sarabas a(n)tar raakhee ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Love of Your Lotus Feet; this is everything to me - I enshrine it deep within my being. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan simirat saadhoo jan ieh baanee rasanaa bhaakhee ||
verses.translation: In the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the humble and the Holy chant this Bani with their tongues.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੨॥੯੮॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit: jap raam naam naanak nisatareeaai hor dhuteeaa birathee saakhee ||2||98||121||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, O Nanak, I am emancipated; other teachings of duality are useless. ||2||98||121||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਮਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: maakhee raam kee too maakhee ||
verses.translation: A fly! You are just a fly, created by the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਦ ਚਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhuraga(n)dh tahaa too baiseh mahaa bikhiaa madh chaakhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever it stinks, you land there; you suck in the most toxic stench. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਤਹਿ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਤੂ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖੀ ਆਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiteh asathaan too Tikan na paaveh ieh bidh dhekhee aakhee ||
verses.translation: You don't stay put anywhere; I have seen this with my eyes.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਛਾਡਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਪਰੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀ ਪਾਖੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa bin tai koi na chhaaddiaa sa(n)t pare gobidh kee paakhee ||1||
verses.translation: You have not spared anyone, except the Saints - the Saints are on the side of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਤੈ ਮੋਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sagale tai mohe bin sa(n)taa kinai na laakhee ||
verses.translation: You have enticed all beings and creatures; no one knows You, except the Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੨॥੯੯॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas har keeratan raataa sabadh surat sach saakhee ||2||99||122||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. Focusing his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, he realizes the Presence of the True Lord. ||2||99||122||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree kaaTee jam kee faas ||
verses.translation: O mother, the noose of Death has been cut away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਬੀਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har japat sarab sukh paae beeche grasat udhaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total peace. I remain unattached in the midst of my household. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa leene kar apune upajee dharas piaas ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He has made me His Own. The thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan wells up within me.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee dhuteeaa aas ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I have given up other hopes. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅਟਵੀ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa udhiaan aTavee te kaadde maarag sa(n)t kahio ||
verses.translation: The Saint has pulled me out of the utterly desolate wilderness, and shown me the path.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੦੦॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit: dhekhat dharas paap sabh naase har naanak ratan lahio ||2||100||123||
verses.translation: Gazing upon His Darshan, all sins are taken away; Nanak is blessed with the jewel of the Lord. ||2||100||123||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਅਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiee ree ario prem kee khor ||
verses.translation: O mother, I am involved with the Love of the Lord;

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਰੁਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan ruchit piaas man su(n)dhar sakat na koiee tor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am intoxicated with it. My mind has such a longing and thirst for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Beauteous Lord. No one can break this. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਪਤਿ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਧਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: praan maan pat pit sut ba(n)dhap har sarabas dhan mor ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my breath of life, honor, spouse, parent, child, relative, wealth - everything.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਸਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhirag sareer asat bisaTaa kiram bin har jaanat hor ||1||
verses.translation: Cursed is this body of bones, this pile of maggots and manure, if it knows any other than the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਜੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan paraa poorabalaa jor ||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, by the power of the karma of my past actions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੦੧॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saran kirapaa nidh saagar binasio aan nihor ||2||101||124||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Treasure, the Ocean of Mercy; my subservience to others is past. ||2||101||124||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: neekee raam kee dhun soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord's melody is noble and sublime.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal anoop suaamee japat saadhoo hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master are incomparably beautiful. Meditating on them, one becomes Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਕਢੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chitavataa gopaal dharasan kalamalaa kadd dhoi ||
verses.translation: Just by thinking of the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Lord of the World, the dirty sins are washed away.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਾਡੇ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran bikaar a(n)kur har kaaT chhaadde khoi ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord cuts down and weeds out the corruption of the cycle of birth and death. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: paraa poorab jiseh likhiaa biralaa paae koi ||
verses.translation: How rare is that person who has such pre-ordained destiny, to find the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਜੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੦੨॥੧੨੫॥
verses.translit: ravan gun gopaal karate naanakaa sach joi ||2||102||125||
verses.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, this is Truth. ||2||102||125||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kee mat saar ||
verses.translation: The intellect of one who dwells on the Name of the Lord is excellent.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੁ ਆਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਮਿਥਨ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisaar ju aan raacheh mithan sabh bisathaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Lord and becomes involved with some other - all his showy pretensions are false. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਪ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gam bhaj suaamee paap hovat khaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate, vibrate on our Lord and Master in the Company of the Holy, and your sins shall be eradicated.

verses.original: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charanaarabi(n)dh basai hiradhai bahur janam na maar ||1||
verses.translation: When the Lord's Lotus Feet abide within the heart, the mortal is never again caught in the cycle of death and birth. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar anugreh raakh leene ek naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: He showers us with His kindness and compassion; He saves and protects those who take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੦੩॥੧੨੬॥
verses.translit: dhin rain simarat sadhaa naanak mukh uoojal dharabaar ||2||103||126||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, day and night, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||103||126||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanee too(n) raam kai dhar maanee ||
verses.translation: Honored - you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਸਭ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee sabh abhimaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; your egotistical pride will be totally dispelled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu apanee kar leenee gurmukh poor giaanee ||
verses.translation: Showering His kindness and compassion, He shall make you His Own. As Gurmukh, your spiritual wisdom shall be perfect.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh aana(n)dh ghanere Thaakur dharas dhiaanee ||1||
verses.translation: All peace and all sorts of ecstasy are obtained, by meditating on the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT varatan saa sadhaa suhaagan dheh dhis saiee jaanee ||
verses.translation: She who dwells close to her Lord is always the pure, happy soul-bride; she is famous in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧੦੪॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit: pria ra(n)g ra(n)g ratee naarain naanak tis kurabaanee ||2||104||127||
verses.translation: She is imbued with the Love of her Loving Beloved Lord; Nanak is a sacrifice to her. ||2||104||127||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਆਸਰੋ ਈਸ ॥
verses.translit: tua charan aasaro iees ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ਸਾਕੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਤੁਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tumeh pachhaanoo saak tumeh sa(n)g raakhanahaar tumai jagadhees || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Best Friend and Companion; I am with You. You are our Protector, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: too hamaro ham tumare kaheeaai it ut tum hee raakhe ||
verses.translation: You are mine, and I am Yours; here and hereafter, You are my Saving Grace.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too bea(n)t apara(n)par suaamee gur kirapaa koiee laakhai ||1||
verses.translation: You are Endess and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; by Guru's Grace, a few understand. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਕਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin bakane bin kahan kahaavan a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
verses.translation: Without being spoken, without being told, You know all, O Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit: jaa kau mel le prabh naanak se jan dharageh maane ||2||105||128||
verses.translation: One whom God unites with Himself, O Nanak, that humble being is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||105||128||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਆਨ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaj aan karam bikaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord; other actions are corrupt.

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan moh na bujhat tirasanaa kaal gras sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Pride, attachment and desire are not quenched; the world is in the grip of death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ ਹਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਤੀ ਅਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: khaat peevat hasat sovat aaudh bitee asaar ||
verses.translation: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, life passes uselessly.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਉਦਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਜਲਤੋ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: narak udhar bhrama(n)t jalato jameh keenee saar ||1||
verses.translation: The mortal wanders in reincarnation, burning in the hellish environment of the womb; in the end, he is destroyed by death. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਰਤ ਕਰ ਝਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: par dhroh karat bikaar ni(n)dhaa paap rat kar jhaar ||
verses.translation: He practices fraud, cruelty and slander against others; he sins, and washes his hands.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾਂ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binaa satigur boojh naahee tam moh mahaa(n) a(n)dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, he has no understanding; he is lost in the utter darkness of anger and attachment. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਮੂਠੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bikh Thagauree khai mooTho chit na sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: He takes the intoxicating drugs of cruelty and corruption, and is plundered. He is not conscious of the Creator Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਆਰੋ ਮਾਤੰਗ ਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gupat hoi rahio niaaro maata(n)g mat aha(n)kaar ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is hidden and unattached. The mortal is like a wild elephant, intoxicated with the wine of egotism. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh sa(n)t raakhe charan kamal adhaar ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God saves His Saints; they have the Support of His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit: kar jor naanak saran aaio guopaal purakh apaar ||4||1||129||
verses.translation: With his palms pressed together, Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Primal Being, the Infinite Lord God. ||4||1||129||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa paRataal
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਮੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: subh bachan bol gun amol ||
verses.translation: Chant His Sublime Word and His Priceless Glories.

verses.original: ਕਿੰਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ki(n)karee bikaar ||
verses.translation: Why are you indulging in corrupt actions?

verses.original: ਦੇਖੁ ਰੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh ree beechaar ||
verses.translation: Look at this, see and understand!

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh dhiaai mahal pai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਤੀ ਮਹਾ ਕੇਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g ra(n)g karatee mahaa kel ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, you shall totally play with Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨ ਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: supan ree sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The world is a dream.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਨੀ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mithanee bisathaar ||
verses.translation: Its expanse is false.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੇਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sakhee kai moh mohilee pria preet ridhai mel ||1||
verses.translation: O my companion, why are you so enticed by the Enticer? Enshrine the Love of Your Beloved within your heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab ree preet piaar ||
verses.translation: He is total love and affection.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੀ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sadhaa ree dhiaar ||
verses.translation: God is always merciful.

verses.original: ਕਾਂਏਂ ਆਨ ਆਨ ਰੁਚੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)e(n) aan aan rucheeaai ||
verses.translation: Others - why are you involved with others?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਚੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g sa(n)g khacheeaai ||
verses.translation: Remain involved with the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jau saadhasa(n)g paae ||
verses.translation: When you join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har dhiaae ||
verses.translation: says Nanak, meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਰਹੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਮੇਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
verses.translit: ab rahe jameh mel ||2||1||130||
verses.translation: Now, your association with death is ended. ||2||1||130||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਦਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chanaa bahu dhat karaa ||
verses.translation: You may make donations of gold,

verses.original: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhoom dhaan arap dharaa ||
verses.translation: and give away land in charity

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਤ ॥
verses.translit: man anik soch pavitr karat ||
verses.translation: and purify your mind in various ways,

verses.original: ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naahee re naam tul man charan kamal laage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: but none of this is equal to the Lord's Name. Remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਹਵ ਭਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar bedh jihav bhane ||
verses.translation: You may recite the four Vedas with your tongue,

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਖਸਟ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhas asaT khasaT sravan sune ||
verses.translation: and listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the six Shaastras with your ears,

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: nahee tul gobidh naam dhune ||
verses.translation: but these are not equal to the celestial melody of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man charan kamal laage ||1||
verses.translation: Remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਤ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੋਚ ਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: barat sa(n)dh soch chaar ||
verses.translation: You may observe fasts, and say your prayers, purify yourself

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਕੁੰਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kiraa ku(n)T niraahaar ||
verses.translation: and do good deeds; you may go on pilgrimages everywhere and eat nothing at all.

verses.original: ਅਪਰਸ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਕਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aparas karat paakasaar ||
verses.translation: You may cook your food without touching anyone;

verses.original: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: nivalee karam bahu bisathaar ||
verses.translation: you may make a great show of cleansing techniques,

verses.original: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoop dheep karate har naam tul na laage ||
verses.translation: and burn incense and devotional lamps, but none of these are equal to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਦਇਆਰ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam dhiaar sun dheen benatee ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, please hear the prayer of the meek and the poor.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨੈਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਸਟ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas nain pekhau jan naanak naam misaT laage ||2||2||131||
verses.translation: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I may see You with my eyes. The Naam is so sweet to servant Nanak. ||2||2||131||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam raam jaap ramat raam sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam. The Lord is your Help and Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਲਬਧਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai charan laage kaam karodh lobh tiaage gur gopaal bhe kirapaal labadh apanee paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, I have abandoned sexual desire, anger and greed. The Guru, the Lord of the World, has been kind to me, and I have realized my destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: binase bhram moh a(n)dh TooTe maiaa ke ba(n)dh pooran sarabatr Thaakur neh kouoo bairaiee ||
verses.translation: My doubts and attachments have been dispelled, and the blinding bonds of Maya have been broken. My Lord and Master is pervading and permeating everywhere; no one is an enemy.

verses.original: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
verses.translit: suaamee suprasa(n)n bhe janam maran dhokh ge sa(n)tan kai charan laag naanak gun gaiee ||2||3||132||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is totally satisfied with me; He has rid me of the pains of death and birth. Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||132||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har hare har mukhahu bol har hare man dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, within your mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: sravan sunan bhagat karan anik paatik punahacharan ||
verses.translation: Hear Him with your ears, and practice devotional worship - these are good deeds, which make up for past evils.

verses.original: ਸਰਨ ਪਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਨ ਬਾਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran paran saadhoo aan baan bisaare ||1||
verses.translation: So seek the Sanctuary of the Holy, and forget all your other habits. ||1||.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤਿ ਪਾਵਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har charan preet neet neet paavanaa meh mahaa puneet ||
verses.translation: Love the Lord's Feet, continually and continuously - the most sacred and sanctified.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਲਿਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak bhai dhoor karan kalimal dhokh jaare ||
verses.translation: Fear is taken away from the servant of the Lord, and the dirty sins and mistakes of the past are burnt away.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਰਹਤ ਜਨਮ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat mukat sunat mukat rahat janam rahate ||
verses.translation: Those who speak are liberated, and those who listen are liberated; those who keep the Rehit, the Code of Conduct, are not reincarnated again.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
verses.translit: raam raam saar bhoot naanak tat beechaare ||2||4||133||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the most sublime essence; Nanak contemplates the nature of reality. ||2||4||133||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam bhagat maag sa(n)t tiaag sagal kaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I beg for devotion to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I have forsaken all other activities. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: preet lai har dhiaai gun guobi(n)dh sadhaa gai ||
verses.translation: Meditate lovingly on the Lord, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੁ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jan kee ren baa(n)chh dhainahaar suaamee ||1||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant, O Great Giver, my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਨਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kusal sukh bisraam aanadhaa aana(n)dh naam jam kee kachh naeh traas simar a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the ultimate ecstasy, bliss, happiness, peace and tranquility. The fear is death is dispelled by meditating in remembrance on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: ek saran gobi(n)dh charan sa(n)saar sagal taap haran ||
verses.translation: Only the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Lord of the Universe can destroy all the suffering of the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
verses.translit: naav roop saadhasa(n)g naanak paaragaraamee ||2||5||134||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the boat, O Nanak, to carry us across to the other side. ||2||5||134||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਲਾਲ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun laal gaavau gur dhekhe ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon my Guru, I sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਏਕੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਗ ਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)chaa te ek chhooTaa jau saadhasa(n)g pag rau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I escape from the five thieves, and I find the One, when I join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਉ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaTau kachh sa(n)g na jai maan tiaag mohaa ||
verses.translation: Nothing of the visible world shall go along with you; abandon your pride and attachment.

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekai har preet lai mil saadhasa(n)g sohaa ||1||
verses.translation: Love the One Lord, and join the Saadh Sangat, and you shall be embellished and exalted. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paio hai gun nidhaan sagal aas pooree ||
verses.translation: I have found the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence; all my hopes have been fulfilled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
verses.translit: naanak man ana(n)dh bhe gur bikham gaarh toree ||2||6||135||
verses.translation: Nanak's mind is in ecstasy; the Guru has shattered the impregnable fortress. ||2||6||135||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਰਾਗੈਗੀ ॥ ਖੋਜਤੀ ਦਰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man biraagaigee || khojatee dharasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is neutral and detached; I seek only the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)tan sev kai priau heearai dhiaaio ||
verses.translation: Serving the Holy Saints, I meditate on my Beloved within my heart.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh roopee pekh kai hau mahal paavaugee ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Embodiment of Ecstasy, I rise to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਉਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karee sabh tiaag kai hau saran paraugee ||
verses.translation: I work for Him; I have forsaken everything else. I seek only His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੩੬॥
verses.translit: naanak suaamee gar mile hau gur manaavaugee ||2||7||136||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace; the Guru is pleased and satisfied with me. ||2||7||136||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee hoi paree ||
verses.translation: This is my condition.

verses.original: ਜਾਨਤੇ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaanate dhiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only my Merciful Lord knows it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤਰ ਪਿਤਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: maatar pitar tiaag kai man sa(n)tan paeh bechaio ||
verses.translation: I have abandoned my mother and father, and sold my mind to the Saints.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੁਲ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaat janam kul khoieeaai hau gaavau har haree ||1||
verses.translation: I have lost my social status, birth-right and ancestry; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਲੋਕ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: lok kuTa(n)b te TooTeeaai prabh kirat kirat karee ||
verses.translation: I have broken away from other people and family; I work only for God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩੭॥
verses.translit: gur mo kau upadhesiaa naanak sev ek haree ||2||8||137||
verses.translation: The Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to serve only the One Lord. ||2||8||137||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: laal laal mohan gopaal too ||
verses.translation: You are my Loving Beloved Enticing Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਾਖਾਣ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: keeT hasat paakhaan ja(n)t sarab mai pratipaal too ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are in worms, elephants, stones and all beings and creatures; You nourish and cherish them all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: neh dhoor poor hajoor sa(n)ge ||
verses.translation: You are not far away; You are totally present with all.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਸਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar rasaal too ||1||
verses.translation: You are Beautiful, the Source of Nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਨਹ ਕੁਲਹ ਕੁਲ ॥
verses.translit: neh baran baran neh kuleh kul ||
verses.translation: You have no caste or social class, no ancestry or family.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਤੂ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩੮॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh kirapaal too ||2||9||138||
verses.translation: Nanak: God, You are Merciful. ||2||9||138||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਕੇਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਮੇਲ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੂਰ ਮੋਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: karat kel bikhai mel cha(n)dhr soor mohe ||
verses.translation: Acting and play-acting, the mortal sinks into corruption. Even the moon and the sun are enticed and bewitched.

verses.original: ਉਪਜਤਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਨਉਪਰੀ ਝੁਨੰਤਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਅਨਿਗ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਧੋਹੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aupajataa bikaar dhu(n)dhar nauparee jhuna(n)takaar su(n)dhar anig bhaau karat firat bin gopaal dhohe || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The disturbing noise of corruption wells up, in the tinkling ankle bells of Maya the beautiful. With her beguiling gestures of love, she seduces everyone except the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਉਨੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਰਹੀ ਕਾਚ ਕਰਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਸਹੀ ਉਨਮਤ ਅੰਧ ਧੰਧ ਰਚਿਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਹੋਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teen bhaune lapaTai rahee kaach karam na jaat sahee unamat a(n)dh dha(n)dh rachit jaise mahaa saagar hohe ||1||
verses.translation: Maya clings to the three worlds; those who are stuck in wrong actions cannot escape her. Drunk and engrossed in blind worldly affairs, they are tossed about on the mighty ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੩੯॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੫॥
verses.translit: audhare har sa(n)t dhaas kaaT dheenee jam kee faas patit paavan naam jaa ko simar naanak ohe ||2||10||139||3||13||155||
verses.translation: The Saint, the slave of the Lord is saved; the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; O Nanak, remember Him in meditation. ||2||10||139||3||13||155||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: raag saara(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Saarang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bin tero ko na sahaiee ||
verses.translation: No one will be your help and support, except the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਂ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n) kee maat pitaa sut banitaa ko kaahoo ko bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Who has any mother, father, child or spouse? Who is anyone's brother or sister? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਰੀ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dharanee ar sa(n)pat sagaree jo maanio apanaiee ||
verses.translation: All the wealth, land and property which you consider your own

verses.original: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਕਹਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tan chhooTai kachh sa(n)g na chaalai kahaa taeh lapaTaiee ||1||
verses.translation: - when you leave your body, none of it shall go along with you. Why do you cling to them? ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨ ਬਢਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal sadhaa dhukh bha(n)jan taa siau ruch na baddaiee ||
verses.translation: God is Merciful to the meek, forever the Destroyer of fear, and yet you do not develop any loving relationship with Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਜਗਤ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat jagat sabh mithiaa jiau supanaa rainaiee ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the whole world is totally false; it is like a dream in the night. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa man bikhiaa siau lapaTaahee ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why are you engrossed in corruption?

verses.original: ਯਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: yaa jag meh kouoo rahan na paavai ik aaveh ik jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one is allowed to remain in this world; one comes, and another departs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਂ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਾਂ ਕੀ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n) ko tan dhan sa(n)pat kaa(n) kee kaa siau neh lagaahee ||
verses.translation: Who has a body? Who has wealth and property? With whom should we fall in love?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so sagal binaasai jiau baadhar kee chhaahee ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen, shall all disappear, like the shade of a passing cloud. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਗਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan saran sa(n)tan gahu mukat hoh chhin maahee ||
verses.translation: Abandon egotism, and grasp the Sanctuary of the Saints; you shall be liberated in an instant.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagava(n)t bhajan bin sukh supanai bhee naahee ||2||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, without meditating and vibrating on the Lord God, there is no peace, even in dreams. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਨਰ ਅਪਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa nar apano janam gavaavai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why have you wasted your life?

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh bikhiaa ras rachio raam saran nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with Maya and its riches, involved in corrupt pleasures, you have not sought the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਸੁਪਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਾ ਲੋਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih sa(n)saar sagal hai supano dhekh kahaa lobhaavai ||
verses.translation: This whole world is just a dream; why does seeing it fill you with greed?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo upajai so sagal binaasai rahan na kouoo paavai ||1||
verses.translation: Everything that has been created will be destroyed; nothing will remain. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa tan saacho kar maanio ieh bidh aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
verses.translation: You see this false body as true; in this way, you have placed yourself in bondage.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak souoo jan mukataa raam bhajan chit laavai ||2||3||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, he is a liberated being, whose consciousness lovingly vibrates, and meditates on the Lord. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: man kar kabahoo na har gun gaio ||
verses.translation: In my mind, I never sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪਨੋ ਭਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur keeno apano bhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I remained under the influence of corruption, night and day; I did whatever I pleased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਨਨਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes sunio neh kaanan par dhaaraa lapaTaio ||
verses.translation: I never listened to the Guru's Teachings; I was entangled with others' spouses.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਮਝਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਮਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa kaaran bahu dhaavat samajhio neh samajhaio ||1||
verses.translation: I ran all around slandering others; I was taught, but I never learned. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa kahau mai apunee karanee jeh bidh janam gavaio ||
verses.translation: How can I even describe my actions? This is how I wasted my life.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਅਉਗਨ ਮੋ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੩੯॥੪॥੧੫੯॥
verses.translit: keh naanak sabh aaugan mo meh raakh leh saranaio ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am totally filled with faults. I have come to Your Sanctuary - please save me, O Lord! ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag saarag asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Saarang, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kiau jeevaa meree maiee ||
verses.translation: O my mother, how can I live without the Supreme Soul?

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jai jagadhees teraa jas jaachau mai har bin rahan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hail to the Lord of the Universe. I ask to sing Your Praises; without You, O Lord, I cannot even survive. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kee piaas piaasee kaaman dhekhau rain sabaiee ||
verses.translation: I am thirsty, thirsty for the Lord; the soul-bride gazes upon Him all through the night.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sreedhar naath meraa man leenaa prabh jaanai peer paraiee ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is absorbed into the Lord, my Lord and Master. Only God knows the pain of another. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਪੀਰ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: ganat sareer peer hai har bin gur sabadhee har paa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: My body suffers in pain, without the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I find the Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau har siau rahaa(n) samaiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind and compassionate to me, that I might remain merged in You, O Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee ravat ravahu man mere har charanee chit laiee ||
verses.translation: Follow such a path, O my conscious mind, that you may remain focused on the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bisam bhe gun gai manohar nirabhau sahaj samaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I am wonder-struck, singing the Glorious Praises of my Fascinating Lord; I am intuitively absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam sadhaa dhun nihachal ghaTai na keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: That heart, in which the Eternal, Unchanging Naam vibrates and resounds, does not diminish, and cannot be evaluated.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh koiee niradhan satigur boojh bujhaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Name, everyone is poor; the True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: preetam praan bhe sun sajanee dhoot mue bikh khaiee ||
