verses.translation: My Beloved is my breath of life - listen, O my companion. The demons have taken poison and died.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਬ ਕੀ ਤੈਸੀ ਰੰਗੁਲ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jab kee upajee tab kee taisee ra(n)gul bhiee man bhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: As love for Him welled up, so it remains. My mind is imbued with His Love. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh sadhaa liv har siau jeevaa(n) har gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: I am absorbed in celestial samaadhi, lovingly attached to the Lord forever. I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rataa bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee ||6||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have become detached from the world. In the profound primal trance, I dwell within the home of my own inner being. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੁਧ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਸਾਂਈਂ ॥
verses.translit: sudh ras naam mahaa ras meeThaa nij ghar tat gusaa(n)iee(n) ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is sublimely sweet and supremely delicious; within the home of my own self, I understand the essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਹ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: teh hee man jeh hee tai raakhiaa aaisee gurmat paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Wherever You keep my mind, there it is. This is what the Guru has taught me. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਨਕ ਸਨਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sanak sanaadh brahamaadh i(n)dhraadhik bhagat rate ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Sanak and Sanandan, Brahma and Indra, were imbued with devotional worship, and came to be in harmony with Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har bin gharee na jeevaa(n) har kaa naam vaddaiee ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. The Name of the Lord is glorious and great. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kiau dheerai man meraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, how can my mind be comforted?

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲਪ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT kalap ke dhookh binaasan saach dhiraRai niberaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The guilt and sin of millions of ages is erased, and one is released from the cycle of reincarnation, when the Truth is implanted within. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਜਲੇ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਉ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: karodh nivaar jale hau mamataa prem sadhaa nau ra(n)gee ||
verses.translation: Anger is gone, egotism and attachment have been burnt away; I am imbued with His ever-fresh Love.

verses.original: ਅਨਭਉ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anabhau bisar ge prabh jaachiaa har niramail sa(n)gee ||1||
verses.translation: Other fears are forgotten, begging at God's Door. The Immaculate Lord is my Companion. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal mat tiaag bhau bha(n)jan paiaa ek sabadh liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Forsaking my fickle intellect, I have found God, the Destroyer of fear; I am lovingly attuned to the One Word, the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakh tirakhaa nivaaree har mel le baddabhaagee ||2||
verses.translation: Tasting the sublime essence of the Lord, my thirst is quenched; by great good fortune, the Lord has united me with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਭਰਤ ਸਿੰਚਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: abharat si(n)ch bhe subhar sar gurmat saach nihaalaa ||
verses.translation: The empty tank has been filled to overflowing. Following the Guru's Teachings, I am enraptured with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man rat naam rate nihakeval aadh jugaadh dhiaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with love for the Naam. The Immaculate Lord is merciful, from the beginning of time, and througout the ages. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: mohan moh leeaa man moraa baddai bhaag liv laagee ||
verses.translation: My mind is fascinated with the Fascinating Lord. By great good fortune, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saach beechaar kilavikh dhukh kaaTe man niramal anaraagee ||4||
verses.translation: Contemplating the True Lord, all the resides of sins and mistakes are wiped away. My mind is pure and immaculate in His Love. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer saagar ratanaagar avar nahee an poojaa ||
verses.translation: God is the Deep and Unfathomable Ocean, the Source of all jewels; no other is worthy of worship.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabadh beechaar bharam bhau bha(n)jan avar na jaaniaa dhoojaa ||5||
verses.translation: I contemplate the Shabad, the Destroyer of doubt and fear; I do not know any other at all. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa maar niramal padh cheeniaa har ras rate adhikaiee ||
verses.translation: Subduing my mind, I have realized the pure status; I am totally imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa(n) satigur boojh bujhaiee ||6||
verses.translation: I do not know any other except the Lord. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar anaath ajonee gurmat eko jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Unmastered and Unborn; through the Guru's Teachings, I know the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: subhar bhare naahee chit ddolai man hee te man maaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Filled to overflowing, my consciousness does not waver; through the Mind, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਕਥਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee akathau katheeaai kahau kahaavai soiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken; I speak what He makes me speak.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dheen dhiaal hamaare avar na jaaniaa koiee ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Lord is Merciful to the meek; I do not know any other at all. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har kai naam vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is glorious and great.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin avar na jaanaa koiee har kai naam mukat gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I know of none, other than the Lord; through the Lord's Name, I have attained liberation and emancipation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh bhau bha(n)jan jamakaal nikha(n)jan har setee liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly attuned to the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa gurmukh jaataa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have realized the Lord, the Giver of peace; I remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa(n) kaa bhojan har naam nira(n)jan pain(h)n bhagat baddaiee ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Name of the Lord is the food of His devotees; they wear the glory of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa sadhaa har sevan har dhar sobhaa paiee ||2||
verses.translation: They abide in the home of their inner beings, and they serve the Lord forever; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh budh kaachee manooaa ddolai akath na kathai kahaanee ||
verses.translation: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is false; his mind wavers and wobbles, and he cannot speak the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat nihachal har man vasiaa a(n)mirat saachee baanee ||3||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Eternal Unchanging Lord abides within the mind; the True Word of His Bani is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man ke tara(n)g sabadh nivaare rasanaa sahaj subhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Shabad calms the turbulent waves of the mind; the tongue is intuively imbued with peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur mil raheeaai sadh apune jin har setee liv laiee ||4||
verses.translation: So remain united forever with your True Guru, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man sabadh marai taa mukato hovai har charanee chit laiee ||
verses.translation: If the mortal dies in the Shabad, then he is liberated; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har sar saagar sadhaa jal niramal naavai sahaj subhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: The Lord is an Ocean; His Water is Forever Pure. Whoever bathes in it is intuitively imbued with peace. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaar sadhaa ra(n)g raate haumai tirasanaa maaree ||
verses.translation: Those who contemplate the Shabad are forever imbued with His Love; their egotism and desires are subdued.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar nihakeval har raviaa sabh aatam raam muraaree ||6||
verses.translation: The Pure, Unattached Lord permeates their inner beings; the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading all. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sev rahe sach raate jo terai man bhaane ||
verses.translation: Your humble servants serve You, O Lord; those who are imbued with the Truth are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa mahal na paavai jag jhooThee gun avagan na pachhaane ||7||
verses.translation: Those who are involved in duality do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; caught in the false nature of the world, they do not discriminate between merits and demerits. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel le akath katheeaai sach sabadh sach baanee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord merges us into Himself, we speak the Unspoken Speech; True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saache sach samaane har kaa naam vakhaanee ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the true people are absorbed in the Truth; they chant the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har kaa naam at meeThaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is supremely sweet.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh bhau bha(n)jan gurmukh eko ddeeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is the Destroyer of the sins, the guilt and fears of countless incarnations; the Gurmukh sees the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT koTa(n)tar ke paap binaasan har saachaa man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Millions upon millions of sins are erased, when the mind comes to love the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har bin avar na soojhai dhoojaa satigur ek bujhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I do not know any other, except the Lord; the True Guru has revealed the One Lord to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prem padhaarath jin ghaT vasiaa sahaje rahe samaiee ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Love, remain intuitively absorbed in Him.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate se ra(n)g chaloole raate sahaj subhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. They are imbued with the Lord's celestial peace and poise. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa sabadh veechaar ras raatee laal bhiee ra(n)g laiee ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, the tongue is imbued with joy; embracing His Love, it is dyed a deep crimson.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam nihakeval jaaniaa man tirapatiaa saa(n)t aaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I have come to know the Name of the Pure Detached Lord; my mind is satisfied and comforted. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਮੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paRi(h) paRi(h) monee sabh thaake bhram bhekh thake bhekhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and study, and all the silent sages have grown weary; they have grown weary of wearing their religious robes and wandering all around.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh nira(n)jan paiaa saachai sabadh veechaaree ||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I contemplate the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun nivaar sach raate saach sabadh man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended, and I am imbued with Truth; the True Word of the Shabad is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paieeaai jin vichahu aap gavaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is found, and self-conceit is eliminated from within. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh sahaj dhun upajai man saachai liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the celestial melody wells up, and the mind is lovingly focused on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: agam agochar naam nira(n)jan gurmukh ma(n)n vasaiee ||6||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord, abides in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ekas meh sabh jagato varatai viralaa ek pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: The whole world is contained in the One Lord. How rare are those who understand the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai taa sabh kichh soojhai anadhin eko jaanai ||7||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Shabad comes to know everything; night and day, he realizes the One Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan boojhai hor kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, understands. Nothing else can be said.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sadhaa bairaagee ek sabadh liv laiee ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are forever detached from the world; they are lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har kee akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Speech of the Lord is unspoken.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har nadhar kare soiee jan paae gurmukh viralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That humble being who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains it. How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har gahir ga(n)bheer gunee gaheer gur kai sabadh pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Deep, Profound and Unfathomable, the Ocean of Excellence; He is realized through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਉਰਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh karam kareh bhai dhoojai bin sabadhai bauraaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Mortals do their deeds in all sorts of ways, in the love of duality; but without the Shabad, they are insane. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam naavai soiee jan niramal fir mailaa mool na hoiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being who bathes in the Lord's Name becomes immaculate; he never becomes polluted again.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sabh jag hai mailaa dhoojai bharam pat khoiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the whole world is polluted; wandering in duality, it loses its honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa dhiraRaa(n) kiaa sa(n)greh tiaagee mai taa boojh na paiee ||
verses.translation: What should I grasp? What should I gather up or leave behind? I do not know.

verses.original: ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau naamo hoi sakhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, Your Name is the Help and Support of those whom You bless with Your kindness and compassion. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sach dhaataa karam bidhaataa jis bhaavai tis nai laae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is the True Giver, the Architect of Destiny; as He pleases, He links mortals to the Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai soiee boojhai jis no aap bujhaae ||4||
verses.translation: He alone comes to understand, who enters the Guru's Gate, whom the Lord Himself instructs. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh bisamaadh ih man nahee chete aavaa gaun sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Even gazing upon the wonders of the Lord, this mind does not think of Him. The world comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur seve soiee boojhai paae mokh dhuaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mortal comes to understand, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) dhar soojhai se kadhe na vigaaReh satigur boojh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who understand the Lord's Court, never suffer separation from him. The True Guru has imparted this understanding.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee kirat kamaaveh aavan jaan rahaiee ||6||
verses.translation: They practice truth, self-restraint and good deeds; their comings and goings are ended. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: se dhar saachai saach kamaaveh jin gurmukh saach adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True Lord, they practice Truth. The Gurmukhs take the Support of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhoojai bharam bhulaae naa boojheh veechaaraa ||7||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander, lost in doubt and duality. They do not know how to contemplate the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape gurmukh aape dhevai aape kar kar vekhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself gives; He Himself creates and beholds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak se jan thai pe hai jin kee pat paavai lekhai ||8||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are approved, whose honor the Lord Himself accepts. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਸਾੲਂੀ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: gusaae(n)ee parataap tuhaaro ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the World, I gaze upon Your wondrous glory.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਬੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan upai samaavan sagal chhatrapat beeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Creator and Destroyer. You are the Sovereign Lord of all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਰੰਕਾ ਉਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: raanaa raau raaj bhe ra(n)kaa un jhooThe kahan kahaio ||
verses.translation: The rulers and nobles and kings shall become beggars. Their ostentatious shows are false

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hamaraa raajan sadhaa salaamat taa ko sagal ghaTaa jas gaio ||1||
verses.translation: . My Sovereign Lord King is eternally stable. His Praises are sung in every heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਪਮਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਤ ਜੇਤ ਪਾਹੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: aupamaa sunahu raajan kee sa(n)tahu kahat jet paahoochaa ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Praises of my Lord King, O Saints. I chant them as best I can.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਊਚੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: besumaar vadd saeh dhaataaraa uooche hee te uoochaa ||2||
verses.translation: My Lord King, the Great Giver, is Immeasurable. He is the Highest of the high. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਵਨਿ ਪਰੋਇਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: pavan paroio sagal akaaraa paavak kaasaT sa(n)ge ||
verses.translation: He has strung His Breath throughout the creation; He locked the fire in the wood.

verses.original: ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕਤ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: neer dharan kar raakhe ekat koi na kis hee sa(n)ge ||3||
verses.translation: He placed the water and the land together, but neither blends with the other. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਥਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT kathaa raajan kee chaalai ghar ghar tujheh umaahaa ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the Story of our Sovereign Lord is told; in each and every home, they yearn for Him.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh paachhai kariaa prathame rijak samaahaa ||4||
verses.translation: Afterwards, He created all beings and creatures; but first, He provided them with sustenance. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa su aape karanaa masalat kaahoo dheen(h)ee ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, He does by Himself. Who has ever given Him advice?

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੑੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar kareh dhikhaae saachee saakhee cheen(h)ee ||5||
verses.translation: The mortals make all sorts of efforts and showy displays, but He is realized only through the Teachings of Truth. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੀਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa kar raakhe apane dheenee naam vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord protects and saves His devotees; He blesses them with the glory of His Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਤੈਂ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜੑਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jin jin karee avagiaa jan kee te tai(n) dhe'ee ruR(h)aiee ||6||
verses.translation: Whoever is disrespectful to the humble servant of the Lord, shall be swept away and destroyed. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukat bhe saadhasa(n)gat kar tin ke avagan sabh parahariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are liberated; all their demerits are taken away.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tin kau dhekh bhe kirapaalaa tin bhav saagar tariaa ||7||
verses.translation: Seeing them, God becomes merciful; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਾਨੑੇ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮੇੑ ਬਡ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham naan(h)e neech tume(h) badd saahib kudharat kaun beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, I am nothing at all; You are my Great Lord and Master - how can I even contemplate Your creative potency?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal gur dharas dhekhe naanak naam adhaaraa ||8||1||
verses.translation: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Nanak takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: saarag mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadhee ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agaadh sunahu jan kathaa ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Story of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kee acharaj sabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Supreme Lord God is wondrous and amazing! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa satigur namasakaar ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, humbly bow to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te gun gai apaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man bheetar hovai paragaas ||
verses.translation: His Light shall radiate deep within your mind.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan agiaan binaas ||1||
verses.translation: With the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mit naahee jaa kaa bisathaar ||
verses.translation: There is no limit to His Expanse.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa taa kee apar apaar ||
verses.translation: His Glory is Infinite and Endless.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g jaa ke gane na jaeh ||
verses.translation: His many plays cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sog harakh dhuhahoo meh naeh ||2||
verses.translation: He is not subject to pleasure or pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik brahame jaa ke bedh dhun kareh ||
verses.translation: Many Brahmas vibrate Him in the Vedas.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਹੇਸ ਬੈਸਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik mahes bais dhiaan dhareh ||
verses.translation: Many Shivas sit in deep meditation.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅੰਸਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik purakh a(n)saa avataar ||
verses.translation: Many beings take incarnation.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਊਭੇ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anik i(n)dhr uoobhe dharabaar ||3||
verses.translation: Many Indras stand at the Lord's Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਵਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਅਰੁ ਨੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik pavan paavak ar neer ||
verses.translation: Many winds, fires and waters.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਤਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਦਧਿ ਖੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik ratan saagar dhadh kheer ||
verses.translation: Many jewels, and oceans of butter and milk.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖਿਆਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik soor saseear nakhiaat ||
verses.translation: Many suns, moons and stars.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: anik dhevee dhevaa bahu bhaa(n)t ||4||
verses.translation: Many gods and goddesses of so many kinds. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik basudhaa anik kaamadhen ||
verses.translation: Many earths, many wish-fulfilling cows.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik paarajaat anik mukh ben ||
verses.translation: Many miraculous Elysian trees, many Krishnas playing the flute.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਕਾਸ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: anik akaas anik paataal ||
verses.translation: Many Akaashic ethers, many nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਖੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anik mukhee japeeaai gopaal ||5||
verses.translation: Many mouths chant and meditate on the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik saasatr simirat puraan ||
verses.translation: Many Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਬਖਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik jugat hovat bakhiaan ||
verses.translation: Many ways in which we speak.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਰੋਤੇ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik sarote suneh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Many listeners listen to the Lord of Treasure.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sarab jeea pooran bhagavaan ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord God totally permeates all beings. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਧਰਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੁਮੇਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik dharam anik kumer ||
verses.translation: Many righteous judges of Dharma, many gods of wealth.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਸੁਮੇਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik baran anik kanik sumer ||
verses.translation: Many gods of water, many mountains of gold.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੇਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik sekh navatan naam leh ||
verses.translation: Many thousand-headed snakes, chanting ever-new Names of God.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kaa a(n)t na teh ||7||
verses.translation: They do not know the limits of the Supreme Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਹ ਖੰਡ ॥
verses.translit: anik pureeaa anik teh kha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: Many solar systems, many galaxies.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
verses.translit: anik roop ra(n)g brahama(n)dd ||
verses.translation: Many forms, colors and celestial realms.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ॥
verses.translit: anik banaa anik fal mool ||
verses.translation: Many gardens, many fruits and roots.

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aapeh sookham aapeh asathool ||8||
verses.translation: He Himself is mind, and He Himself is matter. ||8||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik jugaadh dhinas ar raat ||
verses.translation: Many ages, days and nights.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਤਪਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik paralau anik utapaat ||
verses.translation: Many apocalypses, many creations.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik jeea jaa ke gireh maeh ||
verses.translation: Many beings are in His home.

verses.original: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ramat raam pooran srab Thaa(n)i ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord is perfectly pervading all places. ||9||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anik maiaa jaa kee lakhee na jai ||
verses.translation: Many Mayas, which cannot be known.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਖੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anik kalaa khelai har rai ||
verses.translation: Many are the ways in which our Sovereign Lord plays.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਸੰਗੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: anik dhunit lalit sa(n)geet ||
verses.translation: Many exquisite melodies sing of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਤਹ ਚੀਤ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: anik gupat pragaTe teh cheet ||10||
verses.translation: Many recording scribes of the conscious and subconscious are revealed there. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch bhagat jaa kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is above all, and yet He dwells with His devotees.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gaaveh ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they sing His Praises with love.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: anik anaahadh aana(n)dh jhunakaar ||
verses.translation: Many unstruck melodies resound and resonate with bliss.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: auaa ras kaa kachh a(n)t na paar ||11||
verses.translation: There is no end or limit of that sublime essence. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh sat asathaan ||
verses.translation: True is the Primal Being, and True is His dwelling.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: uooch te uooch niramal nirabaan ||
verses.translation: He is the Highest of the high, Immaculate and Detached, in Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: apunaa keeaa jaaneh aap ||
verses.translation: He alone knows His handiwork.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape ghaT ghaT rahio biaap ||
verses.translation: He Himself pervades each and every heart.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidhaan naanak dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Treasure of Compassion, O Nanak.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੨॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa naanak te bhe nihaal ||12||1||2||2||3||7||
verses.translation: Those who chant and meditate on Him, O Nanak, are exalted and enraptured. ||12||1||2||2||3||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਗ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: saarag chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Saarang, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਨਭੈ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhekheeaai anabhai kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: See the Giver of fearlessness in all.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT pooran hai alipaataa ||
verses.translation: The Detached Lord is totally permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT pooran kar bisatheeran jal tara(n)g jiau rachan keeaa ||
verses.translation: Like waves in the water, He created the creation.

verses.original: ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਭੋਗ ਘਟਾਣੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: habh ras maane bhog ghaTaane aan na beeaa ko theeaa ||
verses.translation: He enjoys all tastes, and takes pleasure in all hearts. There is no other like Him at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)gee ik ra(n)gee Thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: The color of the Lord's Love is the one color of our Lord and Master; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, God is realized.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਨਭੈ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dharas leenaa jiau jal meenaa sabh dhekheeaai anabhai kaa dhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am drenched with the Blessed Vision of the Lord, like the fish in the water. I see the Giver of fearlessness in all. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaun upamaa dheau kavan baddaiee ||
verses.translation: What praises should I give, and what approval should I offer to Him?

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio srab Thaiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸੋਹਨ ਜਬ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਬ ਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pooran manmohan ghaT ghaT sohan jab khi(n)chai tab chhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Enticing Lord adorns each and every heart. When He withdraws, the mortal turns to dust.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਹੁ ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤਕ ਬੇਲਾ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau na araadhahu mil kar saadhahu gharee muhatak belaa aaiee ||
verses.translation: Why do you not worship and adore Him? Join together with the Holy Saints; any instant, your time shall come.

verses.original: ਅਰਥੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: arath dharab sabh jo kichh dheesai sa(n)g na kachhahoo jaiee ||
verses.translation: All your property and wealth, and all that you see - none of it will go along with you.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har har aaraadhahu kavan upamaa dheau kavan baddaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. What praise, and what approval, can I offer to Him? ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: poochhau sa(n)t mero Thaakur kaisaa ||
verses.translation: I ask the Saints, what is my Lord and Master like?

verses.original: ਹਂੀਉ ਅਰਾਪਉਂ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)eeau araapau(n) dheh sadhesaa ||
verses.translation: I offer my heart, to one who brings me news of Him.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹਨ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheh sadhesaa prabh jeeau kaisaa keh mohan paravesaa ||
verses.translation: Give me news of my Dear God; where does the Enticer live?

verses.original: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਈ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)g a(n)g sukhadhaiee pooran brahamaiee thaan thaana(n)tar dhesaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of peace to life and limb; God is totally permeating all places, interspaces and countries.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan te mukataa ghaT ghaT jugataa keh na sakau har jaisaa ||
verses.translation: He is liberated from bondage, joined to each and every heart. I cannot say what the Lord is like.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਛੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhekh charit naanak man mohio poochhai dheen mero Thaakur kaisaa ||3||
verses.translation: Gazing upon His wondrous play, O Nanak, my mind is fascinated. I humbly ask, what is my Lord and Master like? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apune peh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: In His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਜਿਹ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n su ridhaa jeh charan basaiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that heart, in which the Lord's Feet are enshrined.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: charan basaiaa sa(n)t sa(n)gaiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: His Feet are enshrined within, in the Society of the Saints; the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਲਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhiaa pragaas ridhai ulaas prabh loReedhaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: The heart is enlightened and illumined and enraptured; God has been found.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਹਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh naaThaa sukh ghar meh vooThaa mahaa ana(n)dh sahajaiaa ||
verses.translation: Pain is gone, and peace has come to my house. The ultimate intuitive peace prevails.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai pooraa paiaa kar kirapaa apune peh aaiaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord; in His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਇ ਮਹਮੇ ਹਸਨੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ
verses.translit: saara(n)g kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa rai mahame hasane kee dhun
verses.translation: Vaar Of Saarang, Fourth Mehla, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Mehma-Hasna:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਪਾਹੂ ਨਿਵਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੋਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਛਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur ku(n)jee paahoo nival man koThaa tan chhat ||
verses.translation: The key of the Guru opens the lock of attachment, in the house of the mind, under the roof of the body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤਾਕੁ ਨ ਉਘੜੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹਥਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur bin man kaa taak na ughaRai avar na ku(n)jee hath ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Guru, the door of the mind cannot be opened. No one else holds the key in hand. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai raagee naadhee bedh ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by music, songs or the Vedas.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai suratee giaanee jog ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by intuitive wisdom, meditation or Yoga.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੋਗੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਰੋਜਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai sogee keetai roj ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by feeling sad and depressed forever.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰੂਪਂੀ ਮਾਲਂੀ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai roopa(n)ee maala(n)ee ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by beauty, wealth and pleasures.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਨੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai teerath bhaviaai na(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by wandering naked at sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਦਾਤਂੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਪੁੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai dhaata(n)ee keetai pu(n)n ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by giving donations in charity.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai baahar baiThiaa su(n)n ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by living alone in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਭੇੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਸੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai bheR mareh bhiR soor ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by fighting and dying as a warrior in battle.

verses.original: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੂੜ ॥
verses.translit: n bheejai kete hoveh dhooR ||
verses.translation: He is not won over by becoming the dust of the masses.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa likheeaai man kai bhai ||
verses.translation: The account is written of the loves of the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bheejai saachai nai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is won over only by His Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nav chhia khaT kaa kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: You may study the nine grammars, the six Shaastras and the six divions of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨ ਉਚਰੈ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: nis dhin ucharai bhaar aThaar ||
verses.translation: You may recite the Mahaabhaarata.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin bhee a(n)t na paiaa toh ||
verses.translation: Even these cannot find the limits of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam bihoon mukat kiau hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be liberated?

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਵਸਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naabh vasat brahamai a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, in the lotus of the navel, does not know the limits of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak naam pachhaaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, realizes the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap nira(n)janaa jin aap upaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord Himself, by Himself, created Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape khel rachaion sabh jagat sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the whole drama of all the world's play.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun aap sirajian maiaa moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself formed the three gunas, the three qualities; He increased the attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ubare jin bhaanaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are saved - those who love the Will of God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sach varatadhaa sabh sach samaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is pervading everywhere; all are contained within the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਖੈ ਵੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae naanakaa aape rakhai vek ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, O Nanak; He establishes the various creatures.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai jaa(n) sabhanaa saahib ek ||
verses.translation: How can anyone be called bad? We have only One Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa saahib ek hai vekhai dha(n)dhai lai ||
verses.translation: There is One Lord and Master of all; He watches over all, and assigns all to their tasks.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kisai thoRaa kisai agalaa khaalee koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: Some have less, and some have more; no one is allowed to leave empty.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਵਿਚੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh na(n)ge jaeh na(n)ge viche kareh vithaar ||
verses.translation: Naked we come, and naked we go; in between, we put on a show.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਗੈ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na jaaneeaai agai kaiee kaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of God's Command - what will he have to do in the world hereafter? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਉ ਭੇਜੈ ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jinas thaap jeeaa(n) kau bhejai jinas thaap lai jaavai ||
verses.translation: He sends out the various created beings, and he calls back the various created beings again.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ਆਪੇ ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape thaap uthaapai aape ete ves karaavai ||
verses.translation: He himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes. He fashions them in various forms.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea fireh aaudhootee aape bhikhiaa paavai ||
verses.translation: And all the human beings who wander around as beggars, He Himself gives in charity to them.

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਦਾਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: lekhai bolan lekhai chalan kait keecheh dhaave ||
verses.translation: As it is recorded, the mortals speak, and as it is recorded, they walk. So why put on all this show?

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਏਹੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mool mat paravaanaa eho naanak aakh sunaae ||
verses.translation: This is the basis of intelligence; this is certified and approved. Nanak speaks and proclaims it.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karanee upar hoi tapaavas je ko kahai kahaae ||2||
verses.translation: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chalat rachaion gun paragaTee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word makes the drama play itself out. Through virtue, this becomes evident.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee sadh ucharai har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever utters the Word of the Guru's Bani - the Lord is enshrined in his mind.

verses.original: ਸਕਤਿ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sakat giee bhram kaTiaa siv jot jagaiaa ||
verses.translation: Maya's power is gone, and doubt is eradicated; awaken to the Light of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai gur purakh milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who hold onto goodness as their treasure meet the Guru, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje mil rahe har naam samaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed and blended into the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹ ਚਲੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: saeh chale vanajaariaa likhiaa dhevai naal ||
verses.translation: The merchants come from the Banker; He sends the account of their destiny with them.

verses.original: ਲਿਖੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਈਐ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: likhe upar hukam hoi lieeaai vasat sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: On the basis of their accounts, He issues the Hukam of His Command, and they are left to take care of their merchandise.

verses.original: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vasat liee vanajaariee vakhar badhaa pai ||
verses.translation: The merchants have purchased their merchandise and packed up their cargo.

verses.original: ਕੇਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: keiee laahaa lai chale ik chale mool gavai ||
verses.translation: Some depart after having earned a good profit, while others leave, having lost their investment altogether.

verses.original: ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੰਗਿਓ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: thoRaa kinai na ma(n)gio kis kaheeaai saabaas ||
verses.translation: No one asks to have less; who should be celebrated?

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nadhar tinaa kau naanakaa j saabat laae raas ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, upon those who have preserved their capital investment. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੁੜਿ ਜੁੜਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜੁੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: juR juR vichhuRe vichhuR juRe ||
verses.translation: United, the united separate, and separated, they unite again.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਿ ਜੀਵਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeev jeev mue mue jeeve ||
verses.translation: Living, the living die, and dying, they live again.

verses.original: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਾਪ ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਟੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੂਏ ॥
verses.translit: ketiaa ke baap ketiaa ke beTe kete gur chele hooe ||
verses.translation: They become the fathers of many, and the sons of many; they become the gurus of many, and the disciples.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੂਏ ॥
verses.translit: aagai paachhai ganat na aavai kiaa jaatee kiaa hun hooe ||
verses.translation: No account can be made of the future or the past; who knows what shall be, or what was?

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh karanaa kirat kar likheeaai kar kar karataa kare kare ||
verses.translation: All the actions and events of the past are recorded; the Doer did, He does, and He will do.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh mareeaai gurmukh tareeaai naanak nadharee nadhar kare ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh dies, while the Gurmukh is saved; O Nanak, the Gracious Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhoojaa bharam hai dhoojai lobhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders in duality, lured and enticed by duality.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੋ ਆਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT kamaavadhe kooRo aalaiaa ||
verses.translation: He practices falsehood and deception, telling lies.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr moh het hai sabh dhukh sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: Love and attachment to children and spouse is total misery and pain.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhe maare'eh bharameh bharamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is gagged and bound at the door of the Messenger of Death; he dies, and wanders lost in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh janam gavaiaa naanak har bhaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wastes his life; Nanak loves the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin vaddiaaiee tere naam kee te rate man maeh ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the glorious greatness of Your Name - their minds are imbued with Your Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)mrit ek hai dhoojaa a(n)mrit naeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is only One Ambrosial Nectar; there is no other nectar at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)mrit manai maeh paieeaai gur parasaadh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained within the mind, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪੀਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h)ee peetaa ra(n)g siau jin(h) kau likhiaa aadh ||1||
verses.translation: They alone drink it in with love, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਇ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai kare soi saalaeh ||
verses.translation: Why praise the created being? Praise the One who created all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ekee baaharaa dhoojaa dhaataa naeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no other Giver, except the One Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karataa so saalaaheeaai jin keetaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: Praise the Creator Lord, who created the creation.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaataa so saalaaheeaai j sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Praise the Great Giver, who gives sustenence to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸਦੀਵ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aap sadheev hai pooraa jis bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the treasure of the Eternal Lord is over-flowing.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddaa kar saalaaheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||2||
verses.translation: Praise and honor the One, who has no end or limitation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaan hai seviaai sukh paiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is a treasure. Serving it, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਉਚਰਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan ucharaa(n) pat siau ghar jaa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Immaculate Lord, so that I may go home with honor.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh baanee naam hai naam ridhai vasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Gurmukh is the Naam; I enshrine the Naam within my heart.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat pa(n)kheroo vas hoi satiguroo dhiaae(n)ee ||
verses.translation: The bird of the intellect comes under one's control, by meditating on the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aap dhiaal hoi naame liv laiee ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the Lord becomes merciful, the mortal lovingly tunes in to the Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau kaisaa bolanaa j aape jaanai jaan ||
verses.translation: How can we speak of Him? Only He knows Himself.

verses.original: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: cheeree jaa kee naa firai saahib so paravaan ||
verses.translation: His decree cannot be challenged; He is our Supreme Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: cheeree jis kee chalanaa meer malak salaar ||
verses.translation: By His Decree, even kings, nobles and commanders must step down.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee bhalee kaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, O Nanak, is a good deed.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਥਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa cheeree chalanaa hath tin(h)aa kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: By His Decree, we walk; nothing rests in our hands.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਠੀ ਕਰਲੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: saahib kaa furamaan hoi uThee karalai paeh ||
verses.translation: When the Order comes from our Lord and Master, all must rise up and take to the road.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa cheeree likhiaa tehaa hukam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: As His Decree is issued, so is His Command obeyed.

verses.original: ਘਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਦੇ ਉਠੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghale aaveh naanakaa sadhe uThee jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are sent, come, O Nanak; when they are called back, they depart and go. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸੀਐ ਸੇਈ ਪੋਤੇਦਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sifat jinaa kau bakhaseeaai seiee potedhaar ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Praises, are the true keepers of the treasure.

verses.original: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)jee jin kau dhiteeaa tin(h)aa mile bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the key - they alone receive the treasure.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੂ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਤੇ ਕੀਅਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bha(n)ddaaree hoo gun nikaleh te ke'eeh paravaan ||
verses.translation: That treasure, from which virtue wells up - that treasure is approved.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nadhar tin(h)aa kau naanakaa naam jin(h)aa neesaan ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, bear the Insignia of the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan niramalaa suniaai sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is immaculate and pure; hearing it, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun ma(n)n vasaieeaai boojhai jan koiee ||
verses.translation: Listening and hearing, It is enshrined in the mind; how rare is that humble being who realizes it.

verses.original: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bahadhiaa uThadhiaa na visarai saachaa sach soiee ||
verses.translation: Sitting down and standing up, I shall never forget Him, the Truest of the true.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kau naam adhaar hai naame sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: His devotees have the Support of His Name; in His Name, they find peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak man tan rav rahiaa gurmukh har soiee ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He permeates and pervades mind and body; He is the Lord, the Guru's Word. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਤੋਲ ਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tule'eeh tol je jeeau pichhai paieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the weight is weighed out, when the soul is placed on the scale.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਬੋਲ ਜੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eikas na pujeh bol je poore pooraa kar milai ||
verses.translation: Nothing is equal to speaking of the One, who perfectly unites us with the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa aakhan bhaaraa tol ||
verses.translation: To call Him glorious and great carries such a heavy weight.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਹਉਲੀ ਮਤੀ ਹਉਲੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: hor haulee matee haule bol ||
verses.translation: Other intellectualisms are lightweight; other words are lightweight as well.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee paanee parabat bhaar ||
verses.translation: The weight of the earth, water and mountains

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕੰਡੈ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau ka(n)ddai tolai suniaar ||
verses.translation: - how can the goldsmith weigh it on the scale?

verses.original: ਤੋਲਾ ਮਾਸਾ ਰਤਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tolaa maasaa ratak pai ||
verses.translation: What weights can balance the scale?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak puchhiaa dhei pujai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when questioned, the answer is given.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh a(n)dhiaa a(n)dhee dhaat ||
verses.translation: The blind fool is running around, leading the blind.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਨਿ ਆਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh keh kahan kahain aap ||1||
verses.translation: The more they say, the more they expose themselves. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਆਖਿ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan aaukhaa sunan aaukhaa aakh na jaapee aakh ||
verses.translation: It is difficult to chant it; it is difficult to listen to it. It cannot be chanted with the mouth.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖਹਿ ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik aakh aakheh sabadh bhaakheh aradh uradh dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Some speak with their mouths and chant the Word of the Shabad - the low and the high, day and night.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਿਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: je kih hoi ta kih dhisai jaapai roop na jaat ||
verses.translation: If He were something, then He would be visible. His form and state cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਟ ਅਉਘਟ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaran karataa kare ghaT aaughaT ghaT thaap ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord does all deeds; He is established in the hearts of the high and the low.

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਖਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aakhan aaukhaa naanakaa aakh na jaapai aakh ||2||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to chant it, O Nanak; it cannot be chanted with the mouth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai man rahaseeaai naame saa(n)t aaiee ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is delighted. The Name brings peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai man tirapateeaai sabh dhukh gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is satisfied, and all pains are taken away.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai naau uoopajai naame vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, one becomes famous; the Name brings glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naame hee sabh jaat pat naame gat paiee ||
verses.translation: The Name brings all honor and status; through the Name, salvation is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai naanak liv laiee ||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Name; Nanak is lovingly attuned to the Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਰਾਗਂੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਵੇਦਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na raaga(n)ee jooTh na vedha(n)ee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from music; impurity does not come from the Vedas.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਭੇਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na cha(n)dh sooraj kee bhedhee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from the phases of the sun and the moon.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਅੰਨੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na a(n)nee jooTh na naiee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from food; impurity does not come from ritual cleansing baths.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na meeh varihaai sabh thaiee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from the rain, which falls everywhere.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na dharatee jooTh na paanee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਉਣੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jooTh na paunai maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak niguriaa gun naahee koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਿ ਫੇਰਿਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: muh feriaai muh jooThaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੁਲੀਆ ਸੁਚੀਆ ਜੇ ਭਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak chuleeaa sucheeaa je bhar jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to do it.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾ ਜਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: surate chulee giaan kee jogee kaa jat hoi ||
verses.translation: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਚੁਲੀ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: brahaman chulee sa(n)tokh kee girahee kaa sat dhaan ||
verses.translation: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਨਿਆਵ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: raaje chulee niaav kee paRiaa sach dhiaan ||
verses.translation: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਧੋਪਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paanee chit na dhopiee mukh peetai tikh jai ||
verses.translation: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paanee pitaa jagat kaa fir paanee sabh khai ||2||
verses.translation: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai sabh sidh hai ridh pichhai aavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai nau nidh milai man chi(n)dhiaa paavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires are obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai sa(n)tokh hoi kavalaa charan dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai sahaj uoopajai sahaje sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmatee naau paieeaai naanak gun gaavai ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vich ja(n)man dhukh maran dhukh varatan sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dhukh agai aakheeaai paRi(h) paRi(h) kareh pukaar ||
verses.translation: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the more they cry out.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਪੰਡਾ ਖੁਲੑੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh keeaa pa(n)ddaa khul(h)eeaa sukh na nikalio koi ||
verses.translation: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vich jeeau jalaiaa dhukheeaa chaliaa roi ||
verses.translation: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sifatee ratiaa man tan hariaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਅਗੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh keeaa agee maare'eh bhee dhukh dhaaroo hoi ||1||
verses.translation: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਸੂ ਹੂ ਭਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuneeaa bhas ra(n)g bhasoo hoo bhas kheh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dust of ashes.

verses.original: ਭਸੋ ਭਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭੀ ਭਸੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhaso bhas kamaavanee bhee bhas bhareeaai dheh ||
verses.translation: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਭਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa jeeau vichahu kaddeeaai bhasoo bhariaa jai ||
verses.translation: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agai lekhai ma(n)giaai hor dhasoonee pai ||2||
verses.translation: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten times more dust. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai such sa(n)jamo jam neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger of Death will not draw near.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai ghaT chaananaa aan(h)er gavaavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai aap bujheeaai laahaa naau paavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Name is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nai suniaai paap kaTe'eeh niramal sach paavai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak nai suniaai mukh ujale naau gurmukh dhiaavai ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਭਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar naarain sabhaa naal ||
verses.translation: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.

verses.original: ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਵਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: pooj kare rakhai naavaal ||
verses.translation: You wash your stone gods and worship them.

verses.original: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਫੁਲ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)goo cha(n)nan ful chaRaae ||
verses.translation: You offer saffron, sandalwood and flowers.

verses.original: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pairee pai pai bahut manaae ||
verses.translation: Falling at their feet, you try so hard to appease them.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੂਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maanooaa ma(n)g ma(n)g pain(h)ai khai ||
verses.translation: Begging, begging from other people, you get things to wear and eat.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh sajai ||
verses.translation: For your blind deeds, you will be blindly punished.

verses.original: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਰਦਿਆ ਰਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhukhiaa dhei na maradhiaa rakhai ||
verses.translation: Your idol does not feed the hungry, or save the dying.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਥੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa jhagaRaa a(n)dhee sathai ||1||
verses.translation: The blind assembly argues in blindness. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe suratee jog sabh sabhe bedh puraan ||
verses.translation: All intuitive understanding, all Yoga, all the Vedas and Puraanas.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe karane tap sabh sabhe geet giaan ||
verses.translation: All actions, all penances, all songs and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe budhee sudh sabh sabh teerath sabh thaan ||
verses.translation: All intellect, all enlightenment, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਅਮਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabh paatisaaheeaa amar sabh sabh khuseeaa sabh khaan ||
verses.translation: All kingdoms, all royal commands, all joys and all delicacies.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਵ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe maanas dhev sabh sabhe jog dhiaan ||
verses.translation: All mankind, all divinites, all Yoga and meditation.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)dd sabh sabhe jeea jahaan ||
verses.translation: All worlds, all celestial realms; all the beings of the universe.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਵਹੈ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: hukam chalaae aapanai karamee vahai kalaam ||
verses.translation: According to His Hukam, He commands them. His Pen writes out the account of their actions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa sach nai sach sabhaa dheebaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Lord, and True is His Name. True is His Congregation and His Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai sukh uoopajai naame gat hoiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, peace wells up; the Name brings emancipation.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai pat paieeaai hiradhai har soiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord is enshrined in the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai bhavajal la(n)gheeaai fir bighan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and no obstructions are ever again encountered.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai pa(n)th paragaTaa naame sabh loiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, the Path is revealed; through the Name, one is totally enlightened.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai naau ma(n)neeaai jin dhevai soiee ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; he alone has faith, who is blessed with it. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: pureeaa kha(n)ddaa sir kare ik pair dhiaae ||
verses.translation: The mortal walks on his head through the worlds and realms; he meditates, balanced on one foot.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਲੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: paun maar man jap kare sir mu(n)ddee talai dhei ||
verses.translation: Controlling the wind of the breath, he meditates within his mind, tucking his chin down into his chest.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਟਿਕ ਟਿਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
