verses.translit: kis upar oh Tik Tikai kis no jor karei ||
verses.translation: What does he lean on? Where does he get his power?

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai naanakaa kis no karataa dhei ||
verses.translation: What can be said, O Nanak? Who is blessed by the Creator?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hukam rahaae aapanai moorakh aap ganei ||1||
verses.translation: God keeps all under His Command, but the fool shows off himself. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਆਖਾਂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: hai hai aakhaa(n) koT koT koTee hoo koT koT ||
verses.translation: He is, He is - I say it millions upon millions, millions upon millions of times.

verses.original: ਆਖੂੰ ਆਖਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: aakhoo(n) aakhaa(n) sadhaa sadhaa kahan na aavai toT ||
verses.translation: With my mouth I say it, forever and ever; there is no end to this speech.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਥਕਾਂ ਨ ਠਾਕੀਆ ਏਵਡ ਰਖਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa hau thakaa(n) na Thaakeeaa evadd rakheh jot ||
verses.translation: I do not get tired, and I will not be stopped; this is how great my determination is.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਸਿਅਹੁ ਚੁਖ ਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak chasiahu chukh bi(n)dh upar aakhan dhos ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is tiny and insignificant. To say that it is more, is wrong. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai kul udharai sabh kuTa(n)b sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, all one's ancestors and family are saved.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai sa(n)gat udharai jin ridhai vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, one's associates are saved; enshrine it within your heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai sun udhare jin rasan rasaiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, those who hear it are saved; let your tongue delight in it.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai dhukh bhukh giee jin naam chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, pain and hunger are dispelled; let your consciousness be attached to the Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam tinee saalaahiaa jin guroo milaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone Praise the Name, who meet with the Guru. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਹ ਸਭਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe raatee sabh dheh sabh thitee sabh vaar ||
verses.translation: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਤਂੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe rutee maeh sabh sabh dharata(n)ee sabh bhaar ||
verses.translation: All seasons, all months, all the earth and everything on it.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe paanee paun sabh sabh aganee paataal ||
verses.translation: All waters, all winds, all fires and underworlds.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)dd sabh sabh loa loa aakaar ||
verses.translation: All solar systems and galaxies, all worlds, people and forms.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hukam na jaapee ketaRaa keh na sakeejai kaar ||
verses.translation: No one knows how great the Hukam of His Command is; no one can describe His actions.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਥਕਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਂੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh thakeh aakh aakh kar sifata(n)ee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Mortals may utter, chant, recite and contemplate His Praises until they grow weary.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiran na paio bapuRee naanak kahai gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: The poor fools, O Nanak, cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਖਂੀ ਪਰਣੈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: akha(n)ee paranai je firaa(n) dhekhaa(n) sabh aakaar ||
verses.translation: If I were to walk around with my eyes wide open, gazing at all the created forms;

verses.original: ਪੁਛਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਪੁਛਾ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: puchhaa giaanee pa(n)dditaa(n) puchhaa bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: I could ask the spiritual teachers and religious scholars, and those who contemplate the Vedas;

verses.original: ਪੁਛਾ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਜੋਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: puchhaa dhevaa(n) maanasaa(n) jodh kareh avataar ||
verses.translation: I could ask the gods, mortal men, warriors and divine incarnations;

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sidh samaadhee sabh sunee jai dhekhaa(n) dharabaar ||
verses.translation: I could consult all the Siddhas in Samaadhi, and go to see the Lord's Court.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agai sachaa sach nai nirabhau bhai vin saar ||
verses.translation: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਮਤੀ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hor kachee matee kach pich a(n)dhiaa a(n)dh beechaar ||
verses.translation: False are other intellectualisms, false and shallow; blind are the contemplations of the blind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karamee ba(n)dhagee nadhar la(n)ghaae paar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by the karma of good actions, the mortal comes to meditate on the Lord; by His Grace, we are carried across. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai dhuramat giee mat paragaTee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the intellect is enlightened.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naau ma(n)niaai haumai giee sabh rog gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, egotism is eradicated, and all sickness is cured.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai naam uoopajai sahaje sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Believing in the Name, The Name wells up, and intuitive peace and poise are obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai saa(n)t uoopajai har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Believing in the Name, tranquility and peace well up, and the Lord is enshrined in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rata(n)n hai gurmukh har dhiaaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Name is a jewel; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: hor sareek hovai koiee teraa tis agai tudh aakhaa(n) ||
verses.translation: If there were any other equal to You, O Lord, I would speak to them of You.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh agai tudhai saalaahee mai a(n)dhe naau sujaakhaa ||
verses.translation: You, I praise You; I am blind, but through the Name, I am all-seeing.

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa aakhan saahee sabadhee bhaakhiaa bhai subhaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever is spoken, is the Word of the Shabad. Chanting it with love, we are embellished.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bahutaa eho aakhan sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak, this is the greatest thing to say: all glorious greatness is Yours. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਨ ਸਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਜੰਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) na siaa kiaa chaakaree jaa(n) ja(n)me kiaa kaar ||
verses.translation: When there was nothing, what happened? What happens when one is born?

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaran karataa kare dhekhai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator, the Doer, does all; He watches over all, again and again

verses.original: ਜੇ ਚੁਪੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: je chupai je ma(n)giaai dhaat kare dhaataar ||
verses.translation: . Whether we keep silent or beg out loud, the Great Giver blesses us with His gifts.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaataa sabh ma(n)gate fir dhekheh aakaar ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver; we are all beggars. I have seen this throughout the Universe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak evai jaaneeaai jeevai dhevanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak knows this: the Great Giver lives forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai surat uoopajai naame mat hoiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, intuitive awareness wells up; through the Name, intelligence comes.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai gun ucharai naame sukh soiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, chant the Glories of God; through the Name, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai bhram kaTeeaai fir dhukh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, doubt is eradicated, and the mortal never suffers again.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਤਿ ਧੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai saalaaheeaai paapaa(n) mat dhoiee ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Name, sing His Praises, and your sinful intellect shall be washed clean.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poore gur te naau ma(n)neeaai jin dhevai soiee ||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; they alone receive it, unto whom He gives it. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੑੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: saasatr bedh puraan paR(h)(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Some read the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਪੂਕਾਰੰਤਾ ਅਜਾਣੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pookaara(n)taa ajaana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: They recite them, out of ignorance.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) boojhai taa(n) soojhai soiee ||
verses.translation: If they really understood them, they would realize the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai kook na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak says, there is no need to shout so loud. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) hau teraa taa(n) sabh kichh meraa hau naahee too hoveh ||
verses.translation: When I am Yours, then everything is mine. When I am not, You are.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape sakataa aape surataa sakatee jagat paroveh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are All-powerful, and You Yourself are the Intuitive Knower. The whole world is strung on the Power of Your Shakti.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape bheje aape sadhe rachanaa rach rach vekhai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself send out the mortal beings, and You Yourself call them back home. Having created the creation, You behold it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਂਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa sachee naa(n)iee sach pavai dhur lekhai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Name of the True Lord; through Truth, one is accepted by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan alakh hai kiau lakhiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is unknowable. How can it be known?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan naal hai kiau paieeaai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is with the mortal being. How can it be obtained, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan varatadhaa raviaa sabh Thaa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is all-pervading and permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paieeaai hiradhai dhei dhikhaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained. It is revealed within the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee karam hoi gur mileeaai bhaiee ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Grace, the mortal meets with the Guru, O Siblings of Desitny. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੁਤੇ ਮੁਹੀ ਖਾਜੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal hoiee kute muhee khaaj hoaa muradhaar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, people have faces like dogs; they eat rotting carcasses for food.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR bol bol bhaukanaa chookaa dharam beechaar ||
verses.translation: They bark and speak, telling only lies; all thought of righteousness has left them.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin jeeva(n)dhiaa pat nahee muiaa ma(n)dhee soi ||
verses.translation: Those who have no honor while alive, will have an evil reputation after they die.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: likhiaa hovai naanakaa karataa kare su hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever is predestined, happens, O Nanak; whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੰਨਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਬੋਧੀਆ ਪੁਰਸ ਹੋਏ ਸਈਆਦ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)naa hoieeaa bodheeaa puras hoe sieeaadh ||
verses.translation: Women have become advisors, and men have become hunters.

verses.original: ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਭੰਨੀ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਜੁ ਅਹਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: seel sa(n)jam such bha(n)nee khaanaa khaaj ahaaj ||
verses.translation: Humility, self-control and purity have run away; people eat the uneatable, forbidden food.

verses.original: ਸਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: saram giaa ghar aapanai pat uTh chalee naal ||
verses.translation: Modesty has left her home, and honor has gone away with her.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa ek hai aaur na sachaa bhaal ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is only One True Lord; do not bother to search for any other as true. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bhasam lepan kare a(n)tar gubaaree ||
verses.translation: You smear your outer body with ashes, but within, you are filled with darkness.

verses.original: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)thaa jholee bahu bhekh kare dhuramat aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: You wear the patched coat and all the right clothes and robes, but you are still egotistical and proud.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਊਚਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sabadh na uoocharai maiaa moh pasaaree ||
verses.translation: You do not chant the Shabad, the Word of Your Lord and Master; you are attached to the expanse of Maya.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar laalach bharam hai bharamai gaavaaree ||
verses.translation: Within, you are filled with greed and doubt; you wander around like a fool.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na chetiee jooaai baajee haaree ||14||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, you never even think of the Naam; you have lost the game of life in the gamble. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lakh siau preet hovai lakh jeevan kiaa khuseeaa kiaa chaau ||
verses.translation: You may be in love with tens of thousands, and live for thousands of years; but what good are these pleasures and occupations?

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa vis hoi vichhoRaa ek ghaRee meh jai ||
verses.translation: And when you must separate from them, that separation is like poison, but they will be gone in an instant.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je sau varihaa miThaa khaajai bhee fir kauRaa khai ||
verses.translation: You may eat sweets for a hundred years, but eventually, you will have to eat the bitter as well.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa khaadhaa chit na aavai kauRatan dhai jai ||
verses.translation: Then, you will not remember eating the sweets; bitterness will permeate you.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਉੜਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa kauRaa dhovai rog ||
verses.translation: The sweet and the bitter are both diseases.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)t vigute bhog ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, eating them, you will come to ruin in the end.

verses.original: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਝਾਖ ॥
verses.translit: jhakh jhakh jhakhanaa jhagaRaa jhaakh ||
verses.translation: It is useless to worry and struggle to death.

verses.original: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝਖਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhakh jhakh jaeh jhakheh tin(h) paas ||1||
verses.translation: Entangled in worries and struggles, people exhaust themselves. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਕਾਠੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਂਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaapaR kaaTh ra(n)gaiaa raa(n)g ||
verses.translation: They have fine clothes and furniture of various colors.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਗਚ ਕੀਤੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਬਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: ghar gach keete baage baag ||
verses.translation: Their houses are painted beautifully white.

verses.original: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sahaj kar man khelaiaa ||
verses.translation: In pleasure and poise, they play their mind games.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tai seh paasahu kahan kahaiaa ||
verses.translation: When they approach You, O Lord, they shall be spoken to.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa kar kai kauRaa khaiaa ||
verses.translation: They think it is sweet, so they eat the bitter.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਉੜੈ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kauRai tan rog jamaiaa ||
verses.translation: The bitter disease grows in the body.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je fir miThaa peRai pai ||
verses.translation: If, later on, they receive the sweet,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tau kauRatan chookas mai ||
verses.translation: then their bitterness shall be gone, O mother.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paavai soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed to receive

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis no praapat likhiaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: what he is predestined to receive. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai mail kapaT hai baahar dhovaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the filth of deception, may wash themselves on the outside.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT kamaavadhe kooR paragaTee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: They practice falsehood and deception, and their falsehood is revealed.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਹ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar hoi su nikalai neh chhapai chhapaiaa ||
verses.translation: That which is within them, comes out; it cannot be concealed by concealment.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai laalach lagiaa fir joonee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Attached to falsehood and greed, the mortal is consigned to reincarnation over and over again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jo beejai so khaavanaa karatai likh paiaa ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever the mortal plants, he must eat. The Creator Lord has written our destiny. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਬੇਦਂੀ ਆਣੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kathaa kahaanee bedha(n)ee aanee paap pu(n)n beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Vedas bring forth stories and legends, and thoughts of vice and virtue.

verses.original: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਲੈਣਾ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦੇਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhe dhe lainaa lai lai dhenaa narak surag avataar ||
verses.translation: What is given, they receive, and what is received, they give. They are reincarnated in heaven and hell.

verses.original: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਾਤੀਂ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: autam madhim jaatee(n) jinasee bharam bhavai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: High and low, social class and status - the world wanders lost in superstition.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee tat vakhaanee giaan dhiaan vich aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Word of Gurbani proclaims the essence of reality. Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained within it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਂੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aakhee gurmukh jaatee surata(n)ee karam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs chant it, and the Gurmukhs realize it. Intuitively aware, they meditate on it.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai hukamai a(n)dhar vekhai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He formed the Universe, and in His Hukam, He keeps it. By His Hukam, He keeps it under His Gaze.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak agahu haumai tuTai taa(n) ko likheeaai lekhai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the mortal shatters his ego before he departs, as it is pre-ordained, then he is approved. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਕਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bedh pukaare pu(n)n paap surag narak kaa beeau ||
verses.translation: The Vedas proclaim that vice and virtue are the seeds of heaven and hell.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਉਗਵੈ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo beejai so ugavai khaa(n)dhaa jaanai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Whatever is planted, shall grow. The soul eats the fruits of its actions, and understands.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: giaan salaahe vaddaa kar sacho sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: Whoever praises spiritual wisdom as great, becomes truthful in the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach beejai sach ugavai dharageh paieeaai thaau ||
verses.translation: When Truth is planted, Truth grows. In the Court of the Lord, you shall find your place of honor.

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bedh vapaaree giaan raas karamee palai hoi ||
verses.translation: The Vedas are only merchants; spiritual wisdom is the capital; by His Grace, it is received.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲਦਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raasee baaharaa ladh na chaliaa koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without capital, no one has ever departed with profit. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)m birakh bahu sa(n)cheeaai a(n)mirat ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: You can water a bitter neem tree with ambrosial nectar.

verses.original: ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: biseear ma(n)tr visaaheeaai bahu dhoodh peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: You can feed a venomous snake lots of milk.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਪਥਰੁ ਨਾਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh abhi(n)n na bhijiee pathar naavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is resistant; he cannot be softened. You might as well water a stone.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bikh meh a(n)mrit si(n)cheeaai bikh kaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: Irrigating a poisonous plant with ambrosial nectar, only poisonous fruit is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)gat mel har sabh bikh leh jaiaa ||16||
verses.translation: O Lord, please unite Nanak with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, so that he may be rid of all poison. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਰਣਿ ਨ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਪੁਛੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maran na moorat puchhiaa puchhee thit na vaar ||
verses.translation: Death does not ask the time; it does not ask the date or the day of the week.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਨੑੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)ee ladhiaa ik ladh chale ikan(h)ee badhe bhaar ||
verses.translation: Some have packed up, and some who have packed up have gone.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa hoiee saakhatee ikan(h)aa hoiee saar ||
verses.translation: Some are severely punished, and some are taken care of.

verses.original: ਲਸਕਰ ਸਣੈ ਦਮਾਮਿਆ ਛੁਟੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: lasakar sanai dhamaamiaa chhuTe ba(n)k dhuaar ||
verses.translation: They must leave their armies and drums, and their beautiful mansions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dderee chhaar kee bhee fir hoiee chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the pile of dust is once again reduced to dust. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਕੋਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dderee ddeh piee miTee sa(n)dhaa koT ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the pile shall fall apart; the fortress of the body is made of dust.

verses.original: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਖੋਟੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਖੋਟੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bheetar chor bahaaliaa khoT ve jeeaa khoT ||2||
verses.translation: The thief has settled within you; O soul, your life is false. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਨਕ ਵਢੇ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)dhar ni(n)dhaa dhusaT hai nak vadde nak vaddaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਕਰੂਪ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa karoop dhukhe'ee sadhaa kaale muh maiaa ||
verses.translation: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake uTh nit par dharab hireh har naam churaiaa ||
verses.translation: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tin kee sa(n)gat mat karahu rakh leh har raiaa ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak piaai kirat kamaavadhe manmukh dhukh paiaa ||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producing nothing but pain. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh koiee hai khasam kaa khasamahu sabh ko hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone belongs to our Lord and Master. Everyone came from Him.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa taa sach paavai koi ||
verses.translation: Only by realizing the Hukam of His Command, is Truth obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap pachhaaneeaai buraa na dheesai koi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes his own self; no one appears evil to him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Fruitful is his coming into the world. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa dhaataa aap hai aape melanahaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of all; He unites all with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh mile na vichhuReh jinaa seviaa har dhaataar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are united with the Word of the Shabad; serving the Lord, the Great Giver, they shall never be separated from Him again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hiradhai saa(n)t hai naau ugav aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Peace and tranquility fill the heart of the Gurmukh; the Name wells up within them.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap teerath sa(n)jam kare mere prabh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditation, penance and self-discipline, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage - the merits of these come by pleasing my God.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhaa sudh har sevadhe soheh gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: So serve the Lord with a pure heart; singing His Glorious Praises, you shall be embellished and exalted.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere har jeeau evai bhaavadhaa gurmukh taraiaa ||
verses.translation: My Dear Lord is pleased by this; he carries the Gurmukh across.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh melian har dhar sohaiaa ||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is merged with the Lord; he is embellished in His Court. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੀ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhanava(n)taa iv hee kahai avaree dhan kau jaau ||
verses.translation: Thus speaks the wealthy man: I should go and get more wealth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak niradhan tit dhin jit dhin visarai naau ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak becomes poor on that day when he forgets the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜੈ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਘਟੈ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj chaRai vijog sabhasai ghaTai aarajaa ||
verses.translation: The sun rises and sets, and the lives of all run out.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਾਰੈ ਕੋ ਜਿਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: tan man rataa bhog koiee haarai ko jinai ||
verses.translation: The mind and body experience pleasures; one loses, and another wins.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਿਆ ਫੂਕਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਥੰਮੑੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko bhariaa fook aakhan kahan na tha(n)m(h)eeaai ||
verses.translation: Everyone is puffed up with pride; even after they are spoken to, they do not stop.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਫੂਕ ਕਢਾਏ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vekhai aap fook kaddaae ddeh pavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; when He takes the air out of the balloon, the body falls. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat naam nidhaan hai jithahu har paiaa ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Name is in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. There, the Lord is found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ghaT chaananaa aan(h)er gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: lohaa paaras bheTeeaai ka(n)chan hoi aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Iron is transformed into gold, when it touches the Philosopher's Stone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai naau paieeaai mil naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, the Name is obtained. Meeting Him, the mortal meditates on the Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kai potai pu(n)n hai tin(h)ee dharasan paiaa ||19||
verses.translation: Those who have virtue as their treasure, obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਵੇਚਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag tinaa kaa jeeviaa j likh likh vecheh naau ||
verses.translation: Cursed are the lives of those who read and write the Lord's Name to sell it.

verses.original: ਖੇਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਉਜੜੈ ਖਲਵਾੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khetee jin kee ujaRai khalavaaRe kiaa thaau ||
verses.translation: Their crop is devastated - what harvest will they have?

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਰਮੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਅਗੈ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਦਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachai saramai baahare agai laheh na dhaadh ||
verses.translation: Lacking truth and humility, they shall not be appreciated in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਅਕਲਿ ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਕਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: akal eh na aakheeaai akal gavaieeaai baadh ||
verses.translation: Wisdom which leads to arguments is not called wisdom.

verses.original: ਅਕਲੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਕਲੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: akalee saahib seveeaai akalee paieeaai maan ||
verses.translation: Wisdom leads us to serve our Lord and Master; through wisdom, honor is obtained.

verses.original: ਅਕਲੀ ਪੜਿੑ ਕੈ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਅਕਲੀ ਕੀਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: akalee paRi(h) kai bujheeaai akalee keechai dhaan ||
verses.translation: Wisdom does not come by reading textbooks; wisdom inspires us to give in charity.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai raahu eh hor galaa(n) saitaan ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is the Path; other things lead to Satan. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਨੀ ਜਰੂਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa karai kahaavai taisaa aaisee banee jaroorat ||
verses.translation: Mortals are known by their actions; this is the way it has to be.

verses.original: ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਿੰਙ ਝਿੰਙ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੂਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoveh li(n)n(g) jhi(n)n(g) neh hoveh aaisee kaheeaai soorat ||
verses.translation: They should show goodness, and not be deformed by their actions; this is how they are called beautiful.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਓਸੁ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਮੂਰਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo os ichhe so fal paae taa(n) naanak kaheeaai moorat ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever they desire, they shall receive; O Nanak, they become the very image of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur a(n)mirat birakh hai a(n)mirat ras faliaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the tree of ambrosia. it bears the fruit of sweet nectar.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis paraapat so lahai gur sabadhee miliaa ||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, who is so pre-destined, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai har setee raliaa ||
verses.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, is blended with the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਬਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal joh na sakiee ghaT chaanan baliaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even see him; his heart is illumined with God's Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhas milaian fir garabh na galiaa ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God forgives him, and blends him with Himself; he does not rot away in the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach varat sa(n)tokh teerath giaan dhiaan isanaan ||
verses.translation: Those who have truth as their fast, contentment as their sacred shrine of pilgrimage, spiritual wisdom and meditation as their cleansing bath,

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhevataa khimaa japamaalee te maanas paradhaan ||
verses.translation: kindness as their deity, and forgiveness as their chanting beads - they are the most excellent people.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਚਉਕਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jugat dhotee surat chaukaa tilak karanee hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who take the Way as their loincloth, and intuitive awareness their ritualistically purified enclosure, with good deeds their ceremonial forehead mark,

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhojan naanakaa viralaa ta koiee koi ||1||
verses.translation: and love their food - O Nanak, they are very rare. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਉਮੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naumee nem sach je karai ||
verses.translation: On the ninth day of the month, make a vow to speak the Truth,

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh tirasanaa ucharai ||
verses.translation: and your sexual desire, anger and desire shall be eaten up.

verses.original: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸੇ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੈ ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhasamee dhase dhuaar je Thaakai ekaadhasee ek kar jaanai ||
verses.translation: On the tenth day, regulate your ten doors; on the eleventh day, know that the Lord is One.

verses.original: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaadhasee pa(n)ch vasagat kar raakhai tau naanak man maanai ||
verses.translation: On the twelfth day, the five thieves are subdued, and then, O Nanak, the mind is pleased and appeased.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਵਰਤੁ ਰਹੀਜੈ ਪਾਡੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaisaa varat raheejai paadde hor bahut sikh kiaa dheejai ||2||
verses.translation: Observe such a fast as this, O Pandit, O religious scholar; of what use are all the other teachings? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhoopat raaje ra(n)g rai sa(n)cheh bikh maiaa ||
verses.translation: Kings, rulers and monarchs enjoy pleasures and gather the poison of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਦੇ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar het vadhaidhe par dharab churaiaa ||
verses.translation: In love with it, they collect more and more, stealing the wealth of others.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਵਿਸਹਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr na visaheh bahu preet lagaiaa ||
verses.translation: They do not trust their own children or spouses; they are totally attached to the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੁਹਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਹਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vekhadhiaa hee maiaa dhuh giee pachhuteh pachhutaiaa ||
verses.translation: But even as they look on, Maya cheats them, and they come to regret and repent.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhe maare'eh naanak har bhaiaa ||21||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are beaten and punished; O Nanak, it pleases the Will of the Lord. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: giaan vihoonaa gaavai geet ||
verses.translation: The one who lacks spiritual wisdom sings religious songs.

verses.original: ਭੁਖੇ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਘਰੇ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhukhe mulaa(n) ghare maseet ||
verses.translation: The hungry Mullah turns his home into a mosque.

verses.original: ਮਖਟੂ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: makhaToo hoi kai ka(n)n paRaae ||
verses.translation: The lazy unemployed has his ears pierced to look like a Yogi.

verses.original: ਫਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: fakar kare hor jaat gavaae ||
verses.translation: Someone else becomes a pan-handler, and loses his social status.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਮੰਗਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur peer sadhaae ma(n)gan jai ||
verses.translation: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around begging

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਐ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai mool na lageeaai pai ||
verses.translation: - don't ever touch his feet.

verses.original: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaal khai kichh hathahu dhei ||
verses.translation: One who works for what he eats, and gives some of what he has

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak raahu pachhaaneh sei ||1||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, he knows the Path. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੂਪ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ॥
verses.translit: manahu j a(n)dhe koop kahiaa biradh na jaanan(h)ee ||
verses.translation: Those mortals whose minds are like deep dark pits do not understand the purpose of life, even when it is explained to them.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲਿ ਦਿਸਨਿੑ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)dhai uoo(n)dhai kaval dhisani(h) khare karoop ||
verses.translation: Their minds are blind, and their heart-lotuses are upside-down; they look totally ugly.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: eik keh jaaneh kahiaa bujheh te nar sughaR saroop ||
verses.translation: Some know how to speak, and understand what they are told. They are wise and beautiful.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਦ ਨ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਗੀਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa naadh na bedh na geea ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
verses.translation: Some do not understand about the Sound-current of the Naad or the Vedas, music, virtue or vice.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਸਰ ਅਖਰ ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa sudh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheau na laha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Some are not blessed with understanding, intelligence, or sublime intellect; they do not grasp the mystery of God's Word.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਲਿ ਖਰ ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੰਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak se nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are donkeys; they are very proud of themselves, but they have no virtues at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabh pavit hai dhan sa(n)pai maiaa ||
verses.translation: To the Gurmukh, everything is sacred: wealth, property, Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਜੋ ਖਰਚਦੇ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har arath jo kharachadhe dhe(n)dhe sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who spend the wealth of the Lord find peace through giving.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo har naam dhiaaidhe tin toT na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name shall never be deprived.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਟਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa(n) nadharee aavadhaa maiaa suT paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs come to see the Lord, and leave behind the things of Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹੋਰੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa(n) hor chit na aaviee har naam samaiaa ||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees do not think of anything else; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan se vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh jin(h)aa ek liv laagee ||
verses.translation: They are lovingly attuned to the True Shabad, the Word of the One God.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: gireh kuTa(n)b meh sahaj samaadhee ||
verses.translation: In their own household and family, they are in natural Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate se sache bairaagee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are truly detached from the world. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ganatai sev na hoviee keetaa thai na pai ||
verses.translation: Calculated service is not service at all, and what is done is not approved.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaio sach na lago bhaau ||
verses.translation: The flavor of the Shabad, the Word of God, is not tasted if the mortal is not in love with the True Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur piaaraa na lagiee manahaTh aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The stubborn-minded person does not even like the True Guru; he comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਭਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਦਸ ਵਿਖਾਂ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ik vikh agaahaa bhare taa(n) dhas vikhaa(n) pichhaahaa jai ||
verses.translation: He takes one step forward, and ten steps back.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree je chaleh satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: The mortal works to serve the True Guru, if he walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap gavai satiguroo no milai sahaje rahai samai ||
verses.translation: He loses his self-conceit, and meets the True Guru; he remains intuitively absorbed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tin(h)aa naam na veesarai sache mel milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਇਦੇ ਕੋ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khaan malook kahaidhe ko rahan na paiee ||
verses.translation: They call themselves emperors and rulers, but none of them will be allowed to stay.

verses.original: ਗੜੑ ਮੰਦਰ ਗਚ ਗੀਰੀਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gaR(h) ma(n)dhar gach geereeaa kichh saath na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Their sturdy forts and mansions - none of them will go along with them.

verses.original: ਸੋਇਨ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: soin saakhat paun veg dhirag dhirag chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Their gold and horses, fast as the wind, are cursed, and cursed are their clever tricks.

verses.original: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhateeh a(n)mirat parakaar kareh bahu mail vadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Eating the thirty-six delicacies, they become bloated with pollution.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jo dhevai tiseh na jaanan(h)ee manmukh dhukh paiee ||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh does not know the One who gives, and so he suffers in pain. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋੁਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੇਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paRi(h) paRi(h) pa(n)ddit muonee thake dhesa(n)tar bhav thake bhekhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and recite until they get tired. They wander through foreign lands in their religious robes, until they are exhausted.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai naau kadhe na pain dhukh laagaa at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: In love with duality, they never receive the Name. Held in the grasp of pain, they suffer terribly.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh a(n)dhe trai gun seveh maiaa kai biauhaaree ||
verses.translation: The blind fools serve the three gunas, the three dispositions; they deal only with Maya.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar kapaT udhar bharan kai taiee paaTh paReh gaavaaree ||
verses.translation: With deception in their hearts, the fools read sacred texts to fill their bellies.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve so sukh paae jin haumai vichahu maaree ||
verses.translation: One who serves the True Guru finds peace; he eradicates egotism from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁਨਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak paRanaa gunanaa ik naau hai boojhai ko beechaaree ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is One Name to chant and dwell on; how rare are those who reflect on this and understand. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਂਗੇ ਆਵਣਾ ਨਾਂਗੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa(n)ge aavanaa naa(n)ge jaanaa har hukam paiaa kiaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Naked we come, and naked we go. This is by the Lord's Command; what else can we do?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee vasat soiee lai jaigaa ros kisai siau keejai ||
verses.translation: The object belongs to Him; He shall take it away; with whom should one be angry.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su bhaanaa ma(n)ne sahaje har ras peejai ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh accepts God's Will; he intuitively drinks in the Lord's sublime essence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sukhadhaataa sadhaa salaahih rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Giver of peace forever; with your tongue, savor the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੜਿੑ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gaRi(h) kaiaa seegaar bahu bhaa(n)t banaiee ||
verses.translation: The fortress of the body has been decorated and adorned in so many ways.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਕਤੀਫਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਧਰ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g para(n)g kateefiaa pahireh dhar maiee ||
verses.translation: The wealthy wear beautiful silk robes of various colors.

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਦੁਲੀਚਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਭਾ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: laal supedh dhuleechiaa bahu sabhaa banaiee ||
verses.translation: They hold elegant and beautiful courts, on red and white carpets.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭੋਗਣਾ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh khaanaa dhukh bhoganaa garabai garabaiee ||
verses.translation: But they eat in pain, and in pain they seek pleasure; they are very proud of their pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na chetio a(n)t le chhaddaiee ||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mortal does not even think of the Name, which shall deliver him in the end. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje sukh sutee sabadh samai ||
verses.translation: She sleeps in intuitive peace and poise, absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape prabh mel liee gal lai ||
verses.translation: God hugs her close in His Embrace, and merges her into Himself.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa chookee sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Duality is eradicated with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: The Naam comes to abide in her mind.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se ka(n)Th laae j bha(n)n ghaRai ||
verses.translation: He hugs close in His Embrace those who shatter and reform their beings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo dhur mile se hun aan milai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are predestined to meet Him, come and meet Him now. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee naam visaariaa kiaa jap jaapeh hor ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - so what if they chant other chants?

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa a(n)dhar keeT se muThe dha(n)dhai chor ||
verses.translation: They are maggots in manure, plundered by the thief of worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai jhooThe laalach hor ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; greed for anything else is false. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam salaahan naam ma(n)n asathir jag soiee ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the Naam, and believe in the Naam, are eternally stable in this world.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har har chitavai dhoojaa nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: Within their hearts, they dwell on the Lord, and nothing else at all.

verses.original: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: rom rom har ucharai khin khin har soiee ||
verses.translation: With each and every hair, they chant the Lord's Name, each and every instant, the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa niramal mal khoiee ||
verses.translation: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and certified; pure and unstained, his filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jeevadhaa purakh dhiaaiaa amaraa padh hoiee ||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Lord of eternal life, the status of immortality is obtained. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa bahu karam kamaaveh hor ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Naam and do other things,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jam pur badhe maare'eh jiau sa(n)n(h)ee upar chor ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, will be bound and gagged and beaten in the City of Death, like the thief caught red-handed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਜਪੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharat suhaavaRee aakaas suha(n)dhaa japa(n)dhiaa har naau ||
verses.translation: The earth is beauteous, and the sky is lovely, chanting the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਤਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihooniaa tin(h) tan khaaveh kaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who lack the Naam - their carcasses are eaten by the crows. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam salaahan bhaau kar nij mahalee vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who lovingly praise the Naam, and dwell in the mansion of the self deep within,

verses.original: ਓਇ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: oi baahuR jon na aavanee fir hoh na binaasaa ||
verses.translation: do not enter into reincarnation ever again; they shall never be destroyed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har setee ra(n)g rav rahe sabh saas giraasaa ||
verses.translation: They remain immersed and absorbed in the love of the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa ra(n)g kadhe na utarai gurmukh paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; the Gurmukhs are enlightened.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: oi kirapaa kar kai melian naanak har paasaa ||26||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He unites them with Himself; O Nanak, the Lord keeps them by His side. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jichar ih man laharee vich hai haumai bahut aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: As long as his mind is disturbed by waves, he is caught in ego and egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaviee naam na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: He does not find the taste of the Shabad, and he does not embrace love for the Name.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa thai na paviee tis kee khap khap hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: His service is not accepted; worrying and worrying, he wastes away in misery.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sevak soiee aakheeaai jo sir dhare utaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who cuts off his head, and offers it to the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n le sabadh rakhai ur dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He accepts the Will of the True Guru, and enshrines the Shabad within his heart. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੋ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jap tap sevaa chaakaree jo khasamai bhaavai ||
verses.translation: That is chanting and meditation, work and selfless service, which is pleasing to our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਆਪਤੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase mel le aapat gavaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself forgives, and takes away self-conceit, and unites the mortals with Himself.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa kadhe na veechhuRai jotee jot milaavai ||
verses.translation: United with the Lord, the mortal is never separated again; his light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur parasaadhee so bujhasee jis aap bujhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, the mortal understands, when the Lord allows him to understand. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko lekhe vich hai manmukh aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: All are held accountable, even the egotistical self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har naam kadhe na chetiee jamakaal sir maaree ||
verses.translation: They never even think of the Name of the Lord; the Messenger of Death shall hit them on their heads.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਲਦੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paap bikaar manoor sabh ladhe bahu bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Their sin and corruption are like rusty slag; they carry such a heavy load.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maarag bikham ddaraavanaa kiau tareeaai taaree ||
verses.translation: The path is treacherous and terrifying; how can they cross over to the other side?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gur raakhe se ubare har naam udhaaree ||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whom the Guru protects are saved. They are saved in the Name of the Lord. ||27||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vin satigur seve sukh nahee mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds peace; mortals die and are reborn, over and over again.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: moh Thagaulee paieean bahu dhoojai bhai vikaar ||
verses.translation: They have been given the drug of emotional attachment; in love with duality, they are totally corrupt.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik gur parasaadhee ubare tis jan kau kareh sabh namasakaar ||
verses.translation: Some are saved, by Guru's Grace. Everyone humbly bows before such humble beings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak anadhin naam dhiaai too a(n)tar jit paaveh mokh dhuaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, deep within yourself, day and night. You shall find the Door of Salvation. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh visaariaa sach maranaa har naam ||
verses.translation: Emotionally attached to Maya, the mortal forgets truth, death and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa janam giaa a(n)dhar dhukh sahaam ||
verses.translation: Engaged in worldly affairs, his life wastes away; deep within himself, he suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur sev sukh paiaa jin(h) poorab likhiaa karaam ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who have the karma of such pre-ordained destiny, serve the True Guru and find peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa paReeaai har naam fir lekh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Read the account of the Name of the Lord, and you shall never again be called to account.

verses.original: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਦ ਢੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: puchh na sakai koi har dhar sadh ddoiee ||
verses.translation: No one will question you, and you will always be safe in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦੇ ਭੇਟ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal milai dhe bheT sevak nit hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death will meet you, and be your constant servant.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te mahal paiaa pat paragaT loiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, you shall find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. You shall be famous throughout the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak anahadh dhunee dhar vajadhe miliaa har soiee ||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates at your door; come and merge with the Lord. ||28||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa kahiaa je kare sukhee hoo sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings, attains the most sublime peace of all peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee karanee bhau kaTeeaai naanak paaveh paar ||1||
verses.translation: Acting in accordance with the Guru, his fear is cut away; O Nanak, he is carried across. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach puraanaa naa theeaai naam na mailaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Lord does not grow old; His Naam is never dirtied.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai je chalai bahuR na aavan hoi ||
verses.translation: Whoever walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall not be reborn again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam visaariaai aavan jaanaa dhoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam, come and go in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gat jan jaachai dhaan har dheh subhai ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar; I ask this blessing of You: O Lord, please embellish me with Your Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan kee piaas hai dharasan tirapatai ||
verses.translation: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; His Darshan brings me satisfaction.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਾਂ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal ghaRee na jeevuoo bin dhekhe maraa(n) mai ||
verses.translation: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without seeing Him, O my mother.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur naal dhikhaaliaa rav rahiaa sabh thai ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me; He is permeating and pervading all places.

verses.original: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਠਾਲਿ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: sutiaa aap uThaal dhei naanak liv lai ||29||
verses.translation: He Himself wakes the sleepers, O Nanak, and lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||29||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bol na jaanan(h)ee onaa a(n)dhar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not even know how to speak. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: thaau kuthaau na jaananee sadhaa chitaveh bikaar ||
verses.translation: They do not know the difference between good and bad; they constantly think of corruption.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਓਥੈ ਹੋਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh lekhaa ma(n)geeaai othai hoh kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Court, they are called to account, and they are judged to be false.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT upaieean aap kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates the Universe. He Himself contemplates it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kis no aakheeaai sabh varatai aap sachiaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whom should we tell? The True Lord is permeating and pervading all. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har gurmukh tin(h)ee araadhiaa jin(h) karam paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs worship and adore the Lord; they receive the good karma of their actions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hau balihaaree tin(h) kau jin(h) har man vasiaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aas kare sabh lok bahu jeevan jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: All people cherish hope, that they will live long lives.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੜੑ ਮੰਡਪ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit jeevan kau chit gaR(h) ma(n)ddap savaariaa ||
verses.translation: They wish to live forever; they adorn and embellish their forts and mansions.

verses.original: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: valava(n)ch kar upaav maiaa hir aaniaa ||
verses.translation: By various frauds and deceptions, they steal the wealth of others.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਸਾਸ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal nihaale saas aav ghaTai betaaliaa ||
verses.translation: But the Messenger of Death keeps his gaze on their breath, and the life of those goblins decreases day by day.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gur saranaiee ubare har gur rakhavaaliaa ||30||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Guru, and is saved. The Guru, the Lord, is his Protector. ||30||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit vaadh vakhaanadhe maiaa moh suaai ||
verses.translation: Reading and writing, the Pandits engage in debates and disputes; they are attached to the flavors of Maya.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they forget the Naam. Those foolish mortals shall receive their punishment.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿੑ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੑੀ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jini(h) keete tisai na sevan(h)ee dhedhaa rijak samai ||
verses.translation: They do not serve the One who created them, who gives sustenance to all.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jam kaa faahaa galahu na kaTeeaai fir fir aaveh jai ||
verses.translation: The noose of Death around their necks is not cut off; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa satigur miliaa tin aai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam dhiaaidhe naanak sach samai ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, they merge into the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach vanajeh sach sevadhe j gurmukh pairee paeh ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who fall at His Feet deal with the True Lord and serve the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur kai bhaanai je chaleh sahaje sach samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who walk in harmony with the Guru's Will are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa vich at dhukh ghanaa manmukh chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: In hope, there is very great pain; the self-willed manmukh focuses his consciousness on it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhe niraas param sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs become desireless, and attain supreme peace.

verses.original: ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: viche gireh udhaas alipat liv laiaa ||
verses.translation: In the midst of their household, they remain detached; they are lovingly attuned to the Detached Lord.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: onaa sog vijog na viaapiee har bhaanaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Sorrow and separation do not cling to them at all. They are pleased with the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har setee sadhaa rav rahe dhur le milaiaa ||31||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they remain forever immersed in the Primal Lord, who blends them with Himself. ||31||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਾਈ ਅਮਾਣ ਕਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ਦਿਤੀ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: paraiee amaan kiau rakheeaai dhitee hee sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Why keep what is held in trust for another? Giving it back, peace is found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਥੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh gur thai Tikai hor thai paragaT na hoi ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad rests in the Guru; it does not appear through anyone else.

verses.original: ਅੰਨੑੇ ਵਸਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਵੇਚਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n(h)e vas maanak piaa ghar ghar vechan jai ||
verses.translation: The blind man finds a jewel, and goes from house to house selling it.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa parakh na aaviee add na palai pai ||
verses.translation: But they cannot appraise it, and they do not offer him even half a shell for it.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਾਂ ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਲਇਓੁ ਪਰਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je aap parakh na aaviee taa(n) paarakheeaa thaavahu lio parakhai ||
verses.translation: If he cannot appraise it himself, then he should have it appraised by an appraiser.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਵਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je os naal chit laae taa(n) vath lahai nau nidh palai pai ||
verses.translation: If he focuses his consciousness, then he obtains the true object, and he is blessed with the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਧਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hodhai dhan jag bhukhaa muaa bin satigur sojhee na hoi ||
verses.translation: The wealth is within the house, while the world is dying of hunger. Without the True Guru, no one has a clue.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh seetal man tan vasai tithai sog vijog na koi ||
verses.translation: When the cooling and soothing Shabad comes to dwell in the mind and body, there is no sorrow or separation there.

verses.original: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vasat paraiee aap garab kare moorakh aap ganaae ||
verses.translation: The object belongs to someone else, but the fool is proud of it, and shows his shallow nature.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin boojhe kinai na paio fir fir aavai jaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without understanding, no one obtains it; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਰਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man anadh bhiaa miliaa har preetam sarase sajan sa(n)t piaare ||
verses.translation: My mind is in ecstasy; I have met my Beloved Lord. My beloved friends, the Saints, are delighted.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur mile na vichhuReh kabahoo j aap mele karataare ||
verses.translation: Those who are united with the Primal Lord shall never be separated again. The Creator has united them with Himself.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh raviaa gur paiaa sagale dhookh nivaare ||
verses.translation: The Shabad permeates my inner being, and I have found the Guru; all my sorrows are dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾਂ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa sadhaa salaahee a(n)tar rakhaa(n) ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: I praise forever the Lord, the Giver of peace; I keep Him enshrined deep within my heart.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh tin kee bakheelee k kare j sachai sabadh savaare ||
verses.translation: How can the self-willed manmukh gossip about those who are embellished and exalted in the True Word of the Shabad?

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa dhee aap pat rakhasee meraa piaaraa saranaagat pe gur dhuaare ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Himself preserves the honor of those who have come to the Guru's Door seeking Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh se suhele bhe mukh uoojal dharabaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are filled with joy; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eisataree purakhai bahu preet mil moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The husband and wife are very much in love; joining together, their love increases.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
