verses.translit: putr kalatr nit vekhai vigasai moh maiaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing on his children and his wife, the man is pleased and attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਦੇਸਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਧਨੁ ਚੋਰਾਇ ਆਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhes paradhes dhan chorai aan muh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Stealing the wealth of his own country and other lands, he brings it home and feeds them.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t hovai vair virodh ko sakai na chhaddaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the end, hatred and conflict well up, and no one can save him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai dhirag moh jit lag dhukh paiaa ||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, those loving attachments are cursed; engrossed in them, he suffers in pain. ||32||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)mrit naam hai jit khaadhai sabh bhukh jai ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam. Eating it, all hunger departs.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa mool na hoviee naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: There is no thirst or desire at all, when the Naam comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai j hor khaanaa tit rog lagai tan dhai ||
verses.translation: Eating anything other than the Name, disease runs to afflict the body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ras kas sabadh salaahanaa aape le milai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whoever takes the Praise of the Shabad as his spices and flavors - the Lord unites him in His Union. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeaa a(n)dhar jeeau sabadh hai jit seh melaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The life within all living beings is the Word of the Shabad. Through it, we meet our Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗਿ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai jag aan(h)er hai sabadhe paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the world is in darkness. Through the Shabad, it is enlightened.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit monee paR paR thake bhekh thake tan dhoi ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages read and write until they are weary. The religious fanatics are tired of washing their bodies.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai kinai na paio dhukhe'ee chale roi ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one attains the Lord; the miserable depart weeping and wailing.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the Merciful Lord is attained. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਬਹਿ ਮੰਦੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eisatree purakhai at neh beh ma(n)dh pakaiaa ||
verses.translation: The husband and wife are very much in love; sitting together, they make evil plans.

verses.original: ਦਿਸਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhisadhaa sabh kichh chalasee mere prabh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: All that is seen shall pass away. This is the Will of my God.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਕੋ ਕਢਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiau raheeaai thir jag ko kaddahu upaiaa ||
verses.translation: How can anyone remain in this world forever? Some may try to devise a plan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee chaakaree thir ka(n)dh sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: Working for the Perfect Guru, the wall becomes permanent and stable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhas milaian har naam samaiaa ||33||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord forgives them, and merges them into Himself; they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||33||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh visaariaa gur kaa bhau het apaar ||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, the mortal forgets the Fear of God and Guru, and love for the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lobh lahar sudh mat giee sach na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: The waves of greed take away his wisdom and understanding, and he does not embrace love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinaa sabadh man vasai dharageh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad abides in the mind of the Gurmukhs, who find the Gate of Salvation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aape mel le aape bakhasanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself forgives them, and unites them in Union with Himself. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without Him, we could not live for a moment. Forgetting Him, we could not succeed for an instant.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis siau kiau man rooseeaai jiseh hamaaree chi(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: O mortal, how can you be angry with the One who cares for you? ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਝਿਮਝਿਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: saavan aaiaa jhimajhimaa har gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: The rainy season of Saawan has come. The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਕਾੜਾ ਸਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bhukh kaaRaa sabh chukaisee meeh vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
verses.translation: All pain, hunger and misfortune end, when the rain falls in torrents.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਬੋਹਲ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dharat bhiee hareeaavalee a(n)n ja(n)miaa bohal lai ||
verses.translation: The entire earth is rejuvenated, and the grain grows in abundance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har achi(n)t bulaavai kirapaa kar har aape paavai thai ||
verses.translation: The Carefree Lord, by His Grace, summons that mortal whom the Lord Himself approves.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har tiseh dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu ju a(n)te le chhaddai ||
verses.translation: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He shall save you in the end.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat bhagat ana(n)dh hai sadhaa sukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and devotion to Him is bliss; peace shall come to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa gurmukh naam araadhiaa tinaa dhukh bhukh leh jai ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their pain and hunger departs.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tirapatai gai gun har dharasan dheh subhai ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is satisfied, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. Please embellish him with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee dhaat nit dhevai chaRai savaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru bestows His gifts, which increase day by day.

verses.original: ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: tus dhevai aap dhiaal na chhapai chhapaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows them; they cannot be concealed by concealment.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kaval pragaas unaman liv laieeaa ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mortal is lovingly absorbed in the state of supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kare us dhee rees sir chhaiee paieeaa ||
verses.translation: If anyone tries to challenge him, the Lord throws dust on his head.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak apaR koi na sakiee poore satigur kee vaddiaaieeaa ||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one can equal the glory of the Perfect True Guru. ||34||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: amar veparavaahu hai tis naal siaanap na chaliee na hujat karanee jai ||
verses.translation: The Order of the Lord is beyond challenge. Clever tricks and arguments will not work against it.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd saranai pavai ma(n)n le rajai ||
verses.translation: So abandon your self-conceit, and take to His Sanctuary; accept the Order of His Will.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jam dda(n)dd na lagiee haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates self-conceit from within himself; he shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sevak soiee aakheeaai j sach rahai liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaat jot sabh soorat teree ||
verses.translation: All gifts, light and beauty are Yours.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahut siaanap haumai meree ||
verses.translation: Excessive cleverness and egotism are mine.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam kamaaveh lobh moh viaape haumai kadhe na chookai feree ||
verses.translation: The mortal performs all sorts of rituals in greed and attachment; engrossed in egotsim, he shall never escape the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aap karaae karataa jo tis bhaavai saiee gal cha(n)geree ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Himself inspires all to act. Whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Let Truth be your food, and Truth your clothes, and take the Support of the True Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai melaiaa prabh dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru shall lead you to meet God, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਭਾਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaag pooraa tin jaagiaa japiaa nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: When perfect destiny is activated, the mortal meditates on the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat lagiaa tariaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sifat salaeh kar prabh kaa jaikaar ||35||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory. ||35||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe jeea samaal apanee mihar kar ||
verses.translation: In Your Mercy, You care for all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਮੁਚੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਤਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n paanee much upai dhukh dhaaladh bha(n)n tar ||
verses.translation: You produce corn and water in abundance; You eliminate pain and poverty, and carry all beings across.

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਠਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas sunee dhaataar hoiee sisaT Thar ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver listened to my prayer, and the world has been cooled and comforted.

verses.original: ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪਦਾ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: levahu ka(n)Th lagai apadhaa sabh har ||
verses.translation: Take me into Your Embrace, and take away all my pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਘਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai prabh kaa safal ghar ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the House of God is fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vuThe megh suhaavane hukam keetaa karataar ||
verses.translation: Rain is falling from the clouds - it is so beautiful! The Creator Lord issued His Order.

verses.original: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: rijak upaion agalaa Thaa(n)dd piee sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Grain has been produced in abundance; the world is cooled and comforted.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tan man hariaa hoiaa simarat agam apaar ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are rejuvenated, meditating in remembrance on the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sache sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: O my True Creator Lord God, please shower Your Mercy on me.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keetaa loReh so kareh naanak sadh balihaar ||2||
verses.translation: He does whatever He pleases; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa aap aga(n)m hai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Great Lord is Inaccessible; His glorious greatness is glorious!

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee vekh vigasiaa a(n)tar saa(n)t aaiee ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I blossom forth in ecstasy; tranquility comes to my inner being.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape hai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: All by Himself, He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਭ ਨਥੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap naath sabh natheean sabh hukam chalaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master of all. He has subdued all, and all are under the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩੬॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak har bhaavai so kare sabh chalai rajaiee ||36||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord does whatever He pleases. Everyone walks in harmony with His Will. ||36||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag saara(n)g baanee bhagataa(n) kee ||
verses.translation: Raag Saarang, The Word Of The Devotees.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਨਰ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa nar garabas thoree baat ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why are you so proud of small things?

verses.original: ਮਨ ਦਸ ਨਾਜੁ ਟਕਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਾਂਠੀ ਐਂਡੌ ਟੇਢੌ ਜਾਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man dhas naaj Takaa chaar gaa(n)Thee aai(n)ddau Teddau jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With a few pounds of grain and a few coins in your pocket, you are totally puffed up with pride. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਗਾਂਉ ਸਉ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਇ ਲਖ ਟਕਾ ਬਰਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: bahut prataap gaa(n)au sau paae dhui lakh Takaa baraat ||
verses.translation: With great pomp and ceremony, you control a hundred villages, with an income of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

verses.original: ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhivas chaar kee karahu saahibee jaise ban har paat ||1||
verses.translation: The power you exert will last for only a few days, like the green leaves of the forest. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਆਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa kouoo lai aaio ih dhan naa kouoo lai jaat ||
verses.translation: No one has brought this wealth with him, and no one will take it with him when he goes.

verses.original: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raavan hoo(n) te adhik chhatrapat khin meh ge bilaat ||2||
verses.translation: Emperors, even greater than Raawan, passed away in an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sadhaa thir poojahu jo har naam japaat ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints are steady and stable forever; they worship and adore Him, and chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin kau kirapaa karat hai gobidh te satasa(n)g milaat ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are mercifully blessed by the Lord of the Universe, join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਚਲਤ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa banitaa sut sa(n)pat a(n)t na chalat sa(n)gaat ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, spouse, children and wealth will not go along with you in the end.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer raam bhaj baure janam akaarath jaat ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, O madman. Your life is uselessly wasting away. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾਸ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raajaasram mit nahee jaanee teree ||
verses.translation: I do not know the limits of Your Royal Ashram.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere sa(n)tan kee hau cheree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am the humble slave of Your Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਸਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਆਵੈ ਰੋਵਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: hasato jai su rovat aavai rovat jai su hasai ||
verses.translation: The one who goes laughing returns crying, and the one who goes crying returns laughing.

verses.original: ਬਸਤੋ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੋੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: basato hoi hoi suo uoojar uoojar hoi su basai ||1||
verses.translation: What is inhabited becomes deserted, and what is deserted becomes inhabited. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਥਲ ਕਰਿ ਥਲ ਤੇ ਕੂਆ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jal te thal kar thal te kooaa koop te mer karaavai ||
verses.translation: The water turns into a desert, the desert turns into a well, and the well turns into a mountain.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਤੇ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਚਢਾਵੈ ਚਢੇ ਅਕਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharatee te aakaas chaddaavai chadde akaas giraavai ||2||
verses.translation: From the earth, the mortal is exalted to the Akaashic ethers; and from the ethers on high, he is thrown down again. ||2||

verses.original: ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਤੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhaaree te raaj karaavai raajaa te bhekhaaree ||
verses.translation: The beggar is transformed into a king, and the king into a beggar.

verses.original: ਖਲ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਰਿਬੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khal moorakh te pa(n)ddit karibo pa(n)ddit te mugadhaaree ||3||
verses.translation: The idiotic fool is transformed into a Pandit, a religious scholar, and the Pandit into a fool. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naaree te jo purakh karaavai purakhan te jo naaree ||
verses.translation: The woman is transformed into a man, and the men into women.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer saadhoo ko preetam tis moorat balihaaree ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, God is the Beloved of the Holy Saints. I am a sacrifice to His image. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g baanee naamadheau jee kee ||
verses.translation: Saarang, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਏਂ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaae(n) re man bikhiaa ban jai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why are you going into the forest of corruption?

verses.original: ਭੂਲੌ ਰੇ ਠਗਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolau re Thagamooree khai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have been misled into eating the toxic drug. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaise meen paanee meh rahai ||
verses.translation: You are like a fish living in the water;

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaal jaal kee sudh nahee lahai ||
verses.translation: you do not see the net of death.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸੁਆਦੀ ਲੀਲਿਤ ਲੋਹ ॥
verses.translit: jihabaa suaadhee leelit loh ||
verses.translation: Trying to taste the flavor, you swallow the hook.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaise kanik kaamanee baadhio moh ||1||
verses.translation: You are bound by attachment to wealth and woman. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਸੰਚੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jiau madh maakhee sa(n)chai apaar ||
verses.translation: The bee stores up loads of honey;

verses.original: ਮਧੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: madh leeno mukh dheenee chhaar ||
verses.translation: then someone comes and takes the honey, and throws dust in its mouth.

verses.original: ਗਊ ਬਾਛ ਕਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਖੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: guoo baachh kau sa(n)chai kheer ||
verses.translation: The cow stores up loads of milk;

verses.original: ਗਲਾ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਦੁਹਿ ਲੇਇ ਅਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: galaa baa(n)dh dhuh lei aheer ||2||
verses.translation: then the milkman comes and ties it by its neck and milks it. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaaran sram at karai ||
verses.translation: For the sake of Maya, the mortal works very hard.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਗਾਡੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so maiaa lai gaaddai dharai ||
verses.translation: He takes the wealth of Maya, and buries it in the ground.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਸੰਚੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑ ॥
verses.translit: at sa(n)chai samajhai nahee mooR(h) ||
verses.translation: He acquires so much, but the fool does not appreciate it.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਧੂੜਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhan dharatee tan hoi gio dhooR ||3||
verses.translation: His wealth remains buried in the ground, while his body turns to dust. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਜਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh tirasanaa at jarai ||
verses.translation: He burns in tremendous sexual desire, unresolved anger and desire.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee karai ||
verses.translation: He never joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naamadheau taa chee aan ||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, seek God's Shelter;

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਜੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: nirabhai hoi bhajeeaai bhagavaan ||4||1||
verses.translation: be fearless, and vibrate on the Lord God. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਦਹੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਹੋਡ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ॥
verses.translit: badhahu kee na hodd maadhau mo siau ||
verses.translation: Why not make a bet with me, O Lord of Wealth?

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਤੋ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur te jan jan te Thaakur khel pario hai to siau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: From the master comes the servant, and from the servant, comes the master. This is the game I play with You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan dheau dhehuraa aapan aap lagaavai poojaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the deity, and You are the temple of worship. You are the devoted worshipper.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੇ ਹੈ ਜਲੁ ਕਹਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal te tara(n)g tara(n)g te hai jal kahan sunan kau dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: From the water, the waves rise up, and from the waves, the water. They are only different by figures of speech. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh gaavai aapeh naachai aap bajaavai tooraa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself sing, and You Yourself dance. You Yourself blow the bugle.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਨੁ ਊਰਾ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahat naamadheau too(n) mero Thaakur jan uooraa too pooraa ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, You are my Lord and Master. Your humble servant is imperfect; You are perfect. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਨਿੰਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas ani(n)n mero nij roop ||
verses.translation: Says God: my slave is devoted only to me; he is in my very image.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਤਾਪ ਤ੍ਰਈ ਮੋਚਨ ਪਰਸਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੂਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan nimakh taap triee mochan parasat mukat karat gireh koop ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sight of him, even for an instant, cures the three fevers; his touch brings liberation from the deep dark pit of household affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਭਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: meree baa(n)dhee bhagat chhaddaavai baa(n)dhai bhagat na chhooTai moh ||
verses.translation: The devotee can release anyone from my bondage, but I cannot release anyone from his.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗਹਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਤਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੋ ਪੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek samai mo kau geh baa(n)dhai tau fun mo pai jabaab na hoi ||1||
verses.translation: If, at any time, he grabs and binds me, even then, I cannot protest. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: mai gun ba(n)dh sagal kee jeevan meree jeevan mere dhaas ||
verses.translation: I am bound by virtue; I am the Life of all. My slaves are my very life.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੀ ਤੈਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: naamadhev jaa ke jeea aaisee taiso taa kai prem pragaas ||2||3||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, as is the quality of his soul, so is my love which illuminates him. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g ||
verses.translation: Saarang:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੈ ਨਰ ਕਿਆ ਪੁਰਾਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tai nar kiaa puraan sun keenaa ||
verses.translation: So what have you accomplished by listening to the Puraanas?

verses.original: ਅਨਪਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਭੂਖੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anapaavanee bhagat nahee upajee bhookhai dhaan na dheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Faithful devotion has not welled up within you, and you have not been inspired to give to the hungry. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam na bisario karodh na bisario lobh na chhooTio dhevaa ||
verses.translation: You have not forgotten sexual desire, and you have not forgotten anger; greed has not left you either.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਨਿਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa mukh te nahee chhooTee nifal bhiee sabh sevaa ||1||
verses.translation: Your mouth has not stopped slandering and gossiping about others. Your service is useless and fruitless. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਟ ਪਾਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰੈ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: baaT paar ghar moos biraano peT bharai apraadhee ||
verses.translation: By breaking into the houses of others and robbing them, you fill your belly, you sinner.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਿ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਜਾਇ ਅਪਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh paralok jai apakeerat soiee abidhiaa saadhee ||2||
verses.translation: But when you go to the world beyond, your guilt will be well known, by the acts of ignorance which you committed. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)saa tau man te nahee chhooTee jeea dhiaa nahee paalee ||
verses.translation: Cruelty has not left your mind; you have not cherished kindness for other living beings.

verses.original: ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: paramaana(n)dh saadhasa(n)gat mil kathaa puneet na chaalee ||3||1||6||
verses.translation: Parmaanand has joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Why have you not followed the sacred teachings? ||3||1||6||

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd man har bimukhan ko sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: O mind, do not even associate with those who have turned their backs on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g mahalaa panjavaa sooradhaas ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Sur Daas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)g base har lok ||
verses.translation: The people of the Lord dwell with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਝੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man arap sarabas sabh arapio anadh sahaj dhun jhok ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They dedicate their minds and bodies to Him; they dedicate everything to Him. They are intoxicated with the celestial melody of intuitive ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਬਿਖਈ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan pekh bhe nirabikhiee paae hai sagale thok ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, they are cleansed of corruption. They obtain absolutely everything.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਦਨ ਅਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan basat siau kaaj na kachhooaai su(n)dhar badhan alok ||1||
verses.translation: They have nothing to do with anything else; they gaze on the beauteous Face of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਜੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਤਨਿ ਜੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: siaam su(n)dhar taj aan ju chaahat jiau kusaTee tan jok ||
verses.translation: But one who forsakes the elegantly beautiful Lord, and harbors desire for anything else, is like a leech on the body of a leper.

verses.original: ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਥਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਲੋਕ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: sooradhaas man prabh hath leeno dheeno ih paralok ||2||1||8||
verses.translation: Says Sur Daas, God has taken my mind in His Hands. He has blessed me with the world beyond. ||2||1||8||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g kabeer jeeau ||
verses.translation: Saarang, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kaun sahaiee man kaa ||
verses.translation: Other than the Lord, who is the Help and Support of the mind?

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਭ ਫਨ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa hit laago sabh fan kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Love and attachment to mother, father, sibling, child and spouse, is all just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਗੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: aage kau kichh tulahaa baa(n)dhahu kiaa bharavaasaa dhan kaa ||
verses.translation: So build a raft to the world hereafter; what faith do you place in wealth?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਇਸ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਕਾ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਠਨਕਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa bisaasaa is bhaa(n)dde kaa itanak laagai Thanakaa ||1||
verses.translation: What confidence do you place in this fragile vessel; it breaks with the slightest stroke. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹੁ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal dharam pu(n)n fal paavahu dhoor baa(n)chhahu sabh jan kaa ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the rewards of all righteousness and goodness, if you desire to be the dust of all.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਡਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਨ ਕਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ih man uddan pa(n)kheroo ban kaa ||2||1||9||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: this mind is like the bird, flying above the forest. ||2||1||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag malaar chaupadhe mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Chau-Padhay, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਸਉਣਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa saunaa visar giaa hai maranaa ||
verses.translation: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, the mortal forgets about dying.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khasam visaar khuaaree keenee dhirag jeevan nahee rahanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal is ruined, and his life is cursed. He cannot remain forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: praanee eko naam dhiaavahu ||
verses.translation: O mortal, meditate on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apanee pat setee ghar jaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall go to your true home with honor. ||1 Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tudhano seveh tujh kiaa dheveh maa(n)geh leveh raheh nahee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve You - what can they give You? They beg for and receive what cannot remain.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa jeeaa a(n)dhar jeeau tuhee ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver of all souls; You are the Life within all living beings. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੂਚੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhiaaveh s a(n)mrit paaveh seiee sooche hohee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate, and receive the Ambrosial Nectar; thus they become pure.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ahinis naam japahu re praanee maile hachhe hohee ||3||
verses.translation: Day and night, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal. It makes the filthy immacuate. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਰੁਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jehee rut kaiaa sukh tehaa teho jehee dhehee ||
verses.translation: As is the season, so is the comfort of the body, and so is the body itself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਕੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rut suhaavee saiee bin naavai rut kehee ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that season is beautiful; without the Name, what season is it? ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: karau binau gur apane preetam har var aan milaavai ||
verses.translation: I offer prayers to my Beloved Guru, that He may unite me with my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਘਨ ਘੋਰ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਲਾਲ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sun ghan ghor seetal man moraa laal ratee gun gaavai ||1||
verses.translation: I hear the thunder in the clouds, and my mind is cooled and soothed; imbued with the Love of my Dear Beloved, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: baras ghanaa meraa man bheenaa ||
verses.translation: The rain pours down, and my mind is drenched with His Love.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਨੀ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaanee heearai gur mohee man har ras leenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The drop of Ambrosial Nectar pleases my heart; the Guru has fascinated my mind, which is drenched in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sukhee var kaaman piaaree jis gur bachanee man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: With intuitive peace and poise, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband Lord; her mind is pleased and appeased by the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har var naar bhiee sohaagan man tan prem sukhaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: She is the happy soul-bride of her Husband Lord; her mind and body are filled with joy by His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: avagan tiaag bhiee bairaagan asathir var sohaag haree ||
verses.translation: Discarding her demerits, she becomes detached; with the Lord as her Husband, her marriage is eternal.

verses.original: ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sog vijog tis kadhe na viaapai har prabh apanee kirapaa karee ||3||
verses.translation: She never suffers separation or sorrow; her Lord God showers her with His Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan nahee man nihachal poore gur kee oT gahee ||
verses.translation: Her mind is steady and stable; she does not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam jap gurmukh dhan sohaagan sach sahee ||4||2||
verses.translation: She takes the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam; you shall be accepted as the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saachee surat naam nahee tirapate haumai karat gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: They pretend to understand the Truth, but they are not satisfied by the Naam; they waste their lives in egotism.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par naaree rat ni(n)dhaa bikh khaiee dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Caught in slander and attachment to the wealth and women of others, they eat poison and suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭੈ ਕਪਟ ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheen bhai kapaT na chhooTe man mukh maiaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: They think about the Shabad, but they are not released from their fear and fraud; the minds and mouths are filled with Maya, Maya.

verses.original: ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ajagar bhaar ladhe at bhaaree mar janame janam gavaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Loading the heavy and crushing load, they die, only to be reborn, and waste their lives again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man bhaavai sabadh suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is so very beautiful; it is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram jon bhekh bahu keen(h)e gur raakhe sach paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mortal wanders lost in reincarnation, wearing various robes and clothes; when he is saved and protected by the Guru, then he finds the Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਨੑਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teerath tej nivaar na n(h)aate har kaa naam na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not try to wash away his angry passions by bathing at sacred shrines. He does not love the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਜਤ ਕੋ ਤਤ ਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath parahar tiaagiaa jat ko tat hee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He abandons and discards the priceless jewel, and he goes back from where he came.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੀਟ ਭਏ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa keeT bhe ut hee te ut hee maeh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: And so he becomes a maggot in manure, and in that, he is absorbed.

verses.original: ਅਧਿਕ ਸੁਆਦ ਰੋਗ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: adhik suaadh rog adhikaiee bin gur sahaj na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The more he tastes, the more he is diseased; without the Guru, there is no peace and poise. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa surat rahas gun gaavaa gurmukh giaan beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Focusing my awareness on selfless service, I joyfully sing His Praises. As Gurmukh, I contemplate spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਖੋਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: khojee upajai baadhee binasai hau bal bal gur karataaraa ||
verses.translation: The seeker comes forth, and the debater dies down; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋੁਤੇ ਹੀਣਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਤੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham neech huote heenamat jhooThe too sabadh savaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am low and wretched, with shallow and false understanding; You embellish and exalt me through the Word of Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਣ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aatam cheen tahaa too taaran sach taare taaranahaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: And wherever there is self-realization, You are there; O True Lord Savior, You save us and carry us across. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਉ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bais suthaan kahaa(n) gun tere kiaa kiaa kathau apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Where should I sit to chant Your Praises; which of Your Infinite Praises should I chant?

verses.original: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: alakh na lakheeaai agam ajonee too(n) naathaa(n) naathanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Unknown cannot be known; O Inaccessible, Unborn Lord God, You are the Lord and Master of masters.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਤੂ ਕੈਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਕ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kis peh dhekh kahau too kaisaa sabh jaachak too dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: How can I compare You to anyone else I see? All are beggars - You are the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagatiheen naanak dhar dhekhahu ik naam milai ur dhaaraa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Lacking devotion, Nanak looks to Your Door; please bless him with Your One Name, that he may enshrine it in his heart. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਾ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhan pir kaa saadh na jaaniaa saa bilakh badhan kumalaanee ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who has not known delight with her Husband Lord, shall weep and wail with a wretched face.

verses.original: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhiee niraasee karam kee faasee bin gur bharam bhulaanee ||1||
verses.translation: She becomes hopeless, caught in the noose of her own karma; without the Guru, she wanders deluded by doubt. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baras ghanaa meraa pir ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: So rain down, O clouds. My Husband Lord has come home.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bal jaavaa(n) gur apane preetam jin har prabh aan milaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has led me to meet my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਉਤਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: nautan preet sadhaa Thaakur siau anadhin bhagat suhaavee ||
verses.translation: My love, my Lord and Master is forever fresh; I am embellished with devotional worship night and day.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukat bhe gur dharas dhikhaiaa jug jug bhagat subhaavee ||2||
verses.translation: I am liberated, gazing on the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Devotional worship has made me glorious and exalted throughout the ages. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham thaare tirabhavan jag tumaraa too meraa hau teraa ||
verses.translation: I am Yours; the three worlds are Yours as well. You are mine, and I am Yours.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai nira(n)jan paiaa bahur na bhavajal feraa ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I shall not be consigned to this terrifying world-ocean ever again. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਿਰ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: apune pir har dhekh vigaasee tau dhan saach seegaaro ||
verses.translation: If the soul-bride is filled with delight on seeing her Husband Lord, then her decorations are true.

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: akul nira(n)jan siau sach saachee gurmat naam adhaaro ||4||
verses.translation: With the Immaculate Celestial Lord, she becomes the truest of the true. Following the Guru's Teachings, she leans on the Support of the Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੑੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mukat bhiee ba(n)dhan gur khol(h)e sabadh surat pat paiee ||
verses.translation: She is liberated; the Guru has untied her bonds. Focusing her awareness on the Shabad, she attains honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam ridh a(n)tar gurmukh mel milaiee ||5||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is deep within her heart; as Gurmukh, she is united in His Union. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa malaar ||
verses.translation: First Mehla, Malaar:

verses.original: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਰ ਲੋਭਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: par dhaaraa par dhan par lobhaa haumai bikhai bikaar ||
verses.translation: Others' wives, others' wealth, greed, egotism, corruption and poison;

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਭਾਉ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhusaT bhaau taj ni(n)dh paraiee kaam karodh cha(n)ddaar ||1||
verses.translation: evil passions, slander of others, sexual desire and anger - give up all these. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mahal meh baiThe agam apaar ||
verses.translation: The Inaccessible, Infinite Lord is sitting in His Mansion.

verses.original: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bheetar a(n)mrit soiee jan paavai jis gur kaa sabadh ratan aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That humble being, whose conduct is in harmony with the jewel of the Guru's Shabad, obtains the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦੋਊ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh dhouoo sam kar jaanai buraa bhalaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: He sees pleasure and pain as both the same, along with good and bad in the world.

verses.original: ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sudh budh surat naam har paieeaai satasa(n)gat gur piaar ||2||
verses.translation: Wisdom, understanding and awareness are found in the Name of the Lord. In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, embrace love for the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis laahaa har naam paraapat gur dhaataa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: Day and night, profit is obtained through the Lord's Name. The Guru, the Giver, has given this gift.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sikh soiee jan paae jis no nadhar kare karataar ||3||
verses.translation: That Sikh who becomes Gurmukh obtains it. The Creator blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa mahal ma(n)dhar ghar har kaa tis meh raakhee jot apaar ||
verses.translation: The body is a mansion, a temple, the home of the Lord; He has infused His Infinite Light into it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mahal bulaieeaai har mele melanahaar ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is invited to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; the Lord unites him in His Union. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਵਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: pavanai paanee jaanai jaat ||
verses.translation: Know that the creation was formed through air and water;

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆਂ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa(n) agan kare nibharaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: have no doubt that the body was made through fire.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)meh jeea jaanai je thaau ||
verses.translation: And if you know where the soul comes from,

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: surataa pa(n)ddit taa kaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: you shall be known as a wise religious scholar. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh na jaane'eeh mai ||
verses.translation: Who can know the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O mother?

verses.original: ਅਣਡੀਠਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anaddeeThaa kichh kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: Without seeing Him, we cannot say anything about Him.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeaai mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can anyone speak and describe Him, O mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar dhar asamaan piaal ||
verses.translation: He is high above the sky, and beneath the nether worlds.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar kaheeaai dheh veechaar ||
verses.translation: How can I speak of Him? Let me understand.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਹਿਆਇ ॥ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈਸਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin jihavaa jo japai hiaai || koiee jaanai kaisaa naau ||2||
verses.translation: Who knows what sort of Name is chanted, in the heart, without the tongue? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee rahai nibharaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, words fail me.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: so boojhai hovai jis dhaat ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, who is blessed.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis a(n)tar rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Day and night, deep within, he remains lovingly attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: soiee purakh j sach samai ||3||
verses.translation: He is the true person, who is merged in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲੀਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaat kuleen sevak je hoi ||
verses.translation: If someone of high social standing becomes a selfless servant,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa kahanaa kahahu na koi ||
verses.translation: then his praises cannot even be expressed.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਨਾਤਂੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vich sanaata(n)ee sevak hoi ||
verses.translation: And if someone from a low social class becomes a selfless servant,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਣ੍ਹੀਆ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak panheeaa pahirai soi ||4||1||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he shall wear shoes of honor. ||4||1||6||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vechhoRaa ik dhukh bhookh ||
verses.translation: The pain of separation - this is the hungry pain I feel.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਕਤਵਾਰ ਜਮਦੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhukh sakatavaar jamadhoot ||
verses.translation: Another pain is the attack of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhukh rog lagai tan dhai ||
verses.translation: Another pain is the disease consuming my body.

verses.original: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaidh na bhole dhaaroo lai ||1||
verses.translation: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||1||

verses.original: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaidh na bhole dhaaroo lai ||
verses.translation: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine.

verses.original: ਦਰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharadh hovai dhukh rahai sareer ||
verses.translation: The pain persists, and the body continues to suffer.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa dhaaroo lagai na beer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your medicine has no effect on me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: khasam visaar ke'ee ras bhog ||
verses.translation: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal enjoys sensual pleasures;

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਉਠਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: taa(n) tan uTh khaloe rog ||
verses.translation: then, disease rises up in his body.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)dhe kau milai sajai ||
verses.translation: The blind mortal receives his punishment.

verses.original: ਵੈਦ ਨ ਭੋਲੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaidh na bhole dhaaroo lai ||2||
verses.translation: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan kaa fal cha(n)dhan vaas ||
verses.translation: The value of sandalwood lies in its fragrance.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: maanas kaa fal ghaT meh saas ||
verses.translation: The value of the human lasts only as long as the breath in the body.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਇਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saas giaai kaiaa ddal pai ||
verses.translation: When the breath is taken away, the body crumbles into dust.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa kai paachhai koi na khai ||3||
verses.translation: After that, no one takes any food. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa niramal ha(n)s ||
verses.translation: The mortal's body is golden, and the soul-swan is immaculate and pure,

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis meh naam nira(n)jan a(n)s ||
verses.translation: if even a tiny particle of the Immaculate Naam is within.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog sabh giaa gavai ||
verses.translation: All pain and disease are eradicated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak chhooTas saachai nai ||4||2||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mortal is saved through the True Name. ||4||2||7||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਮਹੁਰਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh mahuraa maaran har naam ||
verses.translation: Pain is the poison. The Lord's Name is the antidote.

verses.original: ਸਿਲਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: silaa sa(n)tokh peesan hath dhaan ||
verses.translation: Grind it up in the mortar of contentment, with the pestle of charitable giving.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit leh na chheejai dheh ||
verses.translation: Take it each and every day, and your body shall not waste away.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਠੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jam maarai Theh ||1||
verses.translation: At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਖਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa dhaaroo khaeh gavaar ||
verses.translation: So take such medicine, O fool,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai tere jaeh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: by which your corruption shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਂਵ ॥
verses.translit: raaj maal joban sabh chhaa(n)v ||
verses.translation: Power, wealth and youth are all just shadows,

verses.original: ਰਥਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਥਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: rath fira(n)dhai dheeseh thaav ||
verses.translation: as are the vehicles you see moving around.

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dheh na naau na hovai jaat ||
verses.translation: Neither your body, nor your fame, nor your social status shall go along with you.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਦਿਹੁ ਐਥੈ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: othai dhih aaithai sabh raat ||2||
verses.translation: In the next world it is day, while here, it is all night. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਧਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਘਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kar samadhaa(n) tirasanaa ghiau tel ||
verses.translation: Let your taste for pleasures be the firewood, let your greed be the ghee,

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aganee siau mel ||
verses.translation: and your sexual desire and anger the cooking oil; burn them in the fire.

verses.original: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: hom jag ar paaTh puraan ||
verses.translation: Some make burnt offerings, hold sacred feasts, and read the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases God is acceptable. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਪੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tap kaagadh teraa naam neesaan ||
verses.translation: Intense meditation is the paper, and Your Name is the insignia.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau likhiaa eh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Those for whom this treasure is ordered,

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se dhanava(n)t dhiseh ghar jai ||
verses.translation: look wealthy when they reach their true home.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਧੰਨੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jananee dha(n)nee mai ||4||3||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is that mother who gave birth to them. ||4||3||8||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਗੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: baage kaapaR bolai bain ||
verses.translation: You wear white clothes, and speak sweet words.

verses.original: ਲੰਮਾ ਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)maa nak kaale tere nain ||
verses.translation: Your nose is sharp, and your eyes are black.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੈਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kabahoo(n) saahib dhekhiaa bhain ||1||
verses.translation: Have you ever seen your Lord and Master, O sister? ||1||

verses.original: ਊਡਾਂ ਊਡਿ ਚੜਾਂ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ॥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: uooddaa(n) uoodd chaRaa(n) asamaan || saahib sa(n)mrith terai taan ||
verses.translation: O my All-powerful Lord and Master, by Your power, I fly and soar, and ascend to the heavens.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal ddoo(n)gar dhekhaa(n) teer ||
verses.translation: I see Him in the water, on the land, in the mountains, on the river-banks,

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar saahib beer ||2||
verses.translation: in all places and interspaces, O brother. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਦੀਏ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੰਭ ॥
verses.translit: jin tan saaj dhe'ee naal kha(n)bh ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the body, and gave it wings;

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਡਣੈ ਕੀ ਡੰਝ ॥
verses.translit: at tirasanaa uddanai kee dda(n)jh ||
verses.translation: He gave it great thirst and desire to fly.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੰਧਾਂ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa(n) ba(n)dhaa(n) dheer ||
verses.translation: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, I am comforted and consoled.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਤਿਉ ਵੇਖਾਂ ਬੀਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau vekhaale tiau vekhaa(n) beer ||3||
verses.translation: As He makes me see, so do I see, O brother. ||3||

verses.original: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਨ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਖੰਭ ॥
verses.translit: n ih tan jaigaa na jaahige kha(n)bh ||
verses.translation: Neither this body, nor its wings, shall go to the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: paunai paanee aganee kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: It is a fusion of air, water and fire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karam hovai japeeaai kar gur peer ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it is in the mortal's karma, then he meditates on the Lord, with the Guru as his Spiritual Teacher.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: sach samaavai eh sareer ||4||4||9||
verses.translation: This body is absorbed in the Truth. ||4||4||9||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: The Formless Lord is formed by Himself. He Himself deludes in doubt.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar karataa aape vekhai jit bhaavai tit laae ||
verses.translation: Creating the Creation, the Creator Himself beholds it; He enjoins us as He pleases.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sevak kau ehaa vaddiaaiee jaa kau hukam manaae ||1||
verses.translation: This is the true greatness of His servant, that he obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa bhaanaa aape jaanai gur kirapaa te laheeaai ||
verses.translation: Only He Himself knows His Will. By Guru's Grace, it is grasped.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa sakat sivai ghar aavai jeevadhiaa mar raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When this play of Shiva and Shakti comes to his home, he remains dead while yet alive. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: vedh paRai paR vaadh vakhaanai brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
verses.translation: They read the Vedas, and read them again, and engage in arguments about Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh tiragun maiaa jin jagat bhulaiaa janam maran kaa sahasaa ||
verses.translation: This three-phased Maya has deluded the whole world into cynicism about death and birth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko jaanai chookai manahu a(n)dhesaa ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, know the One Lord, and the anxiety of your mind will be allayed. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham dheen moorakh aveechaaree tum chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
verses.translation: I am meek, foolish and thoughtless, but still, You take care of me.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kar dhaas dhaasaa kaa sevaa karee tumaaree ||
verses.translation: Please be kind to me, and make me the slave of Your slaves, so that I may serve You.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek nidhaan dheh too apanaa ahinis naam vakhaanee ||3||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the treasure of the One Name, that I may chant it, day and night. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak gur parasaadhee boojhahu koiee aaisaa kare veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, understand. Hardly anyone considers this.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਊਪਰਿ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal uoopar fen budhabudhaa taisaa ih sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Like foam bubbling up on the surface of the water, so is this world.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਚੂਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis te hoaa tiseh samaanaa chook giaa paasaaraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: It shall eventually merge back into that from which it came, and all its expanse shall be gone. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee hukam pachhaaniaa se mele haumai sabadh jalai ||
verses.translation: Those who realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command are united with Him; through the Word of His Shabad, their egotism is burnt away.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat kareh dhin raatee sach rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: They perform true devotional worship day and night; they remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sach har vekhadhe gur kai sabadh subhai ||1||
verses.translation: They gaze on their True Lord forever, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with loving ease. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re hukam ma(n)n sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O mortal, accept His Will and find peace.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhaanaa apanaa bhaavadhaa jis bakhase tis bighan na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God is pleased by the Pleasure of His Own Will. Whomever He forgives, meets no obstacles on the way. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai naa har bhagat na bhai ||
verses.translation: Under the influence of the three gunas, the three dispositions, the mind wanders everywhere, without love or devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gat mukat kadhe na hoviee haumai karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: No one is ever saved or liberated, by doing deeds in ego.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saahib bhaavai so theeaai piaai kirat firaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever our Lord and Master wills, comes to pass. People wander according to their past actions. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTiaai man mar rahai har naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the mind is overpowered; the Lord's Name comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: The value of such a person cannot be estimated; nothing at all can be said about him.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chauthai padh vaasaa hoiaa sachai rahai samai ||3||
verses.translation: He comes to dwell in the fourth state; he remains merged in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh agam agochar hai keemat kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: My Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. His value cannot be expressed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bujheeaai sabadhe kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he comes to understand, and live the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh too har har dhar sobhaa pai ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koiee viralaa boojhai jis no nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, understands; the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin dhaataa koiee naahee bakhase nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: There is no Giver except the Guru. He grants His Grace and forgives.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai saa(n)t uoopajai anadhin naam lei ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, peace and tranquility well up; chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har a(n)mirat naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh milai naau paieeaai har naame sadhaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru and the Primal Being, the Name is obtained, and one remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sadhaa vichhuRe fireh koi na kis hee naal ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are forever separated from the Lord; no one is with them.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vaddaa rog hai sir maare jamakaal ||
verses.translation: They are stricken with the great disease of egotism; they are hit on the head by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmat satasa(n)gat na vichhuReh anadhin naam sam(h)aal ||2||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are never separated from the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. They dwell on the Naam, night and day. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa karataa ek too nit kar dhekheh veechaar ||
verses.translation: You are the One and Only Creator of all. You continually create, watch over and contemplate.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik gurmukh aap milaiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Some are Gurmukh - You unite them with Yourself. You bless then with the treasure of devotion.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too aape sabh kichh jaanadhaa kis aagai karee pookaar ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself know everything. Unto whom should I complain? ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam a(n)mrit hai nadharee paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. By the Lord's Grace, it is obtained.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin har har ucharai gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, night and day, the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nidhaan hai naame hee chit lai ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. Focus your consciousness on the Naam. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur saalaahee sadhaa sukhadhaataa prabh naarain soiee ||
verses.translation: I praise the Guru, the Giver of peace, forever. He truly is the Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa vaddee vaddiaaiee hoiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. His glorious greatness is glorious!

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavai nit saache sach samaavai soiee ||1||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, merges in the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man re gurmukh ridhai veechaar ||
verses.translation: O mortal, contemplate the Guru's Word in your heart.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਲਣੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taj kooR kuTa(n)b haumai bikh tirasanaa chalan ridhai sam(h)aal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon your false family, poisonous egotism and desire; remember in your heart, that you will have to leave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa raam naam kaa hor dhaataa koiee naahee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the Lord's Name. There is no other giver at all.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeea dhaan dhei tirapataase sachai naam samaahee ||
verses.translation: Bestowing the gift of the soul, He satisfies the mortal beings, and merges them in the True Name.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin har raviaa ridh a(n)tar sahaj samaadh lagaahee ||2||
verses.translation: Night and day, they ravish and enjoy the Lord within the heart; they are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadhee ih man bhedhiaa hiradhai saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, has pierced my mind. The True Word of His Bani permeates my heart.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh alakh na jaiee lakhiaa gurmukh akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: My God is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Gurmukh speaks the Unspoken.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa japeeaai saari(n)gapaanee ||3||
verses.translation: When the Giver of peace grants His Grace, the mortal being meditates on the Lord, the Life of the Universe. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa bahuR na hovai gurmukh sahaj dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not come and go in renicarnation any longer; the Gurmukh meditates intuitively.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man hee te man miliaa suaamee man hee ma(n)n samaiaa ||
verses.translation: From the mind, the mind merges into our Lord and Master; the mind is absorbed into the Mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saache hee sach saach pateejai vichahu aap gavaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: In truth, the True Lord is pleased with truth; eradicate egotism from within yourself. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko ek vasai man suaamee dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Our One and Only Lord and Master dwells within the mind; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ekuo naam a(n)mrit hai meeThaa jag niramal sach soiee ||
verses.translation: The One Name is Sweet Ambrosial Nectar; it is Immaculate Truth in the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam prabhoo te paieeaai jin kau dhur likhiaa hoiee ||5||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Name of God is obtained, by those who are so predestined. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gan ga(n)dharab naame sabh udhare gur kaa sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: All the heavenly heralds and celestial singers are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar sadh ma(n)n vasaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: They contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Subduing their ego, the Name abides in their minds; they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai jis no aape le milai ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; the Lord unites him with Himself.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਗਾਂਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin baanee sabadhe gaa(n)vai saach rahai liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, he sings the Word of the Shabad and the Guru's Bani; he remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere khin khin naam sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, each and every moment, dwell on the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhaat sabadh sukh a(n)tar sadhaa nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is the Guru's Gift. It shall bring you lasting peace deep within; it shall always stand by you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
