verses.translit: manmukh paakha(n)dd kadhe na chookai dhoojai bhai dhukh paae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs never give up their hypocrisy; in the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam visaar bikhiaa man raate birathaa janam gavaae ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, their minds are imbued with corruption. They waste away their lives uselessly.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eeh velaa fir hath na aavai anadhin sadhaa pachhutaae ||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; night and day, they shall always regret and repent.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mar mar janamai kadhe na boojhai visaTaa maeh samaae ||2||
verses.translation: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn, but they never understand. They rot away in manure. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam rate se udhare gur kaa sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Naam, and are saved; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat har naam dhiaaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, they are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive. They enshrine the Lord within their hearts.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal niramal mat uootam uootam baanee hoiee ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are immaculate, their intellect is immaculate and sublime. Their speech is sublime as well.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eko purakh ek prabh jaataa dhoojaa avar na koiee ||3||
verses.translation: They realize the One Primal Being, the One Lord God. There is no other at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae prabh aape aape nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: God Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause of causes. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raataa gur kee baanee sevaa surat samei ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani. My consciousness is immersed in His service.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasiaa alakh abhevaa gurmukh hoi lakhai ||
verses.translation: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord dwells deep within. He is seen only by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bhaavai tis aape dhevai bhaavai tivai chalai ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He gives to whomever He pleases. According to the Pleasure of His Will, He leads the mortals on. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa dhutuke ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te paavai ghar dhar mahalu su thaan ||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the mortal obtains the special place, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence in his own home.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee chookai abhimaan ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his egotistical pride is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau lilaaT likhiaa dhur naam ||
verses.translation: Those who have the Naam inscribed on their foreheads,

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam sadhaa sadhaa dhiaaveh saachee dharageh paaveh maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: meditate on the Naam night and day, forever and ever. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man kee bidh satigur te jaanai anadhin laagai sadh har siau dhiaan ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, they learn the ways and means of the mind. Night and day, they focus their meditation on the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh rate sadhaa bairaagee har dharageh saachee paaveh maan ||2||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they remain forever detached. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਹੁਕਮ ਕਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man khelai hukam kaa baadhaa ik khin meh dheh dhis fir aavai ||
verses.translation: This mind plays, subject to the Lord's Will; in an instant, it wanders out in the ten directions and returns home again.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) aape nadhar kare har prabh saachaa taa(n) ih man gurmukh tatakaal vas aavai ||3||
verses.translation: When the True Lord God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then this mind is instantly brought under control by the Gurmukh. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kee bidh man hoo jaanai boojhai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The mortal comes to know the ways and means of the mind, realizing and contemplating the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai sadhaa too bhav saagar jit paaveh paar ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd praan sabh tis ke ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Soul, body and breath of life are all His; He is permeating and pervading each and every heart.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa satigur dheeaa bujhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Except the One Lord, I do not know any other at all. The True Guru has revealed this to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere naam rahau liv laiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: adhisaT agochar apara(n)par karataa gur kai sabadh har dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I meditate on the Lord, the Unseen, Unfathomable and Infinite Creator. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bheejai ek liv laagai sahaje rahe samaiee ||
verses.translation: Mind and body are pleased, lovingly attuned to the One Lord, intuitively absorbed in peace and poise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bhram bhau bhaagai ek naam liv laiee ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, doubt and fear are dispelled, being lovingly attuned to the One Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee sach kaar kamaavai gat mat tab hee paiee ||
verses.translation: When the mortal follows the Guru's Teachings, and lives the Truth, then he attains the state of emancipation.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koT madhe kiseh bujhaae tin raam naam liv laiee ||3||
verses.translation: Among millions, how rare is that one who understands, and is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਇਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh eko soiee ieh gurmat budh paiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see the One. This understanding has come through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਰਂੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: man tan praan dhara(n)ee tis aagai naanak aap gavaiee ||4||7||
verses.translation: I place my mind, body and breath of life in offering before Him; O Nanak, self-conceit is gone. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh saachaa dhookh nivaaran sabadhe paiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: My True Lord God, the Eradicator of suffering, is found through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagatee raate sadh bairaagee dhar saachai pat paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with devotional worship, the mortal remains forever detached. He is honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man re man siau rahau samaiee ||
verses.translation: O mind, remain absorbed in the Mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam man bheejai har setee liv laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the Lord's Name, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh at agam agochar gurmat dhei bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: My God is totally Inaccessible and Unfathomable; through the Guru's Teachings, He is understood.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee har keerat har setee liv laiee ||2||
verses.translation: True self-discipline rests in singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabadh sach saakhee aape jin(h) jotee jot milaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Shabad, and He Himself is the True Teachings; He merges our light into the Light.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhehee kaachee paun vajaae gurmukh a(n)mrit paiee ||3||
verses.translation: The breath vibrates through this frail body; the Gurmukh obtains the ambrosial nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape saaje sabh kaarai laae so sach rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself fashions, and He Himself links us to our tasks; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam binaa koiee kichh naahee naame dhei vaddaiee ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is anything. Through the Naam,we are blessed with glory. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਜਗਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai bikh man mohiaa ladhiaa ajagar bhaaree ||
verses.translation: The mortal is enticed by the poison of corruption, burdened with such a heavy load.

verses.original: ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garuR sabadh mukh paiaa haumai bikh har maaree ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has placed the magic spell of the Shabad into his mouth, and destroyed the poison of ego. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man re haumai moh dhukh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: O mortal, egotism and attachment are such heavy loads of pain.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih bhavajal jagat na jaiee taranaa gurmukh tar har taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed; through the Lord's Name, the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa moh pasaaraa sabh varatai aakaaree ||
verses.translation: Attachment to the three-phased show of Maya pervades all the created forms.

verses.original: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tureeaa gun satasa(n)gat paieeaai nadharee paar utaaree ||2||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the Society of the Saints, the state of supreme awareness is attained. The Merciful Lord carries us across. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan ga(n)dh suga(n)dh hai bahu baasanaa bahakaar ||
verses.translation: The smell of sandalwood is so sublime; its fragrance spreads out far and wide.
